job.title: Senior Safeguarding Manager
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for a Senior Safeguarding Manager to promote, embed and deliver a safe and inclusive culture within Men’s Football, with a particular focus on our Youth Academy sites at Hale End and Sobha Realty Training Centre. Working closely with the Head of Safeguarding, you will support the development, implementation and review of safeguarding systems that protect children and young people across the Academy.

In this key role, you will act as deputy to the Head of Safeguarding, providing senior-level support and leadership when required. You will oversee safeguarding compliance across Men’s Football and the Academy, deliver training and awareness initiatives, support Academy tours as the safeguarding lead, and work collaboratively with stakeholders across the Club to identify, assess and mitigate safeguarding risks. You will also contribute to the delivery of the Club’s wider Safeguarding Strategy and help foster a positive, inclusive and safe environment for everyone involved. 

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Act as the lead safeguarding contact for Men’s Football and the Academy - you will provide expert advice, guidance and support to players, parents/carers, employees and workers, helping to embed a positive safeguarding culture and ensuring best practice is consistently followed

  • Represent Safeguarding within the Academy Leadership structure - you'll work closely with the Head of Safeguarding, Academy Director and wider wellbeing teams to shape and deliver safeguarding priorities, Academy outcomes and player welfare initiatives

  • Lead on safeguarding investigations - you will manage concerns relating to poor practice, safeguarding incidents and allegations of abuse, working collaboratively with The FA, Premier League, statutory agencies, safeguarding partnerships and Police where appropriate

  • Deliver safeguarding education and training programmes - you'll create and facilitate engaging workshops and awareness sessions for Academy employees, workers, players, host families and parents/carers to promote safe, inclusive and informed environments

  • Provide safeguarding leadership for Academy tours and trips - you will complete thorough risk assessments, support tour planning and act as the Safeguarding Lead on domestic and international Academy tours when required

  • Manage safeguarding compliance and audit activity - you'll oversee safeguarding requirements linked to the Elite Player Performance Plan (EPPP), support Premier League safeguarding audits and ensure the Academy continues to meet the highest safeguarding standards

  • Deputise for the Head of Safeguarding and drive strategic projects - you will provide senior-level leadership when required, prepare reports for senior stakeholders, support policy development and contribute to the delivery of the Club’s Safeguarding Strategy, Action and Implementation Plan

  • Support safer recruitment and safeguarding risk management across the Club - you'll work closely with People teams, Designated Safeguarding Officers and key stakeholders to manage safeguarding risks, oversee DBS-related processes, conduct risk assessment interviews and ensure concerns are appropriately recorded, assessed and resolved

 

What we are looking for

  • Qualified expert - you come equipped with a professional qualification in Safeguarding

  • Best-in-class emotional intelligence - you're naturally empathetic with a high level of self-awareness and the ability to confidently navigate sensitive situations, difficult conversations and conflict resolution

  • Creative and solutions-focused thinker - you bring a proactive and innovative approach to safeguarding, with the ability to work independently, develop effective solutions and lead projects that strengthen safeguarding practice

  • Excellent relationship builder - you're highly skilled at engaging and working directly with children, young people, adults at risk and their families, building trust and maintaining positive, professional relationships

  • Trusted safeguarding practitioner - you have significant experience managing safeguarding concerns, investigations, referrals and escalations, working effectively with external agencies to achieve positive outcomes

  • Exceptional communicator and influencer - you're able to communicate complex information clearly and confidently across a wide range of audiences, from players and parents/carers to colleagues, senior leaders and external stakeholders

  • Proven stakeholder management skills - you have experience building and managing relationships with senior representatives from statutory agencies, including Children's Services, safeguarding partnerships and the Police, while handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism

  • Analytical and operationally minded - you're experienced in designing and delivering safeguarding training, implementing policies and procedures, analysing safeguarding data, producing reports and case documentation, and working flexibly across multiple sites and outside standard hours when required


Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A flexible hybrid working model

  • Priority access to apply for match tickets

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners

  • An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.


Application Closing Date - Thursday 3rd September 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

Good luck!

job.title: Female Health Physiotherapist (12 Month Fixed Term Contract)
job.location: Bell Lane, St Albans, AL2 1DR, GB
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for a Female Health Physiotherapist on a 12 month Fixed Term Contract basis to support our Women’s First Team medical performance programme and help deliver our AWFC Female Health Strategy.

You'll work closely with the Medical Performance Lead and wider Medical and Performance team to enhance player health, wellbeing and performance through female health and sports medicine initiatives. You will support the ongoing development of our Female Health Strategy and department, this will include all aspects of the seven pillars - Menstrual, Breast, Perinatal, Pelvic Health, MSK, Nutritional and Kit Resources. You'll also provide matchday support as part of the Medical and Performance team.

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Lead the Female Health Strategy - you'll work closely with the Club Doctors to develop, implement and continually evolve AWFC's Female Athlete Health Strategy, while acting as one of our club's designated WSL Female Health Leads

  • Provide expert matchday support - you will act as Assistant Physiotherapist on matchdays and, where required, lead physiotherapy provision for fixtures in collaboration with the Head of Performance Services and Performance Physiotherapist

  • Coordinate player care through the pathway - you'll build relationships with Academy Medical staff and oversee communication regarding Academy players joining the First Team, as well as supporting the management of loan player medical care

  • Deliver world-class medical and performance support - you will work alongside the Medical and Physical Performance teams to enhance player health, wellbeing and performance, while supporting effective recovery and injury reduction strategies

  • Drive data-led decision making - you'll collect and analyse medical and performance data, identify injury trends and contribute to evidence-based strategies that improve performance and minimise injury risk

  • Maintain high standards and best practice - you will help develop departmental processes and standard operating procedures, ensuring all medical records, policies and practices remain compliant, accurate and aligned to industry best practice

  • Manage medical resources and operations - you'll support the organisation of medical equipment and consumables for training, matches and tours, while helping oversee the effective management of facilities and resources

  • Build relationships across our club - you will collaborate with technical, performance and recruitment staff, regularly reporting on player progress, maintaining confidentiality at all times and contributing to the ongoing development of the department

 

What we are looking for

  • Qualified and accredited practitioner - you hold an MSc in Physiotherapy, are HCPC registered, MCSP qualified and maintain appropriate professional indemnity insurance

  • Female health specialist - you've achieved the FA Female Health Lead Certificate and bring an in-depth understanding of female athlete health and wellbeing within elite sport

  • Commitment to professional development - you can demonstrate a consistent record of continuous professional development and remain up to date with current clinical best practice

  • Knowledgeable in elite sport environments - you possess an in-depth understanding of sports science and medicine disciplines and their impact on athlete health, development and performance

  • Evidence-led approach - you're experienced in applying scientific methods to the assessment, monitoring and evaluation of athletes, programmes and performance interventions

  • Medical compliance expertise - you have a sound knowledge of FA Anti-Doping and WADA regulations and hold UK Clean Sport and Safeguarding certification

  • Prepared for high-performance environments - you hold a current FA AREA, ATMMiF or equivalent first aid qualification and are equipped to respond effectively in elite sporting settings

  • Flexible and highly organised - you're able to adapt to changing priorities, travel regularly with the team and work flexible hours and days including weekends


Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A flexible hybrid working model

  • Priority access to apply for match tickets

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners

  • An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.


Application Closing Date - Monday 7th September 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

Good luck!

job.title: Academy Kit Assistant (PDP) - Casual
job.location: Bell Lane, St Albans, AL2 1DR, GB
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for an Academy Kit Assistant on a casual basis to support our PDP team and ensure the effective delivery of kit requirements for our players and colleagues.

In this vital role, you'll play a key part in offering day-to-day support across training sessions and fixtures, through maintaining the highest standards of kit and equipment presentation.

 

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Assist with kit distribution - you will support with kit distribution on a day-to-day basis for our U17-U21 players, ensuring all have appropriate kit for daily activities

  • Ensure excellent presentation - you'll oversee printing for match, training and staff kits and proudly maintain the highest standards of presentation

  • Prepare for upcoming events - you'll organise the packing and preparing of all kit for home and away fixtures, tours and activities

  • Champion operational efficiency - you will diligently maintain our stock inventory and ensure database is accurate

  • Process kit orders - you will support our PDP Kit Coordinator with kit orders

 

What we are looking for

  • Background in sports - you have experience working in youth development or in an elite sport environment

  • Clean UK driving licence - you'll be able to transport yourself to various different locations

  • Confident IT skills - you have excellent IT skills including Microsoft Office and Teamworks

  • Collaborative team player - you're a personable and enthusiastic individual with a competitive work ethic and you work efficiently as part of a team

  • Best-in-class organisational skills - you possess an excellent ability to multi-task and are able to work at pace without compromising quality

  • Foster honesty and integrity - you're a team player and a trusted and proud ambassador for our club

  • Flexible mindset - you have a willingness to work weekends and evenings

job.title: Community Draw Seller (Casual)
job.html_description:
As a Community Draw ticket seller, you will play a vital role in raising funds for the Cherries Community Fund by selling Community Draw tickets at each home matchday. The Cherries Community Fund is dedicated to providing financial assistance to projects that support young people and vulnerable groups in Bournemouth, Dorset, and Hampshire. 
  • Engage with fans at the stadium prior to kick-off. 
  • Promote awareness of the AFC Bournemouth Community Draw. 
  • Proactively sell Community Draw tickets in designated areas, including outside the stadium and in corporate suites. 
  • Handle payment transactions using card machines. 
  • Collaborate with the Community Matchday Draw Supervisor for any queries or assistance.

job.title: Concourse Bar Staff (Casual)
job.html_description:
We are recruiting staff to serve food, confectionery, hot /cold drinks, etc.
 The shifts are approx. 4 - 6 hours home match day only (usually Saturday ko. 3.00pm.).
Staff will be expected to work at a fast pace as we only have a smalltime frame to serve the supporters.

The stadium is very busy on a match day but there is a good atmosphere within the team and you get to know the supporters.

job.title: Global Partner Activation Manager
job.html_description:
The Global Partner Activation Manager is part of AFC Bournemouth’s commercial team and provides crucial support managing and growing relationships with sponsors and partners. The Manager will support the Head of Global Partner Activation and the wider team to ensure contractual sponsorship elements are fulfilled and executed efficiently for a varied list of business partners. 
 
The role holder will act as a senior point of contact within the team and help generate commercial revenue by assisting with contract renewal/refreshing, and opportunistically upselling to their assigned partners, identifying new business opportunities, improve profitability and deliver against KPI’s.  
 
This position will be based at Vitality Stadium Bournemouth and will report to the Head of Global Partner Activation.  
 
The successful candidate will be expected to attend AFC Bournemouth home, as well as non-first team home fixtures and events. This can include working evenings, weekends and public holidays as assigned. The club has various policies in place to allow for time off where this working is required. 
  • Oversee activation and ensure contractual sponsorship elements (matchday and non-matchday assets) are fulfilled/executed properly for assigned AFC Bournemouth partners.  
  • Lead on and update the activations central delivery documents which is shared with internal departments to outline contractual expectations for the season ahead. 
  • Hold meetings with other departmental managers and heads of department to ensure contracted sponsor assets are executed on time and accordingly.  
  • To activate, host and build client relationships on matchdays and non-matchdays – including The Net and club commercial events.  
  • Attend non-matchday/community events on behalf of the Club as needed to manage partner activation/involvement in those events.  
  • Serve as liaison with the Vitality Stadium operations team for all sponsorship-related topics.  
  • Be knowledgeable and trained in Salesforce.  
  • Produce monthly salesforce reports that will form part of a working group with the activations team which focuses on delivery of assets and sharing best practice. 
  • Attend contracted appearances, commercial shoots, etc. as needed at sponsor’s business, community service event and/or other specified locations.  
  • Track and report on partnership performance using metrics such as brand exposure, fan engagement and digital reach. 
  • Present inventory and data insights for assigned partner accounts at the start of the season, mid-season and end-of-season.  
  • Lead on the closed-season commercial re-branding document for the partnership programme. 
  • Drive and be responsible for developing and managing a strategic plan for all of our assigned accounts that are up for renewal/expiring.  
  • Coordinate internal creative meetings with other departments to develop innovative assets and ideas for your assigned sponsors.  
  • Bring new and compelling ideas to current partners whenever possible (i.e. - upsell opportunities). 
  • Develop and maintain excellent relationships and communication between the Partnerships department and other departments such as Brand & Design, Community Sports Trust, Marketing, Media, Operations, and Ticketing.  
  • Other duties as assigned from time to time.  
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club.  
  • As a member of staff to ensure that you to adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club.  
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures.
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club.  

  • Degree level education (preferred.  
  • At least three years’ experience in a similar role. 
  • Business-to-business sales and account management experience  
  • Leadership and people management capability. 
  • Exceptional communication, both on the phone and face-to-face.  
  • The ability to work as a member of a dynamic team but also able to work effectively on own initiative. 

  • Free onsite parking.
  • Season ticket and allocation of complimentary/purchased tickets (subject to availability).
  • Subsidised lunches and complimentary healthy snacks throughout the day.
  • Discounts at the club Superstore.
  • Access to Health Cash Plan with Simplyhealth.
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Contribution towards eye tests and glasses.
  • Discounts and benefits from partners and local businesses.
  • Club pension & Life Assurance Scheme.
  • Paid parental leave (bank of five days per year).
  • Club events or other social events throughout the year run by our club social team.
  • Paid volunteer opportunities (2 days per year).
  • Paid day’s leave on your birthday.

job.title: Brand Ambassadors - Marketing CLTFC
job.html_description:
Position:                                   Brand Ambassador - CLTFC
Department:                             Marketing
Reporting Relationship:          Reports to Marketing Activation Coordinator
Status:                                       Part-Time (Non-exempt)
 
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.
 
Position Summary
The Crown Crew serves as brand ambassadors for Charlotte FC at events around the Carolinas including community festivals, internal club events, and more. Additionally, throughout the MLS season, the Crown Crew will play a pivotal role in enriching the matchday experience for Charlotte FC. This position is within Charlotte FC’s Marketing Department where the team will be tasked with empowering and connecting with avid, casual, and new fans.  
 
Primary Responsibilities
  • Promote Charlotte FC at various events throughout the year, including fairs, festivals, sporting events, parades, and more.
  • Assist in the execution of matchday and non-matchday internal events.
  • Interact with avid, casual, and new fans to educate/inform the community of important Charlotte FC messages (specific promotions, ticket updates/offers, team information, etc.)
  • Responsible for setup and breakdown of events.
  • Create a fun, loud, and positive atmosphere at events by interacting with fans, distributing giveaways, and encouraging fans to support the team.
  • On-site support for execution of community and grassroots activations and Charlotte FC-led events.
  • Additional related duties as assigned.
 
Experience & Required Skills
  • Applicants must currently reside in the Carolinas, preferably near major metro areas or be willing to commute.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Outgoing and engaging personality
  • Knowledge of Major League Soccer, specifically Charlotte FC
  • Punctual, professional and mature demeanor
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and reliable transportation
  • Must be a team player
  • Spanish-speaking skills are a plus but not required
 
Work Environment and Physical Requirements
This position operates in a professional office environment and outside in a stadium facility.  Local travel to events may be required.  This position works no more than 30 hours per week. 
  • Must be able and willing to work in all Charlotte FC home matches.
  • Must be able and willing to work a minimum of one Crown Crew shift per month, including Charlotte FC home matches, grassroots activations and Charlotte FC-led events.
  • Must be able and willing to work non-traditional hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Must be able to lift and carry at least 50 lbs.
  • Ability to remain standing/walking for 8 to 10 hours.
  • Ability to climb stairs.
  • Ability to work both indoors and outdoors, and endure weather conditions, including rain, wind, high and low temperatures, etc.
 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

- Promote Charlotte FC at various events throughout the year, including fairs, festivals, sporting events, parades, and more. - Assist in the execution of matchday and non-matchday internal events. - Interact with avid, casual, and new fans to educate/inform the community of important Charlotte FC messages (specific promotions, ticket updates/offers, team information, etc.) - Responsible for setup and breakdown of events. - Create a fun, loud, and positive atmosphere at events by interacting with fans, distributing giveaways, and encouraging fans to support the team. - On-site support for execution of community and grassroots activations and Charlotte FC-led events. - Additional related duties as assigned.
Experience & Required Skills
- Applicants must currently reside in the Carolinas, preferably near major metro areas or be willing to commute. - Strong interpersonal and communication skills - Outgoing and engaging personality - Knowledge of Major League Soccer, specifically Charlotte FC - Punctual, professional and mature demeanor - Must have a valid driver’s license and reliable transportation - Must be a team player - Spanish-speaking skills are a plus but not required
Work Environment and Physical Requirements
This position operates in a professional office environment and outside in a stadium facility. Local travel to events may be required. This position works no more than 30 hours per week.
- Must be able and willing to work in all Charlotte FC home matches. - Must be able and willing to work a minimum of one Crown Crew shift per month, including Charlotte FC home matches, grassroots activations and Charlotte FC-led events. - Must be able and willing to work non-traditional hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed. - Must be able to lift and carry at least 50 lbs. - Ability to remain standing/walking for 8 to 10 hours. - Ability to climb stairs. - Ability to work both indoors and outdoors, and endure weather conditions, including rain, wind, high and low temperatures, etc.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Intern-Editorial Content
job.html_description:
Position:                                 Intern-Editorial Content CLTFC
Department:                         Digital Media
Reporting Relationship:    Reports to the Senior Director of Content/Head of Content
Status:                                     Intern/Full-Time
Duration:                                Temporary – 12 months
 
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.

Position Summary
Charlotte FC is actively seeking a creative and detail-oriented Editorial Content Intern to help enhance the team’s offerings from a written content standpoint. The Editorial Content Intern will report to the Senior Director of Content/Head of Content and will be responsible for providing comprehensive written coverage of both the first team and the academy throughout the season. This includes, but is not limited to, match previews, post-match reports, press conference articles and any live coverage required. This position will work closely with other departments, including Marketing, Partnerships and Communications. The position is based in Charlotte, NC.
 
Primary Responsibilities
  • Provide comprehensive written coverage of the first team, including all matchday coverage. 
  • Provide additional coverage for the academy team.
  • Write a minimum of four articles per week. 
  • Cover press conferences and other team-led events.
  • Create engaging editorial content that increases website views and click rate. 
  • Pitch and develop engaging story ideas.
  • Collaborate with marketing team on how to best produce content for site and app.
  • Website & app assistance with the Digital Platforms team, including but not limited to titling and posting of videos, photo albums, articles, SEO optimization, page building, etc.
  • Collaborate with social media team on how to best package articles for social distribution.
  • Collaborate with partnerships and communications leaders in meeting any sponsored obligations and shaping and bringing to life the Charlotte FC brand narrative.
  • Create and manage editorial content calendar.
  • Additional related duties as assigned.
 
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism or related field required.
  • At least 1 year experience writing or editing for a publication/website/etc.
  • Base level knowledge of the game of soccer/MLS.
  • Excellent writing skills and copywriting skills.
  • Some experience working in a CMS.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet strategic deadlines in a dynamic environment.
  • Experience ideating and pitching story ideas.
  • Experience conducting interviews. 
  • Must have a valid U.S. Driver’s license 
  • Must be flexible and available to work evenings and/or weekends, nights, and holidays.
  • Must pass pre-employment screens.
 
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working in the sports and/or entertainment industry.
  • Experience covering a sports team in any capacity. 
  • Strong knowledge of the game of soccer/MLS. 
  • Working knowledge within website content management systems – WordPress, Drupal, pocket, custom-coded CMS, etc.
 
Skills for Success
  • Strong work ethic and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve desired outcome.
  • Ability to communicate effectively using a variety of platforms with diverse audiences.
  • Must maintain complete confidentiality of privileged, and/or sensitive information.
  • The ability to prioritize workload to manage time and tasks.
 
Physical Requirements
  • Must be able to attend all home matches.
  • Sitting at desk and computer for long periods of time.
  • Standing for extended periods of time.
  • Must be able to lift 15 pounds at a time.
 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Coordinator - Digital Platforms CLTFC
job.html_description:
Position:                                   Digital Platforms Coordinator – CLTFC 
Department:                           Marketing
Reporting Relationship:      Reports to Senior Manager, Digital Platforms 
Status:                                       Full-Time (Exempt)    

About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.

Position Summary
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. Owned by David Tepper, Charlotte FC is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, including Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers.
Charlotte FC is looking for an experienced Digital Platforms Coordinator to manage key components of two of the Club's digital platforms, the website and mobile app. This role will collaborate closely with both the marketing & digital content teams and report to the Senior Manager of Digital Platforms. The primary goals of this role are to enhance user experiences on the web and app and support in improving key performance indicators (KPIs). The coordinator will focus on creating personalized journeys for fans to deepen their engagement with the brand, as well as contribute to developing, innovating, and optimizing fan experiences on these platforms.
 
Primary Responsibilities
·         Day-to-day support on Charlotte FC digital platforms – first team websites & app – including but not limited to posting videos, photo albums, articles, SEO optimization, page building, etc.
·         Work with the larger marketing team to ideate and integrate new platforms and products to enhance the user experience, increase fans’ overall knowledge, and open new revenue streams
·         Create lead generation forms and campaign landing pages with relevant tracking tags for source attribution
·         Support and execute sponsored activations and digital experiences for fan engagement across platforms
·         Provide detailed analytics and KPI reports on site performance, with recommended actions for several stakeholders for precise responses and improvement
·         Collaborate with partnerships to create sponsored and engaging features that enhance the brand to generate leads, and use the digital platforms to create custom user journeys for fans to become more engaged with the brand
·         Matchday web and app content management
·         Other duties as assigned by manager
 
Minimum Qualifications
·         BA/BS degree in marketing, business, or communications 
·         1-3 years’ experience running large-scale websites or apps for a professional organization (previous sports team experience is a plus, but not mandatory)  
·         Experience creating compelling digital experiences - on websites and mobile apps 
·         Knowledge of website back-end content management systems
·         Full understanding of the MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) 
·         Experience with page building and UI/UX best practices  
·         Must pass pre-employment screens
 
Preferred Qualifications
·         Proven experience using data-driven insights to understand what is working and what needs improvement within the digital space
·         Complete working knowledge within website content management systems – WordPress, Drupal, pocket, custom-coded CMS, Forge, etc.
·         Editorial or long-form exposure experience
·         Familiarity with the overall mobile app ecosystem and can optimize user experience on mobile app platforms
·         Experience within a fast-paced industry
 
Essential Functions
·         Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve the desired outcome
·         Self-starter with a hands-on approach, good instincts for prioritization, and the ability to work under a high-pressure, fast-paced environment
·         Strong analytical, project management, and communication skills
·         Agile and able to respond effectively to the rapidly changing needs of a fast-paced / high-growth organization
·         Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment
·         Must be able to handle confidential, privileged, and/or sensitive information with carefully and with sensitivity.
 
Physical Requirements
·         Ability to sit, walk, and stand for extended periods of time throughout the day.
·         Ability to focus on projects for periods of time.
·         Role routinely uses standard office equipment 
 
Work Environment
This job operates in a professional office environment (mostly office environment, outside in a stadium facility at times, which may include inclement weather conditions) and remotely as assigned by management and based on current business needs.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Manager-Marketing Activation & Events CLTFC
job.html_description:
Position:                                 Manager-Marketing Activation & Events, CLTFC
Department:                         Marketing
Reporting Relationship:    Reports to Head of Marketing, CLTFC
Status:                                     Full-Time (Exempt)
 
About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.
 
Position Summary
The Manager, Marketing Activation & Events, is a lead marketing role for Charlotte FC and a key member of the Club’s leadership team. The role oversees events, experiential marketing, influencer, and other targeted tactics designed to grow CLTFC awareness and fandom. Priorities include developing and executing comprehensive marketing activation strategies to strengthen the brand; fueling fandom and engagement through compelling campaigns; and capturing new potential fans through marketing tactics designed to meet potential fans where they are. This person thrives on building and maintaining strong working alliances with other leaders, internally and externally. The role requires constant communication with teammates in ticketing, partnerships, facility operations, community engagement, communications, and soccer operations, along with external vendors and partners to host and execute marketing activations and events. The Manager, Marketing Activation & Events, is naturally curious about what will take the CLTFC brand to the next level and is an expert collaborator with a history of breakthrough activations.
 
Primary Responsibilities
  • Lead the development of large-scale, club-owned brand events.
  • Work with the Ticketing team to execute Season Ticket Member appreciation programs and support the planning and delivery of other departmental events to ensure consistent brand representation. 
  • Manage the club-wide event calendar, including management of promotional items to support key dates and events.
  • Lead the strategy and planning for viewing parties, in collaboration with the Partnerships Marketing team.
  • Lead matchday fan experience marketing initiatives including pre-match/post-match activations and events, and gate giveaway planning and distribution in collaboration with the Partnerships Marketing team. 
  • Lead influencer campaigns and activations around our events and matches.
  • Serve as the central point of contact for the club-wide apparel ordering program.
  • Lead and manage a team of one coordinator and one intern to support department efforts.
  • Grow fan affinity & fan sentiment; Deliver talked about events & experiences across the enterprise both on gameday / match day and year-round. 
  • Evolve existing and create new products, services & benefits that fans value. 
  • Grow the brand regionally, nationally, and globally & ultimately become one of the most loved brands in sports. 
  • Work with internal clients to drive campaign performance from ideation to execution. 
  • Work alongside Head of Marketing and other Marketing leaders to develop comprehensive annual marketing strategies, including promotional calendars and media strategies with the ticket sales team that support campaigns, tell the brand story, and focus on call to action. 
  • Build experiential lead generation campaigns that drive ticket sales.
  • Establish and monitor staff performance, development goals and department priorities 
  • Partner with Community Outreach team to develop collaborative events and live engagement strategies. 
  • Other duties assigned as necessary. 

Qualifications, Skills and Education Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, sports, business management, communications, or related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of progressive experience in marketing activation, experiential marketing, events, or related fields.
  • 1 - 2 years+ direct managerial experience
  • Knowledge of soccer, professional soccer leagues, and MLS
  • Native Spanish language speaker (bilingual English + Spanish) strongly preferred
  • Sports & entertainment, property, or agency experience.
  • Collaborative Business Partner
 
Leadership, Work Ethic, and Culture
  • Strong leadership skills and business acumen.
  • Exhibits a team-oriented approach, always prioritizing team above self.
  • High energy leader with a strong work ethic and a desire to enhance the culture of the organization.
  • Demonstrates commitment to the organization’s vision, mission, and core values.
  • Projects a positive image as well as inspiring trust and credibility with stakeholders.
  • Embraces the start-up nature of the early brand stage of the organization.
  • Demonstrates ability to adapt and adjust to changing needs of the business while demonstrating a positive attitude.
 
Judgment, Decision-Making and Sense of Urgency
  • Demonstrates exceptional judgment in carrying out duties.
  • Demonstrates strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Able to clearly define complex issues; identifies and discusses potential solutions with key stakeholders; shapes opinions and works to build consensus as appropriate; uses broad knowledge and common sense.
  • Acts with purpose and urgency in making timely recommendations and decisions.
 
Communication
  • Communicates clearly and effectively; possesses excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Keeps leadership informed of important issues/aspects of the marketing performance.
  • Uses effective communication tactics regarding the manner of communication, tone, and channel in all circumstances.
  • Embraces an inclusive style of communication; actively listens and acknowledges conflicting points of view and treats all points of view with respect.
 
Work Environment
This job operates mostly in an office environment and outside in a stadium facility at times which may include inclement weather conditions.  This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.  Some travel may be required to away games or for other business purposes. 
 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Security Console Operators
job.html_description:
Position:                                 Security Console Operator
Department:                        Venue Operations – Security
Reporting Relationship:   Manager – Venue Security
Status:                                    Full Time (Non-Exempt)
 
Position Summary
The Security Console Operator is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of the venue’s physical infrastructure, assets, and access control systems. This role focuses on daily operational oversight of security technologies, procedures, and protocols to maintain a secure environment for guests, staff, and vendors. This position does not include supervisory responsibilities.
 
Primary Responsibilities 
  • Monitor and maintain physical security systems including surveillance cameras, access control, alarms, and perimeter protection.
  • Ensure regular inspections of doors, gates, locks, and other physical barriers to ensure integrity and functionality.
  • Ensure compliance with internal and external security protocols, standards, and regulations.
  • Respond to and investigate security incidents, breaches, or alarms, documenting findings and escalating as needed.
  • Respond in real time to emergency situations, including security breaches, alarms, and safety incidents.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot security equipment to ensure optimal performance and uptime.
  • Collaborate with venue operations and external security vendors to ensure alignment with safety protocols.
  • Document and report security incidents, system malfunctions, and maintenance activities.
  • Maintain accurate records of security activities, incident reports, and system maintenance logs.
  • Support credentialing and access control for events, contractors, and deliveries.
  • Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in physical security.
 
Minimum Qualifications
  • Associates or bachelor’s degree in criminal justice, security management, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in physical security, facilities protection, or a related role.

Position: Security Console Operator
Department: Venue Operations – Security
Reporting Relationship: Manager – Venue Security
Status: Full Time (Non-Exempt)
Position Summary
The Security Console Operator is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of the venue’s physical infrastructure, assets, and access control systems. This role focuses on daily operational oversight of security technologies, procedures, and protocols to maintain a secure environment for guests, staff, and vendors. This position does not include supervisory responsibilities.
Primary Responsibilities
- Monitor and maintain physical security systems including surveillance cameras, access control, alarms, and perimeter protection. - Ensure regular inspections of doors, gates, locks, and other physical barriers to ensure integrity and functionality. - Ensure compliance with internal and external security protocols, standards, and regulations. - Respond to and investigate security incidents, breaches, or alarms, documenting findings and escalating as needed. - Respond in real time to emergency situations, including security breaches, alarms, and safety incidents. - Maintain and troubleshoot security equipment to ensure optimal performance and uptime. - Collaborate with venue operations and external security vendors to ensure alignment with safety protocols. - Document and report security incidents, system malfunctions, and maintenance activities. - Maintain accurate records of security activities, incident reports, and system maintenance logs. - Support credentialing and access control for events, contractors, and deliveries. - Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in physical security.
Minimum Qualifications
- Associates or bachelor’s degree in criminal justice, security management, or equivalent experience. - 3+ years of experience in physical security, facilities protection, or a related role. - Familiarity with security systems such as CCTV, access control, and alarm monitoring. - Strong attention to detail and ability to identify vulnerabilities in physical infrastructure. - Excellent communication and documentation skills. - Ability to work independently and respond effectively under pressure.
Skills for Success
- Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. - Works well under pressure and is flexible when necessary. - Ability to adapt and adjust to changing needs of the business while maintaining a positive attitude. - Must possess excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Essential Functions
- Standing for extended periods of time. - Lift at least 30 pounds.
Work Environment(s)
- Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays as required for events and 24-hour security operations. - Position may require standing for long periods and responding to on-site security situations.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Account Executive – Membership Services CLTFC
job.html_description:
Position:                                  Account Executive – Membership Services CLTFC
Department:                          Ticket Sales & Services
Reporting Relationship:     Reports to Senior Manager - Membership Services
Status:                                      Full-Time (Non-Exempt)   
 
Summary
The Account Executive – Membership Services will be part of the team responsible for retaining and growing our PSL owner base through delivering first-class customer service, relationship building, and benefit development.
 
Primary Responsibilities
·         Deliver exceptional customer service to an assigned portfolio of PSL Owners by proactively communicating relevant team updates, events, benefits, and stadium information.
·         Lead PSL Owners through annual season ticket renewals and Silver Club extensions, consistently meeting or exceeding retention goals.
·         Maintain detailed and accurate customer records in CRM, documenting all interactions, touchpoints, and pertinent account information.
·         Proactively reach out to PSL Owners via phone, email, and SMS to share updates on exclusive experiences, request payments, and communicate operational or stadium changes.
·         Fulfill game day responsibilities including, but not limited to, in-seat visits, assisting with special promotions, addressing PSL Owner inquiries, and delivering Fan Packs.
·         Resolve event day ticketing and seating issues in collaboration with gameday operations staff.
·         Support PSL Owners and buyers in posting or securing tickets through league-approved secondary marketplaces.
·         Plan and execute retention-focused events and experiences that add value to the PSL Owner experience.
·         Provide customer service support for Bank of America Stadium events beyond game days, ensuring a seamless experience for all attendees.
·         Assist in the execution of ticketed team events including Draft Day, Training Camp, and other exclusive season ticket member experiences.
·         Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned by Ticketing leadership to support department objectives and enhance the overall member experience.
·         Other duties as assigned.
 
Additional Responsibilities
·         Committed to the support of Department goals and objectives in all areas
·         Represent the organization at various organizational networking and/or events in a professional manner
·         Involvement in game day activities, promotions, and sales events
·         Facilitate special projects as assigned
 
Minimum Qualifications
·         Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in the sports or hospitality service industry.
·         Prior sales/services experience in the sports or hospitality industry
·         Demonstrated ability in the areas of relationship building, communication, time management, and organization
·         Knowledge of accounts payable and billing
·         Must be able to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays, as necessary
·         Must pass pre-employment screens.
 
Preferred Qualifications
·         Working knowledge of Ticketmaster mobile ticketing and Archtics is preferred.
 
Skills for Success
·         Strength in teamwork, professionalism, and time management.
·         Must possess excellent oral, written, organizational and proofreading skills.
·         Must, at all times, display the character and values of the Tepper Sports and Entertainment brand.
·         Must be detail-oriented and must be able to multi-task while managing time successfully.
·         Works well under pressure and flexible when necessary.
·         Must be able to handle confidential, privileged, and/or sensitive information with carefully and with sensitivity.
·         Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve desired outcome.
·         Self-starter with a hands-on approach, good instincts for prioritization and the ability to work under a high-pressure, fast-paced environment.
 
Physical Requirements
·         Standing for extended periods of time.
·         Sitting and working at desk on a computer.
·         Walking throughout the stadium may include stairs.
·         Lift at least 30 pounds.
 
Work Environment
·         This job operates mostly in an office environment and outside in a stadium facility at times which may include inclement weather conditions.
 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Associate - Media Relations - CLTFC
job.html_description:
Position:                                    Associate – Media Relations CLTFC
Department:                            Communications
Reporting Relationship:       Reports to the Senior Coordinator - Communications
Status:                                       Seasonal/Part-Time (Non-Exempt)

About Charlotte FC
Charlotte Football Club is the Major League Soccer Club in the Carolinas. The Club’s mission is to be a unifying force that is bigger than one city and encourage a sense of belonging through a progressive, collective, and ambitious approach that guides efforts on and off the pitch. CLTFC is committed to driving growth through the sport and community outreach. Charlotte FC is owned by David Tepper and is a part of Tepper Sports & Entertainment, which also includes Bank of America Stadium and the Carolina Panthers. For more information, visit CharlotteFootballClub.com.

Job Summary
The Associate - Media Relations works as Matchday Event Staff assisting the communications department in all aspects of matchdays, which includes press box management, photo marshaling, media will call, and other duties.

Primary Responsibilities:
• Assist in distributing, managing, and logging credentials to all media attending Charlotte FC home games.
• Assist in providing media relations support for all Charlotte FC home games.
• Assist in setup, teardown, and management of media operations spaces, including press conference room, press box, field photography areas and photo work room.
• Assist in post-match press syndications and transcriptions.
• Assist with other duties as needed.

Qualifications and Education Requirements:
• Prior internships, volunteer work, or any work experience in Public Relations, Communications, Sport Management or related field is preferred.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to establish effective working relationships with a variety of media contacts.
• Must be available to work during evenings, weekends, and holidays when necessary.

Essential Functions:
• Ability to meet the physical demands of the job which include lifting (up to 25 lbs.), standing, stooping, and walking for an extended period of time.
• Ability to work indoors and in outdoor stadium environments which may include inclement weather.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Community Relations & Foundation Intern
job.html_description:
There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC. 
 
As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities. 
 
Chicago Fire FC is becoming a cultural force in Chicago by connecting communities, shaping experiences, and creating new ways for fans to engage with the game and the city. The Club's future home, McDonald’s Park, will anchor Chicago's newest neighborhood and serve as a catalyst of growth for the next chapter of professional sports and entertainment in the city. 
 
Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special.  
 
At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle. 
 
Position Overview:
Chicago Fire FC is seeking a Community Relations / Chicago Fire Foundation Intern! This role, reporting to the Director, Community Relations, will support the planning and implementation of Chicago Fire Foundation programs and community development initiatives. This internship will run from September through December.

Job Responsibilities:
  • Assist in coordination of game day 50-50 raffle program
  • Assist in development and execution of present and future community relations programs
  • Assist with operational execution of the Foundation's proprietary P.L.A.Y.S. program including all logistics, securing new school and equipment, and program scheduling
  • Assist with Foundation marquee fundraisers including Marathon Charity Team, Locker Room Sale, Season Kickoff Luncheon, and others
  • Organize monthly autograph sessions and send out donation requests
  • Assist with administrative tasks, participant surveys and tracking, recaps, and grant writing
  • Other duties as assigned by Manager

Required Qualifications:
  •  Previous community service experience or heart to serve others
  •  Self-starter with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Ability to work autonomously and use excellent judgment in escalating issues to supervisors
  • Proven ability to work on simultaneous projects while maintaining attention to detail
  • Willingness to learn in a fast-paced, high-performing work environment
  •  Knowledgeable of the Chicagoland Area
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including nights and weekends when needed

Compensation:
  • This role offers a rate of $17.05 per hour

Please Note:
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club.
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.
  •  If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Manager, Accounting
job.html_description:
The Chicago Fire Football Club (Chicago Fire FC) is an American professional soccer club that competes in Major League Soccer (MLS), the top U.S. domestic league. Founded on October 8, 1997, on the 126th anniversary of the Great Chicago Fire, the Club began play in 1998 as one of the League’s first expansion franchises. The Fire have won six major domestic titles, including the 1998 MLS Cup; the 1998, 2000, 2003, and 2006 Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cups; as well as the 2003 MLS Supporters’ Shield.

The Club recently announced plans to build a $750M+ privately financed downtown stadium in Chicago in 2028. The stadium will anchor Chicago’s newest neighborhood, the 78, a 62-acre development and entertainment district located along the Chicago River just south of Roosevelt Road. For more information on our bold plans, visit DearChicago.com.

Additionally, the Club recently opened the state-of-the-art $100M Endeavor Health Performance Center in March 2025 that has set the standard for North American training facilities. With tremendous growth and expansion, the Club is laying the foundation for an audacious and ambitious vision that will transform the brand and the company in the coming years.

At Chicago Fire FC, we’re on a mission to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago by delivering excellence on and off the pitch to ensure a world-class experience. As a club we let our values guide everything we do: we uphold uncompromising integrity, show respect for all at all times, never settle for less, constantly innovate, and hold ourselves relentlessly accountable.

Position Overview:
The Accounting Manager will be a key member of the Finance and Accounting team and be responsible for the execution of the accounting functions and operations for Chicago Fire Football Holdings, LLC, its various subsidiaries and related not-for-profit entities. They will take the lead in review and close procedures for monthly and annual closes, oversee the accounts payable and accounts receivable processes and be heavily involved in annual audits and tax preparation.

This role will report directly to the Controller and be responsible for managing a Staff Accountant. The right candidate is personable, diligent, and effective at finding solutions and is an outstanding communicator.
 
Job Responsibilities:
  • Lead the month end close process by efficiently assigning and reviewing work and providing hands on preparation/review of the financial statement consolidation
  • Responsible for the scheduling and supervision of day-to-day duties of a staff accountant, as well as assessing and conducting annual performance reviews, quarterly performance check-ins and providing coaching and mentoring to accounting staff as needed
  • Ensures proper revenue and expense recognition
  • Responsible for the review and approval of adjusting and general journal entries before posting to the general and subsidiary ledger accounts
  • Responsible for the analysis of balance sheet accounts and related account reconciliations
  • Work with accounting staff and department stakeholders to manage open accruals

job.plain_text_description:
The Chicago Fire Football Club (Chicago Fire FC) is an American professional soccer club that competes in Major League Soccer (MLS), the top U.S. domestic league. Founded on October 8, 1997, on the 126th anniversary of the Great Chicago Fire, the Club began play in 1998 as one of the League’s first expansion franchises. The Fire have won six major domestic titles, including the 1998 MLS Cup; the 1998, 2000, 2003, and 2006 Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cups; as well as the 2003 MLS Supporters’ Shield.
The Club recently announced plans to build a $750M+ privately financed downtown stadium in Chicago in 2028. The stadium will anchor Chicago’s newest neighborhood, the 78, a 62-acre development and entertainment district located along the Chicago River just south of Roosevelt Road. For more information on our bold plans, visit DearChicago.com.
Additionally, the Club recently opened the state-of-the-art $100M Endeavor Health Performance Center in March 2025 that has set the standard for North American training facilities. With tremendous growth and expansion, the Club is laying the foundation for an audacious and ambitious vision that will transform the brand and the company in the coming years.
At Chicago Fire FC, we’re on a mission to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago by delivering excellence on and off the pitch to ensure a world-class experience. As a club we let our values guide everything we do: we uphold uncompromising integrity, show respect for all at all times, never settle for less, constantly innovate, and hold ourselves relentlessly accountable.

job.title: Director, Ticket Operations
job.html_description:
There has never been a more exciting time to join Chicago Fire FC.

As one of Major League Soccer's original clubs, Chicago Fire FC is in the midst of an exciting era fueled by tremendous investment, ambition, and growth. With a new $100M state-of-the-art Endeavor Health Performance Center now open, new offices in Chicago's iconic Wrigley Building, and plans underway for a privately-funded $750M+ soccer-specific stadium set to open in 2028 in the heart of Chicago, the Club is building the future of soccer in one of the world's great sports cities.

Chicago Fire FC is becoming a cultural force in Chicago by connecting communities, shaping experiences, and creating new ways for fans to engage with the game and the city. The Club's future home, McDonald’s Park, will anchor Chicago's newest neighborhood and serve as a catalyst of growth for the next chapter of professional sports and entertainment in the city.

Joining Chicago Fire FC today means joining an organization on the rise. Our growth creates once-in-a-lifetime opportunities for ambitious professionals to generate meaningful impact and help shape the future of our Club. Whether on the pitch working match day or in the front office, every team member plays a role in building something incredibly special. 

At Chicago Fire FC, our mission is to entertain, serve, and unite Chicago through world-class experiences and a relentless pursuit of excellence. We are guided by our core values: Integrity, Respect, Innovation, Accountability, and a commitment to Never Settle.

If you're looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be heard, and your career can grow alongside one of the most ambitious projects in professional sports, we'd love to hear from you.

 
Position Overview
The Director of Ticket Operations will lead Chicago Fire FC’s ticketing operations, systems, inventory strategy, reporting, financial controls, box office operations, and event execution.

Reporting to the Chief Ticketing Officer, this leader will oversee the Club’s ticketing ecosystem, partner closely across Revenue and key business functions, and help build the operational foundation for McDonald’s Park.

This is a unique opportunity to lead a major ticketing transformation - delivering seamless operations today through Ticketmaster Archtics while guiding the transition to SeatGeek Unify and preparing for the Club’s new stadium in 2028.

Success in this role means delivering best-in-class ticket operations today while helping build one of the most modern and scalable ticketing operations in professional sports.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Lead the Ticket Operations Function
  • Lead the Club's Ticket Operations department, overseeing all ticketing operations, systems, policies, and event execution. 
  • Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Ticket Operations team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
  • Partner closely with the Chief Ticketing Officer, Vice President of Ticket Sales, Service & Operations, and Vice President of McDonald's Park Sales & Service to align operational priorities with the Club's evolving business objectives. 
 
Own the Club's Ticketing Ecosystem
  • Serve as the operational owner of the Club's ticketing platforms, leading Ticketmaster Archtics today while guiding the successful transition to SeatGeek Unify. 
  • Oversee event builds, manifests, inventory architecture, pricing configuration, payment plans, promotions, user permissions, and system governance across all events. 
  • Partner with Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, and third-party technology providers to implement enhancements, integrations, and operational improvements that increase efficiency and scalability. 
 
Drive Revenue Through Operational Excellence
  • Manage ticket inventory, financial controls, operational reporting, and League reporting while partnering with Revenue leadership to maximize ticket revenue and inventory utilization. 
  • Partner with Finance on reconciliations, settlements, payment plans, taxes, and account compliance. 
  • Develop reporting and operational insights that enable informed business decisions and support organizational performance. 
 
Deliver World-Class Event Operations
  • Lead ticket operations and box office execution for all Chicago Fire matches and Club-supported events. 
  • Serve as the senior operational contact for complex ticketing issues while partnering with Stadium Operations, Guest Experience, Security, venue partners, and promoters to deliver an exceptional fan experience. 
  • Develop scalable operating procedures, staffing models, and service standards that support MLS matches, concerts, international events, and future programming. 
 
Build the Future
  • Lead the operational planning and implementation of the Club's ticketing strategy for McDonald's Park, including systems, workflows, staffing, and operational readiness. 
  • Lead cross-functional projects involving multiple business units, vendors, and technology platforms while balancing long-term strategic initiatives with flawless day-to-day execution. 
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies, industry best practices, and process improvements to ensure Chicago Fire FC remains at the forefront of ticketing operations. 
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.
 
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree required. 
  • 6+ years of progressive ticket operations experience within professional sports, live entertainment, venue management, or a comparable industry. 
  • Demonstrated success leading a Ticket Operations department or comparable operational function in a high-volume environment. 
  • Deep expertise with Ticketmaster Archtics required; experience with SeatGeek Unify or another enterprise ticketing platform is a plus. 
  • Proven experience managing ticket inventory, event configuration, financial reconciliation, reporting, and box office operations. 
  • Experience leading complex operational initiatives such as ticketing platform implementations, venue openings, or enterprise technology projects preferred. 
  • Strong understanding of how ticket operations supports revenue strategy, premium seating, memberships, and the overall fan experience. 
  • Exceptional project management, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.  Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex priorities simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and consistently meeting critical deadlines. 
  • Proven ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and make thoughtful decisions in a fast-paced, evolving environment with minimal direction. 
  • Collaborative leadership style with a proven ability to influence, build consensus, and establish trusted relationships across Revenue, Finance, Marketing, Stadium Operations, Technology, and external partners. 
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience leveraging data to drive operational and business decisions. 
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and event days.
 
Compensation:
  • This role offers a salary range of $90,000.00-125,000.00 Final salary is determined by carefully considering the applicant's background, experience, and qualifications. Base pay may vary significantly based on geographic location, job-specific knowledge, skills, and overall experience. This role is classified as Full-time, exempt
  • This role is bonus eligible based on club-wide goals
  • Additional benefits & perks: Official Chicago Fire FC Website
 
Please note:
  • Chicago Fire FC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion. Our diversity initiatives start with the recruitment and selection process; therefore, we’d like to welcome all diverse candidates to apply to opportunities within our Club. 
  • CFFC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and maintaining a workplace for employees and applicants for employment that is free from discrimination.   The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, sexual orientation, sexual orientation or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, termination, and access to benefits and training.  

  •  If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at peopleandculture@chicagofirefc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

  • By clicking apply, you agree to the terms of the MLS Privacy Policy.
