job.title: Emerging Talent Scout (MCWFC)
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this Academy-focused role will help build Manchester City Women's talent-ID function from the ground up. Working across live scouting, video analysis and market intelligence, you will identify and track emerging players who can strengthen the Academy pathway and support the long-term future of the first team.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City Women is a team driven by ambition, belief and a desire to keep pushing the game forward. Founded in 1988 and relaunched in 2014, we have grown into a consistent force in the women's game, competing at the highest level in the UK and Europe. Progress, performance and pride sit at the heart of everything we do. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are building what comes next, the City way.

 

Within Manchester City Women Football Performance, our Academy recruitment work plays an important part in building the next generation of players. This new role will help establish the talent-ID function from the ground up, creating the systems, coverage and reporting that support informed decisions across the Academy and wider pathway.

 

The Role

 

Manchester City Women are continuing to invest in and grow our Scouting and Recruitment structure as we build a world-class, connected talent-identification function.

 

We are seeking an Emerging Talent Scout to play a central role in identifying and developing the next generation of players for Manchester City Women. Working across priority UK and international markets, the role will support Academy recruitment, the Next-Gen programme and future First Team planning.

 

This is an opportunity to help create clear, ambitious pathways for high-potential young talent, from Academy football into Next-Gen, loan opportunities and, ultimately, the First Team environment. The successful candidate will combine outstanding player identification and projection skills with a strong understanding of player development, market intelligence and long-term squad building.

 

Working closely with colleagues across Academy, Next-Gen, First Team, performance and analysis, you will help ensure that Manchester City Women continues to identify, recruit and develop the best young players in the UK and around the world.

 

What You'll Bring

 

⚽ Experience in talent identification, player development analysis or recruitment within professional football.

⚽ Ability to project player development and distinguish current performance from future upside.

⚽ Knowledge of academy, youth or emerging-player markets, preferably within women's football.

⚽ Clear and effective written communication skills, with confidence producing evidence-based reports and recommendations.

⚽ Excellent organisation and attention to detail when managing watchlists, longlists and scouting records.

⚽ Ability to work collaboratively with coaches, analysts and sporting staff, and willingness to travel extensively, including internationally where relevant.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City Women means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days' annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by Sunday 6 September 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

This role involves working with children and/or vulnerable adults in regulated activity, so a relevant suitability check will be required and kept under regular review.

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

job.title: Part Qualified Management Accountant
job.html_description:
Based at City Football Academy in Manchester, this permanent full-time role is an important part of City Football Group’s Finance function. You will help prepare accurate and timely management accounts, support financial reporting and analysis, and contribute to robust controls and continuous improvement across the wider finance operation.

 

Who We Are

 

Founded in 2013, City Football Group is the world’s leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with teams across the globe connected by a shared belief in doing things differently. Alongside our clubs, we invest in football-related businesses and build partnerships that help the game, and the communities around it, thrive. Everything we do is guided by our purpose: empowering better lives through football. Rooted in more than a century of “City” football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.

 

Within our Finance team, we support City Football Group through clear reporting, careful control and practical financial insight. Our work helps the business understand performance, strengthen decision-making and maintain confidence in the integrity of financial information across the organisation.

 

The Role

 

This role sits within a team of Management Accountants and plays a key part in preparing the monthly management accounts, commentary and supporting analysis. You will help ensure reporting is accurate and timely, with a clear focus on data integrity, balance sheet reconciliations and the smooth running of core finance processes.

 

You will also provide management accounting support to the wider Finance department, including financial analysis to support decision-making and assistance during audit activity. Alongside the day-to-day cycle, you will look for ways to improve the management accounts process, strengthen internal controls and support the ongoing optimisation of the Group’s finance system.

 

Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you will build trusted relationships, respond to requests with clarity and contribute to ad hoc projects when needed. This is a role where care, consistency and collaboration all matter, and where your work will help keep the finance function accurate, reliable and well connected.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • Experience in management accounting, financial reporting or a similar finance role
  • Ability to present financial information clearly and effectively to a range of stakeholders
  • Analytical skills and the ability to understand and resolve complex issues
  • Commercial awareness and an interest in how organisations operate and use resources
  • Comfortable working in a busy environment and adapting to changing priorities
  • Confident use of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

job.title: People Programme and Project Manager
job.html_description:
We are looking for a People Programme and Project Manager to coordinate and drive delivery across our strategic People agenda. Based in Manchester working in a hybrid working pattern, this fixed-term role runs until October 2027. You will join an established programme environment, keeping priorities connected, visible and moving forward through effective programme coordination, governance and stakeholder management.

 

Who We Are

 

Founded in 2013, City Football Group is the world’s leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with a shared purpose of empowering better lives through football.

 

Our People Team plays a critical role in creating the environment, experiences and capabilities that enable our people and organisation to perform at their best. This role sits within People Services and Transformation and supports the coordinated delivery of strategic change across the People function.

 

The Role

 

As People Programme and Project Manager, you will coordinate the People Programme, the People function’s central governance and delivery mechanism for strategic change. Our Project Management methodology brings together four outcome-led portfolios through a single roadmap, ensuring initiatives are prioritised, sequenced, governed and progressed through the agreed approach.

 

You will also coordinate the People Experience and Culture portfolio, keeping activity across employee experience, engagement, lifecycle, products and strategic initiatives connected and visible. Working closely with the Director of People Services and Transformation, you will maintain programme plans, reporting, risks and dependencies, support prioritisation and stage-gate reviews, and ensure delivery issues are identified and escalated appropriately.

 

Alongside the portfolio coordination, you will programme manage the employee experience and engagement programme and project manage agreed People Services initiatives. The emphasis is on driving momentum within an established programme environment: connecting stakeholders, maintaining high-quality programme information, coordinating milestones and dependencies, and helping strategic priorities translate into practical delivery.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • Experience coordinating programmes, portfolios, projects or strategic initiatives, ideally within an established PMO, programme or portfolio environment.

  • Excellent organisational and planning capability, with the ability to coordinate multiple priorities, milestones and workstreams while maintaining delivery momentum.

  • Experience maintaining programme governance, reporting, plans, documentation, risks, actions and dependencies to provide clear visibility of progress.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to coordinate activity across multiple teams and prepare clear reports, presentations and governance papers.

  • The ability to identify dependencies, risks and delivery issues, bring structure to complex or ambiguous activity and support practical resolution.

  • A delivery-focused and detail-conscious approach, balancing appropriate governance with pace and practicality.

  • Demonstratable understanding of a people function and working with people focused PMO. 

 

Why Choose Us

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

Please submit your application through our careers site by 2 September 2026.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: 1st Team Physical Performance Coach (MCWFC)
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester at the City Football Academy, this permanent full-time role supports the physical performance of Manchester City Women’s 1st Team through evidence-informed, pitch-based strength and conditioning support. You will help players prepare, perform, recover and progress across a demanding season and multiple competitions, working closely with coaches, players and the wider multidisciplinary team to create meaningful physical impact on and off the pitch.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City Women is a team driven by ambition, belief and a desire to keep pushing the game forward. Founded in 1988 and relaunched in 2014, we have grown into a consistent force in the women’s game, competing at the highest level in the UK and Europe. Progress, performance and pride sit at the heart of everything we do. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are building what comes next, the City way.

 

Within our Performance Services team, we create engaging performance environments that support players and teams to fulfil their potential. The Physical Performance team works collaboratively across coaching, medical and performance disciplines to help players develop the physical qualities, resilience and readiness needed to perform with high skill and intensity.

 

The Role

 

This role plays an important part in supporting 1st Team performance outcomes for Manchester City Women. You will plan, deliver and review evidence-informed physical development programmes that support individual player progression, group performance and the wider MCWFC Performance Services strategy.

 

Day to day, you will work across on-pitch and off-pitch strength and conditioning delivery, helping to design training practices and schedules that support agreed physical outputs and positional demands. You will contribute to physical profiling, monitoring systems, recovery and regeneration interventions, injury rehabilitation and return-to-performance support, using data and insight to inform clear, practical recommendations.

 

Working as part of the Physical Performance team and wider multidisciplinary team, you will build effective relationships with players, coaches and performance staff. You will also support matchday preparation where required and contribute to projects, professional development and continuous improvement that help the department keep evolving.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ A BSc and recognised postgraduate qualification in Sport Science, Strength and Conditioning, or a related area.

⚽ UKSCA accreditation, or an equivalent professional accreditation, alongside a current first aid qualification.

⚽ Experience working in an elite sporting environment and contributing effectively within an interdisciplinary team.

⚽ Experience developing and delivering physical development programmes that support measurable performance outcomes.

⚽ Ability to build positive working relationships with players, coaches and multidisciplinary colleagues.

⚽ Skilled in using performance-related data to inform practice, reflect on current approaches and adapt when needed.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City Women means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 6 September 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group is committed to achieving workforce diversity and we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, national origin, race, age, sex, gender identity, disability - physical or hidden, sexual orientation, veteran status, religious belief, or any other characteristics protected by law. We strive to provide a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage all applicants to reach out if they require any support or accommodations to enable them to thrive throughout our recruitment process. Please contact Hiring@cityfootball.com.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: 2025 Marketing Matchday Activation Intern
job.html_description:
Columbus Crew Job Opportunity



Description

Do you have a passion for marketing, promotions, and fan development? The Columbus Crew is looking for outgoing and engaging college students to serve as Marketing Matchday Activation interns for the 2025 MLS season. This position provides a variety of sports-marketing related learning experiences, specifically in event production and fan experience.

 

Opportunities & Responsibilities
  • Execute matchday activations including coordinating with on-site vendors, placing banners, setting up tents, tables, and running supporter engagement stations
  • Demonstrate and maintain Crew brand standards while serving as an ambassador of the brand
  • Assist in executing in-match experiences, halftime contests and pre/post-match activations
  • Provide a fun, entertaining and positive experience by interacting and engaging with Lower.com Field guests
  • Promote the Crew by creating a positive and exciting atmosphere while interacting with guests, sponsors, and supporters
  • Assist guests with various Matchday elements
  • Assist with additional Crew grassroots and marketing events as needed

 

Required skills, experience & abilities
  • Available for the entire 2025 MLS Season
  • Max of 20 hours per match week paid hourly
  • Must be a minimum of 18 years of age and an active student or recent graduate of a college or university program
  • Ability to attend ALL regular and post-season Crew home matches, including evening and weekend assignments
  • Must be able to lift and maneuver a minimum of 50 pounds
  • Must be able to climb ladders, carry, walk, sit, push, pull and move continuously during work hours
  • Must be able to work outdoors in varying weather conditions
  • Ability to communicate effectively with a diverse population, including strong verbal communication skills. Customer service experience a plus
  • Able to work independently and with a team
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays

The Columbus Crew is pursuing to hire an enthusiastic seasonal grounds member for the 2026 MLS season to provide hands-on experience in a diverse professional sporting environment.   • Aid in all aspects of field maintenance at all three field sites
  • Exposure to agronomic practices, planning, and implementation

  • Assist in grounds operations for Crew home matches

job.title: Manager, Performance & Player Development - Crew 2 & Academy
job.html_description:
Overview
Columbus Crew is searching for an energetic and passionate individual for a Manager of Performance, Player Development full time role. This exciting opportunity embeds the individual into the day-to-day programming of our player development pathway. The Crew is invested in the individual development of each athlete within our player pathway. This role will be vital in ensuring the maximization of their potential through the physical performance aspect of their profile. This individual should be motivated by the development of young players and be driven to contribute to their athletic journey.

Responsibilities:
  • Player Development & Leadership:
    • Lead the performance space within three main areas: emerging talents, second team and academy teams.
    • Implement and deliver plans for physical development of youth players within the club.
    • Manage the appropriate execution of the physical component of player development plans across all levels of the club.
    • Create and deliver reports on the physical component of player development across all levels of the club.
    • Establish age specific and science-based physical benchmarks to drive programs.
    • Create and maintain performance testing battery and schedule.
  • Coaches & Meetings:
    • Attend meetings with medical and performance staffs across all levels of the club.
    • Attend meetings with Crew2/Academy coaching staffs as needed.
    • Create and maintain regular meeting schedule to discuss progress of emerging talents throughout all levels of the club.
    • Act as the Performance Lead in the Emerging Talents Workgroup. 
  • On Field Coaching:
    • On field priority focus will be in attending the IDP and IDP+ sessions.
    • Establish cadence for attending first team, Crew 2, and Academy training sessions and/or matches.
    • Provide cross coverage of Crew 2 and Academy teams as needed (i.e. run warm up, RTP, or gym sessions).
  • Load Management & Injury Prevention:
    • Lead development of periodization and programming for emerging talents.
    • Work closely with Crew 2/Academy performance staff in load management and injury prevention.
    • Ensure all information is aligned within One Club philosophy.
  • Administrative:
    • Maintain appropriate reports that detail plans and progressions for player development.
    • Establish cadence for reporting on emerging talents progress physical development.
  • Return to Play Programming:
    • Ensure Crew 2/Academy performance staff have built appropriate RTP.
  • Leadership:
    • Provide leadership to Crew 2/Academy performance staff.
    • Provide support for Crew 2/Academy performance staff in day to day operations.
  • Pre-Season & Away Games:
    • Work closely with Crew 2/Academy performance staff to establish appropriate preseason physical periodization.
    • Attend preseason trips with Crew 2 as necessary and required.
    • Create a travel schedule for Crew 2/Academy away games and tournaments that fosters leadership, evaluation and support of Crew 2/performance staff.
  • Technology Platforms:
    • Use club's technology platforms to analyze physical development of emerging talents across all levels of the club.
    • Prepare individual physical development programs with second team and academy performance staff for players based off of data collected on these platforms.
  • Community:
    • Interact with local soccer community.
    • Making public appearances and participating in promotional and sponsorship activities on behalf of the Team (and its sponsors) as are reasonable in Employee's position as Manager, Performance (Player Development) without additional compensation.
    • Involve players with the community outreach activities.
  • Other Duties:
    • Performing such other duties reasonably consistent with Employee's employment as Fitness Coach that may from time to time be reasonably determined by the Director of Sports Science and/or club leadership.

Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited College/University in Exercise Science, Kinesiology, Physical Education, or related field (required).
  • Master's degree in Exercise Science, Kinesiology, Physical Education or related field (preferred).
  • Minimum of three (3) years' experience in working with and developing elite level youth athletes (required).
  • Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS) by the NSCA, UKSCA, or ASCA or equivalent internationally recognized Strength and Conditioning certification (required).
  • Certified Performance and Sports Scientist (CPSS) by NSCA (preferred).
  • First Aid and CPR certified.
  • Previous experience working as a part of a multi-disciplinary team.
  • Experience in utilizing sports science technologies and athlete management systems such as: STATSports, Vald Performance, Kitman Labs, etc.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to quickly build trust and relationships with players and staff.
  • Fluency in multiple languages would be considered an asset.
  • Extensive computer knowledge, including MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, OneNote, Zoom.
  • An ongoing awareness and responsiveness to client satisfaction.
  • A high level of accuracy, attention to detail and confidentiality, 
  • Proven ability to listen, understand and communicate effectively. 
  • Proven to perform well under pressure, manage multiple priorities simultaneously within a highly dynamic environment.
  • Accepting direction while also displaying a high level of initiative.
  • Ability to grasp new concepts quickly and comfortable and capable in meeting deadlines.
  • On call availability and flexibility and willingness to work evenings, weekends and holidays with ability to travel when necessary.
  • A positive, winning attitude, incorporating integrity and discretion.
  • A strong understanding of growth and maturation & pediatric exercise

job.title: Scoreboard Operations Intern
job.html_description:

The Columbus Crew are looking for a qualified, highly motivated intern to join the Scoreboard Operations staff for the 2026-2027 MLS seasons. This position will assist with motion graphic animation, video editing, system engineering and event production. Candidates must be organized, quick-learners, self-starters and able to work under strict deadlines.

Opportunities & Responsibilities
• Video editing
• Motion graphic animation
• Logging video footage
• Daktronics content loading
• Support day-to-day needs of production team
• Stadium event production
• Administrative duties
• Work cross functionally, collaborating with the Marketing Department among others

• Knowledge of video editing principles (Adobe Premiere Pro).
• Knowledge of Adobe After Effects and Adobe Photoshop.
• Experience with motion graphics, design, and 2D/3D animation.
• Exceptional time management and organizational skills, with the ability to multi-task.
• Outstanding communication skills.
• Ability and willingness to work non-traditional hours (including nights, weekends and holidays).
• Ability to attend all Crew home matches, including evening and weekend assignments.
• Able to work independently and take initiative.
• Ability to communicate effectively with a diverse population, including strong verbal communication skills.
• Sports and entertainment industry experience a plus.

job.title: Director, Guest Experience
job.html_description:
Description
Columbus Crew is seeking a Director, Guest Experience that will be responsible for all guests and team members receiving world class experience when visiting all venues operated by the Columbus Crew. Under the direction of the Vice President, Operations, the Director oversees the day-to-day and event operations of the Guest Experience department ensuring the safety and comfort for all through strong training programs, policies, and procedures.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Guest Experience
    • Responsible for all Guest Experience operations across all Club facilities and events; including but not limited to Columbus Crew matches, future Columbus NWSL matches, concerts, third-party events, etc.
    • Lead an informed, motivated, and energetic staff and maintain a consistent focus on curating a best-in-class experience throughout every Club and third-party event.
    • Maintain cross-departmental connection to ensure the Guest Experience staff and general processes are supporting and enhancing broader club focuses and initiatives
    • Monitor all channels of guest communication (email, telephone, in-person, guest survey, and social media). Provide reports, identify trends and institute operational improvements. 
    • Ensure that guest information channels always have the appropriate information (Stadium Maps, Know Before You Go, Columbus Crew social media accounts and Columbus Crew website).
    • Collaborate with Safety and Security leadership to maintain emergency preparedness and have a working knowledge of all applicable safety regulations and security procedures for Columbus Crew Venues
  • Recruitment and Training
    • Develop department training and staffing plan based on service strategy, event budget and staffing matrix in collaboration with Vice President, Operations. Identify appropriate staffing levels, recruitment processes, and desired target areas to maintain the highest level of retention and service. 
    • Develop and conduct an effective and efficient recruiting, interviewing and onboarding program
    • Develop, maintain, and facilitate (as appropriate) department new hire and veteran training programs, create specialty training programs for supervisors, specialty positions and team member development opportunities. Maintain a strong presence with the service department management and frontline team members. 
  • Team Member Management
    • Create and consistently emphasize a service strategy to empower team members to provide world class service and meet organizational goals. 
    • Foster a fun and fulfilling work environment for team members.
    • Oversee scheduling and payroll on a weekly basis.
    • Create and implement staff incentive programs.
  • Effectively communicate with frontline team members to establish policies, procedures, standards, expectations, goals, and objectives.
  • Ensure fair, consistent, and timely enforcement of policies and procedures (including tracking call-offs, no-shows and overall attendance)
  • Conduct ongoing performance coaching and evaluation, identifying growth opportunities.
 
Required Skills and Experience
  • Minimum of 3 -5 years leadership experience managing teams of PT frontline event staff. Preferably, in a public assembly facility.
  • Minimum four-year college degree or equivalent experience.
  • Exceptional customer service and leadership skills, including but not limited to de-escalation, service recovery, coaching, people management, recruitment, training, and the ability to motivate a diverse workforce. 
  • Must possess strong problem solving, analysis and communication skills, both written and oral. 
  • Extremely organized, detail-orientated and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Must be able to create and deliver informative and engaging presentations to large groups of people.
  • Ability to read, interpret, update, and create training programs utilizing documents such as strategy documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance guides, application instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Familiarity with payroll and scheduling systems 
  • Clear understanding and implementation of all department and company policies and procedures
  • Must be available on varied schedules including nights, weekends, and holidays. 
  • Ability to walk, stand, and climb stairs and ramps during entire shift (8 – 12 hours)
  • Ability and willingness to work outdoors in elements for entire shift (8 – 12 hours)
  • Ability to lift, carry, and transport large boxes and items in excess of 25 lbs.
  • Ability to work long and irregular hours including nights, weekends, holidays, events including but not limited to soccer, football, concerts and private events.

job.title: Account Executive, Season Ticket Sales
job.html_description:
Position Summary: 
Columbus Crew is seeking a driven and self-motivated Account Executive, Season Ticket Sales committed to growing his/her career in the sports industry. This person will be a member of the Ticket Sales team, responsible for leading new business generation efforts across all ticketing products. The Account Executive will be responsible for selling a full menu of season tickets, premium hospitality packages, group tickets and partial season plans for the Columbus Crew. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 
  • Prospect, establish, research and close ticket sales leads through cold-calling, in-person appointments and networking
  • Conduct a high volume of in person sales meetings, including stadium tours, to close new business
  • Adhere to department guidelines in relation to call volume and outside networking opportunities and key performance metrics
  • Work closely with Ticket Operations and Membership Services departments to achieve sales and prospecting goals
  • Consistently enter client data into CRM and Archtics ticketing system to aid in information sharing between sales and service as well as analytical data aimed at enhancing the Crews sales processes
  • Consistently maintain a strong sales pipeline and display the capability to manage a sales funnel effectively
  • Maintain high level of customer service to existing and new clients of the Columbus Crew
  • Participate in various sales, team and community events as assigned
  • Represent organization at various networking events and/or offsite community events promoting ticket sale's active role in the Columbus Crew game day experience
 
Required Skills, Experience & Abilities: 
  • College graduate (4) year degree required
  • Minimum of one (1) year of professional experience in sports or entertainment ticket sales 
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work weekends, nights, and holidays as dictated by games and events 
  • Strong ability to quickly and effectively establish rapport and build new relationships 
  • Willingness to learn, receive coaching and be competitive 
  • Highly developed professional attitude, appearance and inter-personal skills 
  • A solutions-based, consultative approach to solving problems 
  • Ability to confidently deliver information, analysis and recommendations to senior business leaders (both internally and externally) 
  • Strong individual organization, time-management and communication skills

job.title: IT Matchday
job.html_description:
What is Wicket Software?

Wicket is a facial authentication software company that allows fans to enter a venue in a touchless, secure fashion. By pairing a picture to their Ticketmaster account, fans can easily enter stadiums by approaching express entry lanes and allowing Wicket's technology to correctly detect their face.


Job Details:

Assist with Wicket's facial authentication software as fans enter the venue at Columbus Crew and Cleveland Browns home games. You will be interacting with fans by helping them enroll in the express entry solution, while also setting up and taking down equipment.

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive hourly wage
  • Valuable experience working with cutting edge technology and premier professional sports teams

job.title: IT Intern
job.html_description:
Job Summary

The Columbus Crew is seeking a tech-savvy, service-oriented Support Services Intern to serve our fans, staff, and coaches. This role is ideal for someone passionate about IT support, eager to learn, and ready to provide hands-on assistance in a fast paced, team-oriented environment. Candidates must be a problem solver, have the capacity to work independently, and be a team player. Strong verbal and written communication skills are a must along with the ability to interact professionally with executives, managers, coaches, and partners. The ability to prioritize multiple projects is critical. The successful candidate will serve as the first point of contact for all Front Office technology support questions or issues. The ability to manage projects, coordinate with multiple departments, work with a sense of urgency and diplomacy, and take the initiative to contribute to the overall success of the club is paramount.

 

Job Responsibilities

·       Provide first and second level technical support to staff in a timely manner.

·       General IT Knowledge - Installing and configuring computer hardware, software, and printers.

·       Laptop and desktop troubleshooting (Windows and Mac).

·       Provide A/V support where and when as needed. 

·       Setup and tear down of event related functions as needed. 

·       Provide mobile device support with iOS, Android, and Microsoft products.

·       Troubleshoot network communication issues and end user network connectivity. 

·       IT support at various locations including ScottsMiracle-Gro Field, Historic Crew Stadium, Ohio Health Performance Center, and Municipal Light Plant.

·       Help desk support and event support which may include nights and weekends. 

·       Creates technical documentation of support issues and user guides.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

·       Currently enrolled or completed in a relevant degree program (e.g., Information Technology, or related field).

·       Strong understanding of computer hardware, software, and networking fundamentals.

·       Basic knowledge of operating systems (e.g., Windows, MacOS, Linux) and productivity tools.

·       Excellent problem-solving skills.

·       Strong communication, customer service and interpersonal skills.

·       Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

·       Willingness to learn and adapt in a dynamic environment.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications:

·       Coursework or experience in areas such as cybersecurity, network administration, or database management.

·       Experience with ticketing systems (e.g. ServiceDesk Plus).

·       Familiarity with Active Directory, Office 365, and remote support tools (e.g. NinjaRMM).

·       Previous internship or relevant work experience in IT support.

·       Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals.

job.title: Matchday Steward (casual contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15 per hour


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace FC is looking for passionate, well-presented, and engaging individuals to join our Security matchday team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring the safety, safeguarding, and enjoyment of all our guests at Selhurst Park. Representing Crystal Palace FC on the front line, you’ll deliver outstanding service with a smile, support fans, and help create an unforgettable matchday experience. Be part of the energy, excitement, and pride of Selhurst Park as you play a key role in bringing our club to life on matchdays.


Responsibilities:

  • Commit to and attend all Premier League fixtures (schedule to be announced in June) as well as FA Cup games as required

  • Be responsible for the safe access and comfort of spectators visiting the stadium

  • Identify and report any incident, occurrence or hazard among spectators and report to a supervisor

  • Ensure that CPFC standards are upheld by being the first line of contact with guests and provide a welcoming environment to provide the best experience and visit at Selhurst Park Stadium.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

• You must be over 18 (Essential)

• NVQ Level 2 in Spectator Safety (desirable)

• Friendly and happy to help all clients with patience and good manners

• Be mature and be able to handle situations calmly

• Possess excellent interpersonal skills and be polite and courteous

• A strong focus on accuracy and diligence in every aspect

• Good communication skills

• An understanding of body search regulations and processes

• Experience working at a football stadium and/or similar spectator events (Desirable)


Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for a self-motivated, detail orientated and hardworking cleaner to join our team. You will be responsible for making sure that the site is clean, presentable. This can entail dusting, polishing, mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, and cleaning smudges off windows and doors.


Responsibilities:

  • Being responsible for all basic cleaning in and around the building.

  • Cleaning floors and rooms - including dust mopping, damp mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, dusting, picking up objects off the floor, and spot cleaning glass and windows.

  • Cleaning restrooms, including restocking dispensers, emptying trash, cleaning and sanitizing fixtures, cleaning mirrors, spot cleaning partition doors and walls, sweeping and mopping tile floors, and cleaning toilets and urinals.

  • Emptying trash, cleaning vacuums and replacing liners

  • Setting up, stocks, and maintains cleaning equipment and supplies.

  • Monitoring and maintaining sanitation and organization of assigned areas.

  • Assisting other departments when needed to ensure optimum service to guests.

  • Liaising with the line manager to ensure that you have sufficient cleaning products at all times.

  • Reporting any breakages that occur during the cleaning process.

  • Informing the line manager of repairs that need to be done.

  • Reporting any large objects obstructing fire exit.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in professional cleaning with exceptionally high standards

  • Attention to detail

  • High standard of discretion and confidentiality

  • Have a strong work ethic, be loyal, passionate, and friendly.

  • Team player – expected to work well and communicate effectively with the team

  • Checkable reference

  • Ability to work with high profile professionals

  • Understanding that our commercial premises may contain confidential paperwork etc

  • Ensuring compliance to sanitation, hygiene, health and safety legislation and organisational and quality requirements and working policies and procedures.

  • Flexible and adaptable at all times

- Understanding all menus, product offerings, packaging and pricing - Responsible for preparing and cooking all the hot food such as burgers, pies, hot dogs nachos and specialty items for a unit on match day and meeting peak periods with appropriate food levels - Maintain high standards of food presentation and quality with regular controls - Ensure all products are accounted for, prepared and distributed according to cook-off numbers and instructions from your manager - Restock and ensure the food prep area is clean at the end of your shift - Ensure all kitchen unit equipment (electrical or otherwise) is cleaned down and properly maintained at the end of every shift - Adhere and keep up to date records for food and health and safety standards such as food temperature control levels and following the club’s Food Safety Management System - Adhering to all Health & Safety policies and Security policies - Carrying out any other reasonable duties asked of you from within your team and management including being flexible in covering tasks outside of your role-specific duties. - Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager. - Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.
Experience, Skills and Qualifications:
- Food Safety Level 2 certificate and strong knowledge of proper food handling procedures - Experience grilling or cooking food in mass quantities, particularly in a busy or similar environment - A can-do attitude and be prepared to help the rest of the team out with a positive attitude - Immaculate grooming standards and overall appearance - Always look for ways to improve - Can work in high pressure situations

job.title: Maintenance Operative
job.location: Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:     Academy Training Ground, BR3 1NZ

Contract Type:   Full-time


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for an experienced and skilled Maintenance operative to perform and upkeep tasks such as repairs, inspections, plumbing, carpentry, painting, decorating, general maintenance and planned improvement services to our facilitates. The individual will be responsible for assisting other trades when required to ensure the highest level of service across our sites.


Responsibilities:

  • Undertake the day-to-day general maintenance repairs in-house for all our facilities but mainly at our Academy Training Ground.

  • Undertake painting work, such as preparing painting surfaces, removing old paint, mixing and matching paints, and to use correct utilities to prepare the surrounding areas in order to prevent messes.

  • Undertake plumbing work, such as fixing leaks, unblocking drains and gutters, shower fitting, and more.

  • Undertake tiling and decorating work, such as, preparing surfaces by levelling off with the correct material, measuring and applying tiles, repairing/removing old surfaces, add more.

  • Undertake carpentry work, such as taking measurements and installing shelves, cabinets, handles, locks and more.

  • Preparation of the facilities for home matches

  • Regular checks and repairs on lights, toilets, and seats.

  • Completing work in accordance with the Crystal Palace specifications and in compliance with the relevant Legislation and industry best practices

  • Working to operational procedures, safe working practices and Health and Safety procedures as required.

  • Providing general support and assistance to the Maintenance Manager

  • Inspecting the Training ground and Academy and it’s adjoining structures on a daily and weekly basis to ensure they are all well-kept and in order.

  • Completing works at other Crystal Palace Football Club grounds and facilities including the Academy Training Ground.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in a maintenance environment.

  • Experience in plumbing, painting, decorating, carpentry, and general maintenance.

  • Basic knowledge of maintenance systems such as HVAC, plumbing, electrical etc.

  • Ability to read manuals and drawings.

  • Experience using hand and electrical tools.

  • Experience working in large scale stadiums/ buildings.


Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees.

About this role:

Crystal Palace FC is looking for passionate, well-presented, and engaging individuals to join our Security matchday team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring the safety, safeguarding, and enjoyment of all our guests at Selhurst Park. Representing Crystal Palace FC on the front line, you’ll deliver outstanding service with a smile, support fans, and help create an unforgettable matchday experience. Be part of the energy, excitement, and pride of Selhurst Park as you play a key role in bringing our club to life on matchdays.


Responsibilities:

  • Commit to and attend all Premier League fixtures (schedule to be announced in June) as well as FA Cup games as required

  • Be responsible for the safe access and comfort of spectators visiting the stadium

  • Identify and report any incident, occurrence or hazard among spectators and report to a supervisor

  • Ensure that CPFC standards are upheld by being the first line of contact with guests and provide a welcoming environment to provide the best experience and visit at Selhurst Park Stadium.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

• You must be over 18 (Essential)

• SIA Door Supervisor Badge (Essential)

• NVQ Level 2 in Spectator Safety (desirable)

• Friendly and happy to help all clients with patience and good manners

• Be mature and be able to handle situations calmly

• Possess excellent interpersonal skills and be polite and courteous

• A strong focus on accuracy and diligence in every aspect

• Good communication skills

• An understanding of body search regulations and processes

• Experience working at a football stadium and/or similar spectator events (Desirable)

job.title: Concessions Supervisor
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   Full-time

Deadline:            Sunday 9th August 2026

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

The position ensures all concourse kiosks, fan zones and public catering units are prepared, clean, compliant and ready for matchdays and events. The role focuses on operational readiness, compliance, porter coordination, Hub Leader support, and ensuring smooth matchday execution across the stadium.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare, set up and complete pre-match readiness checks for all kiosks, bars and fan zone units, ensuring cleanliness, equipment functionality, signage, stock presentation and operational readiness.

  • Move between units during matchdays/events to ensure smooth, safe and efficient operations, assisting with issue resolution and supporting end-of-day close-down to leave all areas secure, clean and compliant.

  • Ensure Hub Leaders receive all operational information, briefings, schedules, allocations and updates required for each matchday, while reinforcing operational standards and key messages.

  • Ensure Hub Leaders have the equipment, disposables and operational support required to run their units effectively, resolving issues relating to staffing, equipment, customer flow and compliance.

  • Collect, log and communicate feedback, operational issues and risks raised by Hub Leaders before, during and after events.

  • Maintain high standards of hygiene, presentation and housekeeping across all concessions, carrying out routine food safety, health & safety and pest control checks, liaising with contractors where required, and ensuring all kiosks remain audit-ready for EHO, Fire Safety and internal inspections.

  • Document and maintain licensing records, including refusals and ID checks.

  • Coordinate porter activities to ensure kiosks and work areas are cleaned to the required standard before, during and after events, including waste removal, floor cleanliness and general housekeeping.

  • Provide clear communication between kiosks, Hub Leaders and the management team, reporting maintenance issues, equipment faults, health & safety concerns and recurring operational risks requiring management action.

  • Complete and maintain operational checklists, compliance documentation and post-event reports.

  • Support equipment and stock organisation by communicating operational requirements without undertaking stock control duties.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in a catering, retail, stadium or events environment.

  • Understanding of food safety and health & safety procedures.

  • Ability to work across a large multi-unit site and manage multiple demands.

  • Strong organisational skills with good attention to detail.

  • Experience supervising or supporting operational staff. (desirable)

  • Familiarity with EHO expectations, HACCP, or compliance-based work. (desirable)

  • Experience coordinating cleaning/porter teams. (desirable)

  • Hands-on, reliable and calm under pressure.

  • Clear communicator with a practical, problem-solving approach.

  • Organised, methodical and consistent.

  • Takes pride in maintaining high standards across the stadium.

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days 

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. job.title: Social Media & Content Producer
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   Full-time

Deadline:            30th August 2026

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club is seeking a creative, multi-skilled and well organised social media and content professional to undertake a key role in the club’s media team.

The successful candidate will, alongside the Senior Social Media and Content Manager, be charged with running the club’s social media output across multiple channels to help meet the club’s objectives of engaging and growing its global fan base as well as meeting the club’s commercial targets.

Every day, the successful applicant will conceive, pitch and deliver innovative content ideas in conjunction with the club’s editorial, video production and graphics team to deliver interesting, accurate, shareable and high-quality club output, whilst reacting to social trends appropriately.

The role will be at the heart of creative content creation but also is responsible for planning and scheduling posts on a day to day basis – ensuring the needs of colleagues across the club are met.

As a member of the wider Marketing department, they will also be tasked with shaping and delivering effective social media campaigns for club departments and external partners. (such as Retail, Ticketing, Memberships, Commercial Partnerships, Premium Hospitality etc).

The successful candidate will be expected to maintain a ‘can-do’ positive attitude, be willing to work unsociable hours (e.g. weekends and evenings), expectation to work home and away games, be flexible to changing demands in a fast-paced environment, have outstanding people skills. The successful applicant will be proactive, inquisitive, organised and obsessed with all things social media, digital content - and of course, Premier League football.

Responsibilities:

  • Day-to-day management of all CPFC social media platforms – including weekly scheduling and longer-term planning, copy writing, creating and delivering content, briefing graphics, video and replying to supporter queries, frequency and engagement reporting

  • Vertical content capture for social channels and Official club website and app

  • Expectation to work home and away fixtures

  • Supporting the video and production team to edit imagery and video content to be used on social platforms

  • Developing the club’s social media strategy as the platforms and business evolves

  • Devising and delivering content ideas & campaigns from scratch in line with club objectives

  • Supporting commercial partners and club departments in delivering campaigns through social media

  • Demonstrating excellent, true ‘fan engagement’ and two-way communication with supporters

  • Reporting on the success of club / partner campaign performance across all social media platforms

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

Desirable

  • 2+ years working for a media team in the football industry, including experience running social media accounts

  • A creative mindset / approach

  • A clear understanding of the club’s current social media output

  • Extensive Premier League football knowledge

  • Outstanding written communication skills, with exceptional attention to detail

  • Video editing skills (Adobe Premiere Pro/CapCut)

  • Image editing skills (Adobe Photoshop)

  • Proven experience in videography and photography, with expertise in capturing engaging vertical content for social media and digital channels

  • A willingness to work out-of-hours and weekends (ie. matchdays)

  • A willingness to be flexible and work to tight deadlines

  • A people person – someone who can build and maintain positive working relationships, club wide, with all colleagues

  • Someone who lives and breathes social media, with strong views as to what represents outstanding content and community management

  • Someone who understands the importance of tone of voice and organisational values – but also someone who isn’t afraid to test and learn

  • A creative, confident, passionate individual – a storyteller, with an eye for detail

  • Someone who can multi-task and works at pace

  • Someone who is comfortable to make decisions in high pressure situations

Desirable

  • Advanced video shooting / editing skills

  • Advanced graphic design skills

  • Experience working with talent

  • In-depth knowledge of Crystal Palace Football Club

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days 

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring basic cleaning jobs are carried out as quickly as possible including: food preparation areas, equipment, crockery, cutlery, pots and pans

  • bins checked and cleaned structure of the kitchen (walls/skirting/doors)large equipment including rationale oven/brat pan/ blast chiller/ walk in fridge/ walk in freezer

  • Adhere to all aspects of Fire, Health & Safety, Food Hygiene, Licencing law, Challenge 21, Trading Standards, COSHH and other policies

job.title: Chief Finance Officer
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   Full-time

Deadline:            30th August 2026

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

As the Chief Financial Officer for Crystal Palace Football Club, you will play a crucial role in overseeing the financial strategy and operations of the Club. This includes financial planning, management of financial risks, record-keeping, and financial reporting. You will ensure the financial health of the Club, driving sustainable growth and supporting major projects.

Responsibilities:


Financial Strategy and Planning

Develop and implement the financial strategy for the Club.

Lead financial planning and analysis to support strategic decision-making.

Ensure the Club's financial operations are robust, efficient, and compliant with all regulatory requirements.

Capital projects

  • Oversee the financial aspects of all capital projects including the main stand redevelopment project, ensuring cost management and budget adherence.

  • Collaborate with project managers and contractors to monitor expenses and financial progress on all capital projects.

  • Manage financing and funding arrangements for projects, ensuring financial viability and securing necessary investments.

Budget Management

  • Prepare and manage the annual budget, ensuring alignment with the Club’s strategic goals.

  • Monitor and control expenditure, ensuring all departments operate within their budgetary limits.

  • Report financial performance to the Executive Chairman and the Board.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including banks, investors, and regulatory bodies.

  • Communicate financial performance and strategic initiatives to the Board and other senior leaders.

  • Liaise with auditors, ensuring all financial audits are completed efficiently and accurately.

Compliance and Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with all financial regulations and standards including Premier League and UEFA guidelines.

  • Identify and mitigate financial risks, implementing robust risk management frameworks.

  • Ensure the Club's financial practices are ethical and transparent.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Extensive experience in senior financial management roles.

  • Proven track record of managing large-scale financial projects, preferably in the sports or entertainment industry.

  • Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills.

  • Extensive experience in financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting.

  • Expertise in managing capital projects, with specific experience in overseeing construction or redevelopment projects.

  • In-depth knowledge of financial regulations and compliance requirements.

  • Exceptional leadership and team management skills, with a focus on mentoring and developing finance professionals.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex financial information to non-financial stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Experience in negotiating and managing contracts with vendors and partners.

  • Advanced proficiency in financial software and tools, including ERP systems.

  • Professional accounting qualification (e.g., ACA, ACCA, CIMA).

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days 

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.
