job.title: MA Africa, Intern/Apprentice
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:

·        Providing operational support to the Deputy Chief Member Associations Officer
·        Provide administrative support to the Paris team and conduct research
·        Prepare reports, presentations, meeting minutes, and project documentation
·        Follow up on project timelines, milestones, and deliverables
·        Coordinate logistics for Member Association delegations visiting the Paris office
·        Assist in organizing meetings, workshops, and official missions
·        Supporting the team in the organisation of workshops and seminars, including education and capacity building
·        Improve the service to the MAs with the help of external stakeholders and other departments/divisions
·        Assist in the development and implementation of specific football development projects within Africa in collaboration with other FIFA departments
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:

·        Strong organizational and communication skills
·        Proactive, reliable, and detail-oriented
·        Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
·        Team player with a collaborative mindset
·        Interest in football development and international organizations
·        Bachelor's or Master's student (Currently pursuing or recent graduate) in Sports Management, Law, Business, International Relations, or a related field
·        Strong analytical and writing skills
·        Good knowledge of project management principles
·        Interest in international development and sport
·        Previous internship or project experience is an asset
·        Experience in administration or project coordination is an asset
·        Experience in an international or multicultural environment is an asset
·        Sport organization experience is an advantage
·        Volunteer experience in sport is welcomed
·        Fluent in English
·        Proficiency in any other FIFA language (F / AR / ES) is an asset
·        Willingness to travel when/if required  
·        Availability to work from the Paris office four days per week
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Home office: Up to one day of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Media Partnerships Services Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting to the Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager FIFA27, the Media Partnerships Services Manager will play a key role in the planning and servicing of FIFA’s Media Partners, the Rights Holding Broadcasters for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Support the Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager FIFA27 with all logistical and administrative issues related to Media Partners.
  • Assist in managing event-related projects in collaboration with internal FIFA stakeholders and external entities.
  • Support the planning and organisation of various workshops, milestone events and venue tours for the Media Partners. 
  • Develop strong working relationships with key internal FIFA27 functional areas to ensure effective collaboration.
  • Contribute to the seamless delivery of services to Media Partners during the tournament, always ensuring the highest standards of excellence. 
  • Work hand in hand with the Media Partnerships Relations Manager to address specific needs of Media Partners during their visits to the Host Cities.

Education
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education.
  • Higher education in Media or Sports Event Management.
Experience
  • Strong experience in a similar role.
  • Experience in the Sports industry and/or Broadcast environment is an advantage.
  • Experience of working in Brazil and knowledge of local culture will be an added benefit.
Skills & Competencies
  • ACCOUNTABILITY: We are looking for accountable individuals—people who take ownership of their responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and drive results with integrity. Individuals must be ready to step up, be reliable, and make a meaningful impact.
  • INITIATIVE: We are seeking people with strong initiative—self-starters who take proactive steps, anticipate challenges, and go beyond what’s expected without waiting to be asked – who have the capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.
  • DECISION MAKING: We are seeking decisive individuals, with the ability to identify critical situations and swiftly make decisions, who take initiative and calculated risks, who explore alternative solutions, and react promptly to unforeseen circumstances. 
  • INNOVATION: We are looking for innovative thinkers—individuals who challenge the status quo, bring fresh ideas, and find creative solutions to complex problems.
  • VISION: We are looking for visionary individuals—people who see the bigger picture, formulate strategic plans, think long-term, perceive the organization's global environmental impact and help shape bold ideas into reality. 
  • INCLUSIVITY: We seek individuals who love teamwork, actively listen, embrace diverse perspectives, and help build collaborative, respectful teams. Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
Requirements
  • Fluent in English and (Brazilian) Portuguese. Any other language is a plus.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) and online collaboration tools.
  • This position requires travel to participate in meetings and venue tours across Brazil.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education. - Higher education in Media or Sports Event Management.
Experience
- Strong experience in a similar role. - Experience in the Sports industry and/or Broadcast environment is an advantage. - Experience of working in Brazil and knowledge of local culture will be an added benefit.
Skills & Competencies
- ACCOUNTABILITY: We are looking for accountable individuals—people who take ownership of their responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and drive results with integrity. Individuals must be ready to step up, be reliable, and make a meaningful impact. - INITIATIVE: We are seeking people with strong initiative—self-starters who take proactive steps, anticipate challenges, and go beyond what’s expected without waiting to be asked – who have the capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas. - DECISION MAKING: We are seeking decisive individuals, with the ability to identify critical situations and swiftly make decisions, who take initiative and calculated risks, who explore alternative solutions, and react promptly to unforeseen circumstances. - INNOVATION: We are looking for innovative thinkers—individuals who challenge the status quo, bring fresh ideas, and find creative solutions to complex problems. - VISION: We are looking for visionary individuals—people who see the bigger picture, formulate strategic plans, think long-term, perceive the organization's global environmental impact and help shape bold ideas into reality. - INCLUSIVITY: We seek individuals who love teamwork, actively listen, embrace diverse perspectives, and help build collaborative, respectful teams. Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts.
Requirements
- Fluent in English and (Brazilian) Portuguese. Any other language is a plus. - Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) and online collaboration tools. - This position requires travel to participate in meetings and venue tours across Brazil. - Right to work in Brazil. - Fluent in English (spoken and written) - Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) - Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: IPTV & CATV Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecom Manager, the CATV/IPTV Manager will be a key member of the FWWC27 Technology team, and work in close collaboration with the Technology teams based in Brazil and Zurich and other key individuals responsible for delivering the CATV and IPTV solutions required for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Manage the CATV/IPTV service planning, delivery, and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. The service includes:
    o   CATV and IPTV systems in Stadia and IBCC
    o   Streaming to various platforms
    o   VOD services 
    o   TVs in all FWWC27 Venues
  • Organize procurement of CATV/IPTV services, manage the selected supplier
  • Review Legacy and Overlay CATV/IPTV design documentation and ensure it meets FIFA requirements.
  • Actively participate in the scope and R&R definition, liaison with different stakeholders, including Host Broadcaster, Stadia, CATV/IPTV suppliers etc.
  • Lead the CATV/IPTV infrastructure design, implementation and integration, ensuring it meets FIFA Standards and requirements
  • Overseeing the effective and efficient usage of Legacy Network services. 
  • Ensure the Project scope, timelines and budget are respected by all the stakeholders. Track the progress of CATV/IPTV Infrastructure implementation, report status, issues and risks related to Infrastructure projects and operations, according to Technology governance and keep counterparts aligned  
  • Liaise with and / or support other projects in clarifying requirements, adhering to robust change management protocol.  Deliver technical guidance, coaching & mentoring to team members, including preparation of good practice and educational material for personnel

Education
  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering or related field
Experience
  • Strong experience in CATV/IPTV
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex CATV/IPTV Infrastructure Projects
  • Experience in Management of distributed international team of telecom experts and professional
Skills & Competencies
  • Manager with experience in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events 
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in CATV/IPTV/Streaming Services, including infrastructure design, implementation, integration and connectivity. 
  • Should have broad understanding of CATV/IPTV, Streaming and Broadcast Infrastructure and Information Technologies in Sport Events and sufficient experience in design, commissioning and operation of following protocols/technologies: H.264/H.265 encoding, Multicast, SRT, RTMP, DVB, fiber convertors, etc.
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee 
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones  
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members 
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance  
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments
Certifications & Requirements
  •  Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 30%), with some trips with a long duration (15 days or more)
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Access Management Systems & Applications Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, the Access Management Systems & Applications Manager will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN´S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and managing a range of tools to assist in the planning and delivery of access operations of the FWWC2027 at all stadiums and the IBCC.  Such tools will include:


•             Access Management System (AMS).


Working closely with the Access Management Senior Manager, FIFA Corporate Access Manager and IT, help develop the AMS in its functionalities, reporting systems and set up. 


The Access Management Systems & Applications Manager will manage 1 Coordinator, whose primary function will be to support the Manager. Together you will train and provide support to the venue team in each Host City as well as deal with the system provider, Fortress.   


The Access Management Systems & Applications Manager will be an active member of the Access Management (ACS) HQ team throughout the planning phases and the tournament period.

The main responsibilities and oversights of the Access Management Systems & Applications Manager for the FIFA WOMEN´S WORLD CUP 2027 include: 

•             Help develop the AMS. 
•             Setup the AMS for the Tournament 
•             Provide training and training materials on the system to ACS, ACR and SEC staff.
•             Be the central focal point for issue resolution on the AMS system. 
•             Oversee the distribution and collection of the AMS physical devices. 
•             Provide central support as part of ACS Main HQ team during the tournament.
Education:
·        Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. 
·        Qualifications or extensive experience in access management systems. 
·        If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply.
·        Qualifications in IT systems.
·        FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. 
·        Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills.
·        Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
·        Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues.
·        Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people.

 Experience:

·        Minimum experience of 4 years in the sport event industry, with access management systems, ticketing systems or similar for large scale events.
·        Experience in delivering training.  
·        Single-sport, multi-venue event experience.
·        Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations. 
·        Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure

 
Skills & Competencies:
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyze one’s behavior, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes.
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculated risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts.
INITIATIVE: Capacity to do things on one’s own initiative and to influence the course of events, assume responsibilities, and achieve objectives with a minimum of supervision and control.
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans.

Certifications & Requirements

·        Access Management Systems, Ticketing Systems. 
·        Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools

Requirements
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Guest Experience Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Guest Experience Manager is responsible for the development and implementation of the guest experience concept exclusively within the FIFA VIP Hotel environment, including the FIFA Club.

This role focuses on brand implementation, experiential elements, FIFA Club concept (including F&B), and curated guest touchpoints such as gifts and in-hotel experiences.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead the development and execution of the VIP Guest Experience concept within the FIFA VIP Hotel, including FIFA Club, brand implementation, and experiential elements (e.g. gifts, amenities, and curated guest touchpoints).
  • Define the FIFA Club concept (including F&B, design, and guest journey) and oversee its implementation.
  • Supervise the tender process, evaluation, and appointment of guest experience suppliers related to VIP Hotel and FIFA Club delivery (e.g. experiential agencies, branding, F&B concept providers).
  • Coordinate and maintain a strategic overview of all guest experience activities within the VIP Hotel environment.
  • During tournament time, act as FIFA Club Manager (or oversee FIFA Club Manager role), responsible for operational setup and delivery of the FIFA Club.
  • Collaborate with relevant functional areas to ensure alignment of VIP Hotel guest experience delivery (e.g. Accommodation, Protocol, Transport, Branding).
  • Establish clear lines of communication and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and involved parties.
  • Develop training concepts and deliver training sessions for all relevant suppliers, their service staff, and volunteers, focusing on excellence and ‘wow’ customer service.
  • Attend site visits and inspections.
Education:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Business Management, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Marketing & Communications, or a related field. Specialization in hospitality, event management, or experience design is an advantage.
Experience:
  • Experience in developing and delivering premium VIP guest experience concepts and operations, ideally within hotel environments, hospitality settings, or large-scale events.
  • Extensive experience in concept development and implementation of guest experience elements, including branding, scenography, F&B concepts, and curated guest touchpoints.
  • Experience in designing and delivering premium hospitality environments (e.g. lounges, clubs, VIP spaces, or hotel-based experiences).
  • Proven experience in managing and coordinating external agencies and suppliers for experience delivery (e.g. production, branding, F&B, experiential agencies).
  • Hands-on experience in implementing on-site guest experience concepts, including setup, testing, and operational delivery.
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments, coordinating with hospitality, accommodation, and operational stakeholders.
Skills & Competencies:
  • Fluent Portuguese and English (spoken and written) with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to ensure high-quality delivery of premium guest experience standards.
  • Ability to translate conceptual ideas into operational execution, ensuring consistency between design and on-site delivery.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate, manage, and resolve complex situations in fast-paced environments.
  • Proven ability to manage and steer multiple external suppliers and agencies to deliver against defined concepts and timelines.
  • Collaborative mindset with strong stakeholder management skills across cross-functional teams.
  • Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and priorities simultaneously.
  • High level of adaptability and resilience in dynamic, high-pressure event environments.
  • Solid understanding of premium hospitality environments and guest expectations.
  • Advanced skills in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint; Project or similar tools is an advantage)
Certifications & Requirements:
  • Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an advantage.
  • Additional certifications in hospitality, event management, or experience design are considered a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager and working closely with the Ticketing Group Sales Manager, the Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. 

This role will support the implementation of the customer care strategies and processes for Group Sales Customers, to specifically fulfil all Group Sales ticketing requirements and ensure a smooth and successful ticketing operation for these customers. The Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator must ensure compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations, whilst providing support to Group Sales customers with ticketing issues and enquiries. 

The Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator focuses particularly on the delivery of effective ticketing customer care for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Implement customer care processes across all established communications channels (email, phone, and any other ticketing bespoke systems), in line with the applicable strategy. 
  •  Support regular quality assurance checks across the customer care operation, in line with the sales strategy and FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations. 
  •  Perform customer care ticketing processes (back office and onsite) whenever required. 
  •  Support and maintain relationships with Group Sales customers, resolving issues and enquiries. 
  •  Monitor ticket inventory, order status and deadlines for Group Sales bookings. 
  •  Issue all necessary ticketing communications and be able to translate into required languages, where applicable. 
  •  Present ticketing information to Group Sales customers and other stakeholders, both in person and online, as required. 
  •  Follow established communication and escalation processes and support their consistent implementation across stakeholders. 
  •  Implement quality control procedures to ensure that any deviation from requirements is detected and corrected as soon as possible. 
  •  Support the research and implementation of solutions to increase the productivity of the group sales customer care team and maximize customer information and satisfaction. 
  •  Analyse and report regularly on KPIs and the effectiveness of customer care being delivered. 
  •  Proactively identify and report on patterns and risks and implement processes to mitigate them. 
  •  Ensure that all customer care processes are in compliance with the different FIFA functional areas requirements, including but not limited to Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc. 
  •  Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the relevant customer care information is available and share applicable knowledge. 
  •  Ensure an efficient administration and archive of all versions of customer care and knowledge base, in all languages. 
  •  Report on the implementation of sales strategy and ticketing requirements. 
  •  Ensure adherence to specific operational deadlines and project plans and compliance with ticketing policies, regulations and GDPR. 
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Experience in the planning and delivery of a similar project for a major international sports event. 
  • Experience in customer care delivery for Group Sales, corporate customers and/or business stakeholders. 
  • Experience working within small, cross-functional teams, with exposure to day-to-day task coordination. 
  • Delivery of user acceptance tests. 
  • Ticketing. 
  • Venue and onsite operations experience for major sports events. 
  • Customer Service. 
  • Excellent communication and relationship management. 
  • Good numeracy. 
  • Courtesy and Cooperation. 
  • Accountability and Transparency. 
  • Analysis and Innovation. 
  • Flexibility and Adaptability. 
  • Perseverance and Dedication. 
  • Proactivity and Organisation. 
  • Time Management and Prioritisation.
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Fluent in Spanish, French or German, spoken and written.

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools

job.plain_text_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager and working closely with the Ticketing Group Sales Manager, the Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™.
This role will support the implementation of the customer care strategies and processes for Group Sales Customers, to specifically fulfil all Group Sales ticketing requirements and ensure a smooth and successful ticketing operation for these customers. The Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator must ensure compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations, whilst providing support to Group Sales customers with ticketing issues and enquiries.
The Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator focuses particularly on the delivery of effective ticketing customer care for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Implement customer care processes across all established communications channels (email, phone, and any other ticketing bespoke systems), in line with the applicable strategy.
- Support regular quality assurance checks across the customer care operation, in line with the sales strategy and FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations. - Perform customer care ticketing processes (back office and onsite) whenever required. - Support and maintain relationships with Group Sales customers, resolving issues and enquiries. - Monitor ticket inventory, order status and deadlines for Group Sales bookings. - Issue all necessary ticketing communications and be able to translate into required languages, where applicable. - Present ticketing information to Group Sales customers and other stakeholders, both in person and online, as required. - Follow established communication and escalation processes and support their consistent implementation across stakeholders. - Implement quality control procedures to ensure that any deviation from requirements is detected and corrected as soon as possible. - Support the research and implementation of solutions to increase the productivity of the group sales customer care team and maximize customer information and satisfaction. - Analyse and report regularly on KPIs and the effectiveness of customer care being delivered. - Proactively identify and report on patterns and risks and implement processes to mitigate them. - Ensure that all customer care processes are in compliance with the different FIFA functional areas requirements, including but not limited to Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc. - Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the relevant customer care information is available and share applicable knowledge. - Ensure an efficient administration and archive of all versions of customer care and knowledge base, in all languages. - Report on the implementation of sales strategy and ticketing requirements. - Ensure adherence to specific operational deadlines and project plans and compliance with ticketing policies, regulations and GDPR.
SKILLS FRAMEWORK
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes.
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.
INCLUSIVITY:Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts.
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.
LEADERSHIP:Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans.
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.
WORK EXPERIENCE
- Experience in the planning and delivery of a similar project for a major international sports event. - Experience in customer care delivery for Group Sales, corporate customers and/or business stakeholders. - Experience working within small, cross-functional teams, with exposure to day-to-day task coordination. - Delivery of user acceptance tests. - Ticketing. - Venue and onsite operations experience for major sports events. - Customer Service. - Excellent communication and relationship management. - Good numeracy. - Courtesy and Cooperation. - Accountability and Transparency. - Analysis and Innovation. - Flexibility and Adaptability. - Perseverance and Dedication. - Proactivity and Organisation. - Time Management and Prioritisation.
LANGUAGES
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written.
Fluent in Spanish, French or German, spoken and written.
TECHNOLOGY
- Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools - CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases.
Certifications & Requirements
- Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro - Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Non-Competition Venue Dressing Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Dressing and Signage Manager for non-competition venues reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing and Signage Manager for non-competition venues is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all non-competition FIFA Official Sites. 

This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.  
Non-competition venues are crucial to the successful delivery of a successful FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, the below list is a non-exhaustive list of venues that the successful candidate may be responsible for: 
  • Team Base Camp Training Sites 
  • Team Base Camp Hotels 
  • VIP Hotels 
  • Accreditation Centres 
  • Ticketing Centres 
  • Volunteer Centres 
  • Airports 
  • International Broadcast Centre (IBC) 
  • Outside Presentation Facility (OPF) 
  • Main Operations Centre (MOC) 
The successful candidate will be responsible for directly overseeing the dressing and signage planning and implementation at all FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ non-competition venues Brazil. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their cluster and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their cluster, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spend within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with the wider Dressing and Signage team to maximise creativity and ensure consistency across all non-competition venues. 
There will also be a potential need to relocate to another Host City for up to three months to take the role as Venue Dressing and Signage Managers during event periods at an assigned stadium. 

Key Responsibilities 
  • Contributing to the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups who require the services of non-competition venues at the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™. 
  • Overseeing the turnkey planning and delivery of non-competition venue dressing and signage across the tournament.  
  • Collaborating with the other Venue Dressing and Signage Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament official sites.  
  • Working closely with the Stadium Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximise efficiencies across the wider project.  
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all non-competition venues. 
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing and signage operations and reporting updates into the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly. 
  • Providing strategic input into the non-competition venue dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.  
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.  
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimised at all stages of the project.  
  • Liaising with non-competition owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.  
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.  
  • Attending department-specific and organisation site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.  
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing and wayfinding signage strategies utilising expertise from previous events and directives from management.  
  • Acting as the non-competition venues point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers during the implementation phase of the project.  
  • Participating in the creative design process for the non-competition venues.  
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.  
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against.  
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.  
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.
  • Strong experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 4 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.  
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.) 
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.  
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events. 
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. 
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.  
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. 
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. 
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. 
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period. 
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Bilingual – Brazilian Portuguese and English. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Workforce Planning & Operations Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Working alongside the FIFA Workforce Management team based in Zurich and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Planning & Operations is responsible for executing all workforce planning phases and processes, ensures the organisation has the right talent in the right roles at the right time.

Workforce Strategy & Planning
• Assist with the implementation of workforce planning and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027)
• Support the coordination of workforce planning activities across all workforce types (paid staff, freelancers, tournament-time hires, secondees, etc.)
• Work with the Workforce Management team to help align workforce plans with operational requirements
• Provide administrative support in maintaining workforce categories and entitlements data
• Maintain and regularly update the centralised headcount tracker, ensuring accuracy of data
• Support change management activities by tracking updates and communicating changes to relevant stakeholders
• Assist in collecting and preparing inputs for workforce budgets, timelines, and planning activities

Workforce Operations & Management
• Support the delivery of operational workforce plans during tournament time, including assisting with site operations
• Help gather and document requirements for workforce spaces, equipment, and operational needs on site
• Support the documentation and maintenance of workforce policies, procedures, and operational guidelines
• Assist in mapping and documenting workforce planning and operational processes
• Provide administrative and coordination support for workforce systems and tools
• Support the delivery of workforce training sessions, including preparation of materials and logistics
• Assist with scheduling and coordination of workforce operations teams, including staff and volunteers
• Provide on-the-ground operational support to venue managers during event delivery
• Help communicate workforce processes and procedures to ensure consistency
• Track workforce service levels and support reporting on entitlements and delivery

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
• Liaise with cross-functional teams (e.g., Accommodation, Travel, Transport) to support workforce needs
• Maintain regular communication with functional areas to gather and update operational requirements
• Provide coordination support between workforce teams, HR, and other stakeholders

  • Work Experience
    • Ideally experience with exposure to workforce planning, operations, events, or a related field
    • Basic to intermediate understanding of workforce planning systems, tools, and processes
    • Experience supporting or assisting with operational teams, preferably in event or venue environments
    • General understanding of data and its use in workforce planning and decision-making
    • Ability to organise tasks, manage priorities, and work with guidance in a structured environment
    • Experience collaborating with team members and contributing to a positive team environment
    • Good communication skills, both written and verbal
    • Demonstrated adaptability and willingness to support problem-solving and coordination activities
    • Experience working in or interacting with multicultural and/or multinational environments is an advantage
    • Fluent in English, both written and spoken
    • Portuguese language skills (basic to advanced) are an advantage

  • Technology
    • Proficient in MS Office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Visio & advanced Excel) 
    • Proficiency in using project planning tools such as WeTrack and Monday.com
    • Experience with workforce system implementations advantageous

job.title: Afghan National Women’s Team - Project Coordinator
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
The Project Coordinator will support the effective planning, administration and delivery of the Afghan Women’s National Team (AWNT) programme. The role is responsible for coordinating day-to-day project activities, logistics, documentation, communications, reporting and operational support across camps, matches, meetings, and stakeholder engagement. The Project Coordinator will work closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the programme runs smoothly, professionally and with strong attention to player and staff welfare.

These are your key tasks:
  • Support day-to-day project coordination, administration and delivery.        
  • Maintain project plans, timelines, trackers, risk registers and reports.      
  • Prepare meetings, briefings, presentations, minutes and follow-up actions.   
  • Manage document storage and keep key information accurate and up to date.
  • Coordinate logistics including travel, accommodation, transport, venues and equipment.
  • Liaise with FIFA teams, stakeholders, suppliers and service providers.       
  • Maintain team, player, registration and travel records.
  • Support visa, immigration, accreditation and player release processes.      
  • Coordinate support staff and ensure alignment across key functions.       
  • Help maintain a safe, respectful and player-centred environment.        
  • Provide on-site support during camps, matches and tournaments.
  • Keep players and staff informed with clear schedules and logistics updates. 
  • Identify operational risks, support contingency planning and escalate issues promptly.
  • Foster a positive, organised and collaborative team environment.    
  • Communicate with players and staff in a professional, culturally sensitive and trauma-informed way. 
  • Support evaluations, capture lessons learned and improve operational processes.
  • Support budget tracking, invoices and expense documentation.      
  • Support strategic planning and long-term development of AWU.      
  • Support the elevation, visibility and narrative of AWNT across international football, media, and humanitarian spaces. 
  • Support all content creation, storytelling, press relations, and digital communication.
  • Support media representation and ensuring alignment of safeguarding standards for players. 
  • Support sponsorship visibility and stakeholder communication. 
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Experience in project coordination, team management, operations, administration or event delivery
  • Experience in women’s football, women’s sport team environments
  • Experience in sport, football, national teams, international events or high-performance settings
  • Experience and knowledge of Afghan culture, communities or diaspora contexts is advantageous
  • Experience working with refugees, displaced communities, diaspora communities or people affected by conflict, preferably in a sport    
  • Experience with FIFA, confederations, member associations, clubs or international sporting bodies
  • Experience in communications, media relations, digital content, storytelling or public relations, ideally within sport, social impact or international settings 
  • Safeguarding training or willingness to complete certification
  • Valid police/background check or willingness to obtain one before appointment
  • Qualification in administration, project management, sport or event management, business or commerce
  • Fluent in English
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / SharePoint 
  • Ability to shape sensitive, player-centred narratives while upholding safeguarding, consent, privacy and duty-of-care standards
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
  • Able to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines and stakeholders     
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build trust
  • Comfortable in fast-paced, high-pressure environments
  • Flexible, adaptable and solutions focused
  • Strong understanding of confidentiality, safeguarding and duty of care     
  • Commitment to trauma-informed, culturally sensitive and player-centred working
  • Able to work effectively with diverse cultural, social and professional backgrounds
  • Professional, discreet, reliable and trustworthy
  • Willing to travel internationally and adapt to different contexts
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

- Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym. - Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all. - Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth. - Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it. - Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions. - Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation. - Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport. - Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance. - Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Ticketing Infrastructure Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
This role will be responsible for delivering all stadium and non-stadium ticketing facilities, including all related sub-infrastructure projects, serving millions of ticket holders.

The main responsibilities of the Ticketing Infrastructure Manager for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ include:  

• Ensure the delivery of all stadium and non-stadium ticketing facilities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ and other FIFA tournaments, in full compliance with established requirements.

• Coordinate with other departments to review and interpret facility designs and floor plans, as well as hardware and equipment scope, specifications, and requirements, to ensure accurate and timely implementation.

• Attend regular coordination meetings with the Ticketing Infrastructure team and other relevant departments.

• Establish and maintain up-to-date requirements documents, as well as policies and procedures for ticketing facilities, including physical infrastructure, overlay, FF&E (furniture, fixtures, and equipment), signage, and IT equipment.

• Plan and oversee the delivery and installation of physical infrastructure, overlay, FF&E, signage, and IT equipment in ticketing facilities.

• Manage, plan, and oversee staff involved in supporting ticketing infrastructure delivery in the host cities.
Education

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent level of education.

Experience

• Minimum of 5 years’ experience supporting infrastructure projects.
• Proven experience working in similar roles at international sporting events
• Experience in ticketing projects is an advantage
• Experience working in international and multicultural environments.

Skills & Competencies

• Proven knowledge of infrastructure projects (e.g., overseeing the installation of overlay, furniture, signage, equipment, etc.).
• Strong ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.
• Detail-oriented, with focus on delivering high-quality projects.
• Excellent communication skills, both within and across multiple functional areas.


Certifications & Requirements

• Languages: Fluent in English and Portuguese.
• Technology: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), as well as planning software and online collaboration tools. Knowledge of Power BI will be considered a significant advantage.
• Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
• Right to work in Brazil.

job.title: Fleet and Bus Service Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Fleet and Bus Service Manager will oversee the efficient and effective operation Tournament fleet and for any ancillary event. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing all aspects of bus services and operations, working close to the other Transport workstreams, providing a reliable, on-time and outstanding service for the established FIFA Client Groups, such as PMAs, Referees, Media and Broadcast, FIFA Workforce and Arrivals and Departures. The Fleet and Bus Services and Operations Manager will play a crucial role in optimizing bus performance, developing, and ensuring compliance with Service Level Agreements, Policies and Procedures, Operational Plan and Reports. This role reports to the Senior Transport Manager.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Act as the primary liaison between the Transport FA and FIFA27 departments for all bus and minibuses related planning and operational matters for FWWC2027 and any ancillary event.
  • Act as the primary operational interface between FIFA Transport and the event bus and minibus suppliers, ensuring full alignment on vehicle specifications, delivery timelines, KPIs, and operational needs.
  • Coordinate the reception, inspection, and acceptance of vehicles (e.g. buses), ensuring all units meet quality and operational readiness criteria before deployment. Manage the return, decommissioning, and handback process of fleet and buses post-tournament.
  • Act as the primary operational interface with cars, buses and minibuses and drivers’ suppliers ensuring service has been delivered as per contract. Monitor Fleet services performance against agreed KPIs, escalating issues and implementing corrective actions when service levels are not met.
  • Manage all ancillary contracts, if any, and operational processes related to the bus and minibus services, including vehicle washing and cleaning, refueling services, toll management, and the handling of traffic fines.
  • Develop the fleet and bus services Operational plan and well as the Depot Concept of Operations (including the design) and ensure its implementation across all Host Cities. Coordinate with all Host Cities depot locations, space, utilities, and facility requirements to confirm requirements are fully met.
  • Overall accountability for appropriate staffing levels and quality employees relating to all vehicle Operations.
  • Act as the central coordinator for the development of service-related Policies & Procedures, reports, presentations and Guidelines.
  • Manages day-to-day operations pre and during event and subordinate staff including supervisors, coordinators, dispatchers, depot planners, administrative assistants and drivers.
  • Setup of the bus timetables and any required information into Tournament Management System (TMM). Daily management and updates.
  • Ensure all FIFA and Supplier staff are properly trained by developing and maintaining training materials and coordinating the delivery of FIFA-required modules (e.g TMM, fleet management system), operational workshops and briefings, safety guidelines, and role-specific instructions. The manager maintains consistent training standards across all Host Cities.
  • It’s also responsible, in coordination with the bus and minibus service providers, for developing and delivering the full training program for all drivers and fleet operational team, including designing training content, defining formats (classroom, online, practical sessions), and establishing clear timelines and schedules. This includes planning how and when training will be delivered across all Host Cities, determining training duration and required number of days, organizing group sessions to cover the entire driver workforce, and ensuring consistent standards and materials. 
  • During tournament ensure all job requests are correctly entered, validated, and assigned with the appropriate vehicle and driver. Oversee dispatching procedures, monitor vehicles while in operation, and ensure real-time coordination with Host Cities for seamless service delivery. Particular attention should be given to PMA services, ensuring precise planning, communication, and execution in alignment with other Host City transport teams.
  • Provide regular reporting to the Transport Senior Manager, FIFA counterparts, and other key stakeholders on coordination progress, issues, and decisions.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with other event areas (Security, FIFA Travel, Guest Operations, Media, Broadcast, TSV, etc.) to ensure coherent and efficient engagement with fleet service matters.
Qualifications:
Education – Bachelor’s Degree in Transport/Logistics/ Engineering/Project management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset.

Experience:
  • Strong transport and fleet or bus services experience in international major events in at least two (2) world-class sport/football events. E.g. FIFA World Cup/Olympic Games. Experience should include solid experience in multiple aspects of event transport operations and project management. 
  • Strong management experience in a similar role within an organising committee leading large teams to deliver a time critical project.
  • Proven experience of successfully managing and delivering transport projects of a similar size and scale.
  • Proven experience of managing fleet services and operations projects of a similar size and scale.
  • Experience working with public and private sector partners in a collaborative environment and ability to build strong partnerships.
Skills:
  • Advanced knowledge of administration and management principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data validation, pivot tables, advanced formulas, and large database management. 
  • Advanced communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, the ability to influence others and manage relationships.
  • Ability to design, implement and operate a transport system in the Brazilian event environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of transportation technical operating processes and activities.
  • Ability to motivate others toward a common goal and manage a multidisciplinary team through conflicting priorities and continuous change requests.
  • Ability to work and communicate in a corporate and project focused organisation.  
  • Proven project management skills within a complex project.
  • Strong analytical and organisation skills.
  • Proven solution orientated decision-making skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure to immoveable deadlines.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Mitarbeiter/in Ausstellungsbetreuung / Visitor Support, 20%-60% - befristet bis 30.11.2026
job.html_description:
Erzählen Sie mit uns die faszinierende Geschichte des Fussballs!
 

Das FIFA Museum in Zürich bietet einzigartige Exponate, faszinierende Geschichten, multimediale und interaktive Attraktionen, spannende Informationen und besondere Erinnerungen. Mit aussergewöhnlichen Ausstellungen sowie interessanten Kultur- und Lernprogrammen ist das Zuhause der Fussballgeschichte ein lebendiger Treffpunkt für Fans und Interessierte jeden Alters aus der ganzen Welt.


Für unsere Skills Zone-Stationen und die weiteren Spielbereiche im Museum suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n engagierte/n und motivierte/n 

Mitarbeiter/in Ausstellungsbetreuung / Visitor Support, 20%-60% - befristet bis 30.11.2026
 
Du begeisterst mit deiner offenen und sympathischen Wesensart unsere Gäste von gross bis klein und bist mit deiner Kreativität und Begeisterungsfähigkeit vor allem verantwortlich für die interaktive Sonderausstellung im Museum. Du trägst dazu bei, dass der Museumsbesuch für alle ein unvergessliches Erlebnis bleibt. 

Die Einsätze sind flexibel auf Abruf, werden im Stundenlohn vergütet und finden von Dienstag bis Sonntag statt. 

  • Betreuung der Besuchenden der Sonderausstellung
  • Begrüssung und Einweisung der Besuchenden in die Nutzung der Sonderausstellung
  • Betreuung der interaktiven Stationen der neuen Sonderausstellung
  • Sicherstellung eines sicheren und angenehmen Erlebnisses für die Besuchenden
  • Überprüfung der Funktionalität und Leistung der Geräte und Systeme
  • Beaufsichtigung der Unterhaltungsmedien, Fehlerbehebung bei kleineren technischen Problemen und Koordination mit dem technischen Support Team
  • Ansprechperson bei Notfällen oder Problemstellungen vor Ort, Krisenmanagement und Weiterleitung an die verantwortliche Person
  • Mit-Betreuung der Pinball-Stationen im Museum bei Kapazität
  • Zusätzliche Einsätze bei Events sind bei Interesse möglich
  • Animierende Persönlichkeit mit Freude an Kontakt mit einem internationalen Publikum jeden Alters
  • Grosses Interesse und Faszination am Fussball und seiner Geschichte von Vorteil
  • Selbstbewusstes Auftreten
  • Kontaktfreudig und belastbar
  • Ausdauer und Fähigkeit ruhig zu bleiben in hektischen Situationen
  • Flexibilität und Spontanität bei der Ausführung der Aufgaben
  • Flexibilität bei den Arbeitszeiten sowie regelmässige und zuverlässige Einsatzbereitschaft; vor allem auch an Wochenenden
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse der deutschen Sprache, gute Englischkenntnisse, jede weitere Sprache ist ein Vorteil
  • Zuverlässigkeit dem Arbeitgeber gegenüber

job.title: Guest Relations Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Guest Relations Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and delivery of Guest Relations activities for VVIP/VIP and other FIFA guest groups at the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

The role focuses on guest account management (including invitation, registration, and communication), as well as the coordination of end-to-end guest journeys and liaison with key stakeholders.

Under the guidance of the FIFA Guest Relations Lead, the role ensures the implementation of the Guest Relations strategy, maintaining high service standards, efficient processes, and seamless communication across all guest touchpoints.

The Guest Relations Manager acts as a key point of reference for guest management operations and supports the training and coordination of service providers and workforce in the respective areas.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead and coordinate Guest Relations activities across all guest groups, ensuring alignment with service levels and event objectives.
  • Define and manage VVIP/VIP account management processes, including invitation, registration, communication, and quota management.
  • Liaise with stakeholders on guest invitation concepts, guest lists, and quota definitions, including coordination with offices and embassies of international and local authorities.
  • Map and oversee end-to-end guest journeys, ensuring high service standards across all touchpoints and efficient resolution of guest issues.
  • Oversee guest requests and bookings (e.g. program attendance, ticketing, travel, accommodation, transport), including structured change management processes.
  • Oversee ticketing-related guest processes and ensure consistency and efficiency in guest request handling.
  • Define and implement guest communication and liaison strategies, ensuring streamlined communication flows across all channels.
  • Collaborate with FIFA Zurich and relevant departments to ensure an integrated Guest Relations approach and consistent service delivery.
  • Establish and maintain clear communication lines with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop policies, guidelines, and protocol requirements for VVIP/VIP guests and other dignitaries.
  • Coordinate the management of guest-related IT systems and applications in alignment with FIFA Guest Relations.
  • Manage resources and support workforce planning for Guest Relations activities.
  • Ensure project delivery within defined timelines, milestones, and quality standards, including reporting and issue resolution.
  • Develop training concepts and deliver training sessions for service providers, workforce, and volunteers.
Education:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Communications & Marketing, International Relations, Business Management, Hospitality Management, or a related field. Specialization in protocol, event management, or international relations is an advantage.
Experience:
  • Extensive experience in guest relations and guest management, including exposure to protocol environments and structured guest handling processes.
  • Experience in planning, coordinating, and delivering guest services in a professional or event-based environment.
  • On-site event experience in guest relations, protocol, or VVIP/VIP service delivery.
  • Experience in managing guest accounts, invitations, registrations, and communication processes is an advantage.
  • Experience in coordinating with high-level stakeholders (e.g. government representatives, embassies, international organizations) is an asset.
  • Ideally experience within a sport/event organisation or large-scale international project, preferably in a world-class event environment.
Skills & Competencies:
  • Fluent Portuguese and English (spoken and written) with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • High level of diplomacy and ability to handle sensitive VVIP/VIP interactions.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Proven problem-solving skills and ability to operate in dynamic environments.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to deliver under pressure.
  • Solid understanding of guest management processes and operational coordination.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across cross-functional teams.
  • Advanced MS Office skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); experience with planning tools is an asset.
Certifications & Requirements:
  • Project Management certification (e.g. PMI) or equivalent experience is an advantage.
  • Relevant certifications in hospitality, event management, or protocol are a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Academy Driver (Part-Time)
job.plain_text_description:
The Academy Driver is responsible for providing a safe, reliable and professional driving service across. the Academy. Reporting to the Head of Academy Operations, the role includes, management of part-time drivers (exclusively Academy), and to work alongside the Club Driver & Fleet Compliance Manager ensuring all vehicles are maintained and presented to a professional standard. The Academy Driver delivers a consistent, reliable service to ensure safe transport of Academy players, staff and guests.
This will be a part-time (20-hour) role, with hours split across a 7-day week.
Responsibilities
- Provide transport for identified registered players to and from our Motspur Park training site. - Provide transport for trialist players to and from airports, train stations, accommodation, and club activities. - Support the player induction process when identifying players in need of transport support. - Act as a guide for visits to Motspur Park and Craven Cottage. - Assist the club on 1st team match days for corporate driving requirement. - Support the Academy across key events and wider activities. - Promote the work of Fulham Academy amongst the London football community. - Always represent Fulham Football Club to a high standard in line with club values.
Requirements
- Hold a full clean driving licence - Interact with others in a positive manner - Strong understanding of the local area - Positive ability to work within a diverse organisation - Self-starter who takes pride in the delivery of a professional service - Bi-Lingual (Desired) - D1 driving licence (Desired)

job.title: Academy Kit Assistant
job.html_description:
The Academy Kit Assistant supports the smooth day-to-day running of the Academy by preparing, maintaining, and distributing training and match kit for players and staff. 

This role is 20hrs per week.

Responsibilities

Essential and Desirable
  • Organised and reliable.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Positive team player with a flexible approach to working evenings and weekends.
  • Full Driving License
  • Able to work in a fast-paced football environment while maintaining high professional standards.

Requirements

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:  
 
  • Prepare and distribute training and match kit.
  • Ensure all kit and equipment is clean, organised, and ready for use.
  • Assist with stock control, kit issuing, and inventory management.
  • Support academy training sessions, fixtures, and tournaments as required.
  • Maintain high standards within the kit room and storage areas.
  • Work closely with academy staff to meet operational needs.
