job.title: Senior Manager, Membership Services
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

The Senior Manager, Membership Services will be charged with driving season ticket retention through successful training and development of the team, creating accountability goals and metrics, as well as spearheading a best-in-class season ticket member engagement strategy. This position will report to the Senior Director, Premium & Membership Services.   

   

 RESPONSIBILITIES:  

  • Oversee the entirety of the Season Ticket Member platform, including annual retention and year-round service and engagement strategies for the general Season Ticket Member base.  
  • Drive the creation, planning and execution of the annual renewal and relocation campaigns, while maximizing member retention and revenue generation.  
  • Lead an elite Membership Services team by recruiting, interviewing, training, developing and mentoring a talented group of individuals.   
  • Take ownership of season ticket member events, gift planning, creating customized member programs and generate other unique experiences and benefits to enhance member experience and retention.   
  • Troubleshoot issues that may arise from Season Ticket Members and the organization to determine appropriate resolution and act as a leadership point of contact for all escalated communications.  
  • Lead the Season Ticket Member onboarding process and touchpoint strategies throughout each season to build and maintain a high level of member engagement.  
  • Responsible for ongoing training and education of team members in the areas of customer service, account management, revenue generation, cross-selling, referrals, etc.   
  • Develop and track goals for individual team members and the department.   
  • Conduct one-on-ones with the Membership Services team to identify issues, help troubleshoot, and establish a relationship with the goal of helping each team member perform their jobs at the highest level.  
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Public Relations, Operations, Finance and other internal departments to ensure synergy and strong relationships across the board.  
  • Proactively recognize and anticipate challenges and opportunities for the team and the department  
  • Assist in the creation and management of the overall Ticketing department budget.   
  • Track all season ticket member renewals, feedback, attendance, event RSVPs, and other relevant member information in CRM to create reports and recaps.   
  • Other responsibilities as assigned by leadership.   

   

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:  

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Sports Management, Hospitality, or related field.  
  • A minimum of three (3) years of relevant work experience, preferably in the areas of sports business sales, service, revenue generation, retention, etc.
  • A minimum of one (1) year of experience in a people leadership role.     
  • Strong leadership drive with a desire to lift, lead, and serve others.   
  • Solid work ethic, team-oriented attitude, and enthusiastic about contributing to the success of the department and Club in a fast-paced environment.  
  • A proven track record in relationship building with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.   
  • Exceptional attention to detail, problem resolving ability, and ability to meet deadlines under pressure.  
  • Ability to organize and delegate responsibilities of projects and tasks to ensure timely completion of all obligations.  
  • Ability to work flexible hours including evenings, weekends, and holidays as necessary.  
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce and Archtics preferred.  
 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Housekeeping - Housekeeping PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

About Nashville SC & GEODIS Park:
 Nashville is America’s “It City” and one of the fastest-growing soccer hubs in the country. From hosting the CONCACAF Gold Cup to FIFA World Cup Qualifiers and the FIFA Club World Cup, Music City has quickly become a destination for some of the sport’s most prominent events. Locally, Nashville SC is in its sixth season and continues to thrive both on and off the field, highlighted by the opening of GEODIS Park in May 2022—the largest soccer-specific stadium in Major League Soccer. 
 
What we are looking for:
  • Individuals available for 6-8 hours, 15-20 times per year, and available to attend all necessary in-person and virtual training as a prerequisite for employment
  • Someone who enjoys speaking and interacting with others in a warm, and respectful manner
  • Must enjoy helping others and working within a team environment
  • Ability to lift, pull, push and/or carry 25-60 lbs. as necessary
  • Must be able to stand for long periods of time and be exposed to different types of weather 

Primary roles & responsibilities:
  • Maintain stadium cleanliness, emptying trash cans, replacing trash cans with a new liner, wiping down countertop areas, tops of trash cans; sweeping/mopping the concourse as necessary; squeegeeing standing water to provide a safe environment for our guests; picking up and throwing away trash left in the stadium and outside perimeter that cannot be swept.
  • Responsible for providing a clean and safe facility before, during, and after all events
  • Responsible for picking up trash and emptying trash and recycle receptacles
  • Maintain all aspects of restroom cleanliness and preparedness by stocking and wiping down dispensers; cleaning and disinfecting all fixtures (toilets, urinals, sinks, baby changing tables); keeping the floor clean, dry and free of debris; and emptying trash cans
  • Respond to and resolve guests’ questions, concerns, complaints or suggestions in a professional and polite manner. Recognize and respond effectively in emergency situations
  • Supervisory positions available

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Coordinator, Event & Parking Operations
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
BACKGROUND:

GEODIS Park – home of Nashville SC – is the largest soccer specific stadium in the United States and one of the premier sports and entertainment venues in the country.  Since opening in 2022, GEODIS Park has hosted several concerts, FIFA Club World Cup, U.S. Men’s & Women’s National Teams, Mexico & Korea Men’s National Teams and future LA28 Olympic Soccer Matches.

 

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Nashville Soccer Club is seeking an Event & Parking Operations Coordinator to support the planning, coordination, and execution of exterior events while assisting with parking logistics and traffic management across the venue footprint. This position plays a key role in supporting event day operations, coordinating exterior event logistics, maintaining operational resources, and contributing to a seamless experience for guests, clients, and event participants at GEODIS Park.

 

The ideal candidate is highly organized, operationally savvy, calm under pressure, and experienced in managing complex logistics in a live-event environment. This position will work closely with various stakeholders, so communication and organization will be paramount to the success of the role.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Serve as a key liaison between guests, clients, internal departments, and third-party vendors on all-event day exterior activities (i.e. – Fan Activation Area, Supporter Tailgating)
  • Plan and oversee end-to-end execution of exterior events, including 5K runs and walking events, ensuring seamless operations and a positive participant experience.
  • Assist the Event & Parking Operations Manager in ensuring the venue’s parking management company is properly staff and positioned on event day.
  • Schedule and liaise with vendor supplying event day staff shuttles.
  • Procure and manage inventory of exterior event and parking-related equipment (i.e – Portable Restrooms, Light Towers, Cones, Signage etc.).
  • Maintain documentation including standard operating procedures, checklists, and training manuals for parking and event operations.
  • Assist in preparation, setup, organization and placement of all vehicle directional and exterior pedestrian signs.
  • Maintain a professional, service-oriented relationship with guests, clients and partners attending events at GEODIS Park.
  • Complete all duties as assigned, on a timely basis, and with a high degree of professionalism.

 

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum high school diploma or GED required. 
  • Qualified Promise Zone residents given priority treatment. 
  • Must have a professional demeanor and excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
  • Must be detail-oriented, and capable of working on multiple projects simultaneously. 
  • Team player with a positive attitude, professionalism, resourcefulness, integrity, motivation, and a strong work ethic. 
  • Must be able to take constructive criticism and change direction to suit operational and client needs. 
  • Can be trusted to act in a manner that is truthful and values direct, honest communication at all levels of the Club. 
  • Must have a thorough understanding of the complexity of events and the hours that go into successful planning and activation. 
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively, both in writing and orally. 
  • Must be able to work events from start to finish throughout the year which includes days, nights, weekends and holidays. 
  • Must have computer skills: Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Outlook. 
  • Ability to lift and/ or move up to 25 pounds.

- Must have computer skills: Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Outlook.
- Ability to lift and/ or move up to 25 pounds.

job.title: Safety & Security - Venue Security Officer PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

POSITION OVERVIEW:
The Venue Security Officer will provide prevention activities and contribute to the building safety and security by monitoring and reporting physical security and safety conditions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Assist with controlling access to the Stadium including registering and directing visitors.  Visually inspect the ID card of each person entering the building and verify that the individual and the cardholder are the same.
  • Help with writing reports on all accidents or potential problems that shall occur, as well as notifying the Security management team.
  • Issue temporary access badges to authorized personnel as required by procedures.
  • Escort visitors and other personnel as required by procedures.
  • Inspect packages and other designated items as required (including assignment as a searcher).
  • Conduct foot patrol and Stadium security checks.
  • Visually inspect and monitor designated post area(s).
  • Assist with monitoring performance of security/safety equipment.
  • Investigate and report any unusual or unauthorized activity within the area.
  • Verify credentials to control access in restricted areas.
  • Assist with inspecting bags and purses at all entry points for prohibited items, as well as operate a walk-through metal detector (WTMD) or Evolv machine. 
  • Be observant for fires and suspicious packages.
  • Be observant for spills and alert to odors and unusual sounds.
  • Check and report condition of area, exit, and emergency lighting.
  • Check external access to vital areas of the facility.
  • Monitor access through designated doors as required.
  • In the event of alarm conditions, assist in the safe and orderly evacuation of facility personnel if warranted.
  • Respond to local audible alarms on HVAC and electrical equipment.  Report and silence alarms as instructed by procedures and Facility Operations personnel during after-hours operations.
  • Identify and turn-off electrical appliances such as space heaters, fans, coffee pots, etc., that might be left on after normal work hours and could pose a source of heat and ignition for fire.
  • Be observant for trespassers and unauthorized persons.
  • Inspect designated areas for unauthorized activity.
  • Operate and monitor CCTV and access control systems where required.
  • Operate computer-based security/safety-related software and applications as required.
  • Assist with controlling access to the Stadium utilizing access control system.
  • Complete required testing of security and fire systems-related equipment as required by security procedures.
  • Operate and monitor alarm systems where required.
  • Initiate appropriate response as required for various alarms.
  • Initiate and maintain 24/7 communication with the Security management team. 
  • Dispatch other Security Force personnel and/or check alarms as required.
  • Additional duties as assigned. 
 
QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Minimum of a high school education or have passed a General Educational Development (GED) equivalency test.
  • Ability to be trained to operate a golf cart, magnetometer wand, and walk-through metal detector and Evolv machine.
  • Able to obtain a State of Tennessee Security Guard License.  
  • Previous security, law enforcement and/or military experience strongly preferred.
  • Effective verbal and written communications skills.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and remain calm during times of stress.
  • Ability to lift, pull, push and/or carry 25-60 lbs. as necessary.
  • Ability to work in outdoor weather conditions to include extreme heat, cold and rain.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including but not limited to days, nights, weekends and holidays.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Event Operations - Event Operations Associate PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

Department:  Event Operations
Reports to:  Director, Event Operations

ABOUT NASHVILLE SC:
Nashville is America’s “It City” and one of the fastest-growing soccer hubs in the country. From hosting the CONCACAF Gold Cup to FIFA World Cup Qualifiers and the FIFA Club World Cup, Music City has quickly become a destination for some of the sport’s most prominent events. Nashville SC has the largest soccer-specific stadium in Major League Soccer and in 2025 made Tennessee state history by becoming its first professional sports team champion! 
Position Summary:
Nashville Soccer Club is currently seeking an Event Operations part-time associate. This position will support the GEODIS Park Event Operations team in the planning and execution of Major League Soccer matches, as well as other major events, while also providing day-to-day support to the club's operations.  
Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Assist the Event Operations department on the planning and execution of Major League Soccer games, third-party ancillary events, and other major events.
  • Ensure Club and Stadium standard operating procedures are compliant with Major League Soccer’s operational regulations.
  • During Major League Soccer events:
  1. Ensure locker room set-ups meet MLS standardization requirements.
  2. Assist in servicing the needs of visiting teams and league officials on game day.
  3. Provide support for the referee crew before, during and after the game.
  4. Assist with match credential production and distribution.
  5. Lead, brief, and oversee ball retrievers during the event.
  6. Assist various departments with match day responsibilities.
  • During third-party/major events:
  1. Assist in ensuring that client needs, and expectations are met.
  2. Work with the Event Management Team in planning operational details of the event.
  3. Help with the movement and storage of the department’s equipment.
  4. Setting event day spaces to meet needs of various departments.
  • Other duties as assigned.
DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Knowledge and interest in sports and entertainment.
  • Computer proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong communication skills and professional etiquette.
  • Strong worth ethic with a positive, team-oriented approach.
REQUIREMENTS
  • Available 20-25 hours per week, including nights and weekends and often under extreme weather conditions. A typical game day can require early hours and late nights amounting to a 12 hour event day commitment.
  • Ability to lift and carry at least 50 pounds.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Membership Services Specialist
job.html_description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:
The Membership Services Specialist is responsible for providing world-class customer service to Nashville SC season ticket members.  The Membership Services Specialist will manage an assigned base of season ticket member accounts, building strong relationships throughout the year to maximize renewals while delivering an extraordinary fan experience.  This position will report to the Membership Services Manager.
 
 RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with assigned season ticket members, driving effective communication through phone calls, emails, face to face meetings, match visits, events and other various channels. 
  • Prioritize season ticket member retention and satisfaction as a liaison between the season ticket members and the club.  
  • Strive to achieve designated revenue goals each year through renewals, new business referrals, seat add-ons, relocations and upgrades. 
  • Assist in coordinating season ticket member events, customized member programs and additional season ticket benefits to continually increase customer loyalty.
  • Execute various roles during Nashville SC home games to assist season ticket members and ensure a memorable experience for fans.
  • Troubleshoot issues and concerns as they arise and determine appropriate solutions, often cross-collaborating with various internal departments to ensure resolution.  
  • Effectively utilize CRM to achieve account touchpoint goals, track and organize all member communications, pull appropriate reports, and stay up to date with tasks and opportunities. 
  • Manage member payment schedules and late payment collections, working closely with leadership to identify at-risk and delinquent accounts.  
  • Collaborate with the Ticket Operations team on all ticket related items, issues or concerns. 
  • Contribute positively to the ticketing team culture by developing mutually beneficial working relationships with all team members. 
  • Meet and exceed established monthly, quarterly and annual service & sales goals. 

 

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • A minimum of one year of work experience in professional sports ticket sales and/or customer service.
  • Strong work ethic, team-oriented attitude, and enthusiastic about contributing to the success of the department and Club in a fast-paced environment.
  • The ability to work independently and demonstrate innovation and initiative.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, problem solving ability, and ability to meet deadlines under pressure.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours including evenings, weekends, and holidays as necessary.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce & Archtics preferred.
  • Bilingual (Spanish) speaker is a plus, but not required. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Marketing - Street Team PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
Position Summary
Nashville SC Street Team members serve as key community ambassadors for the Club throughout the 2025 season. This role supports fan engagement at public appearances, home matches, away watch parties, and community events across the Nashville area. Street Team members play a vital role in strengthening fan loyalty by enhancing the matchday and event experience, while also serving as an extension of the Club’s Marketing and Entertainment teams.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Facilitate on-site activations and promotional events while delivering exceptional customer service and representing the Club with energy and professionalism.
  • Serve as an extension of the Marketing Department by promoting club initiatives, ticket programs, and brand messaging.
  • Assist guests as part of the GEODIS Park guest experience team when needed.
  • Actively engage with fans to encourage participation in activations, distribute giveaways, and provide event-specific information.
  • Assist with the setup, operation, and breakdown of interactive displays, promotional booths, and event materials.
  • Distribute marketing collateral in an organized and professional manner.
  • Collect and report feedback, observations, and insights following events to supervisors.
  • Support pre-match activities, including Opening Act activations (e.g., Kick Wall, premium tailgate).
  • Serve as a matchday runner for the Nashville SC Entertainment team as needed.
  • Assist with matchday entertainment management, hospitality, and game presentation needs.
  • Support production logistics, including entertainment personnel arrival, load-in, and load-out.

Shift Information
  • Shifts include all home matches, the majority of away matches, and additional off-site community events throughout the season.
  • Hours vary by event schedule, with an expected commitment of approximately 5–15 hours per week during the season.
  • Some shifts require transporting materials to and from event locations and assisting with setup and teardown.

Qualifications
  • Ability to commit to all Nashville SC matchdays (home and away) with minimal scheduling conflicts.
  • General interest in and working knowledge of soccer, including basic understanding of Nashville SC’s schedule and roster.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a positive, outgoing attitude.
  • Comfortable engaging with fans and promoting club initiatives in public settings.
  • Team-oriented, collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to learn club promotions, ticket programs, and soccer-related information (training provided).
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver’s license, and a good driving record.
  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, and select holidays.
  • Dependable, punctual, and professional.
  • Ability to lift and move materials exceeding 50 lbs.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism when interacting with VIP-level personnel.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred but not required.
  • Prior experience in promotions, events, or brand ambassador roles preferred.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Housekeeping - Housekeeping PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
About Nashville SC & GEODIS Park:
 Nashville is America’s “It City” and one of the fastest-growing soccer hubs in the country. From hosting the CONCACAF Gold Cup to FIFA World Cup Qualifiers and the FIFA Club World Cup, Music City has quickly become a destination for some of the sport’s most prominent events. Locally, Nashville SC is in its sixth season and continues to thrive both on and off the field, highlighted by the opening of GEODIS Park in May 2022—the largest soccer-specific stadium in Major League Soccer. 
 
What we are looking for:
  • Individuals available for 6-8 hours, 15-20 times per year, and available to attend all necessary in-person and virtual training as a prerequisite for employment
  • Someone who enjoys speaking and interacting with others in a warm, and respectful manner
  • Must enjoy helping others and working within a team environment
  • Ability to lift, pull, push and/or carry 25-60 lbs. as necessary
  • Must be able to stand for long periods of time and be exposed to different types of weather 

Primary roles & responsibilities:
  • Maintain stadium cleanliness, emptying trash cans, replacing trash cans with a new liner, wiping down countertop areas, tops of trash cans; sweeping/mopping the concourse as necessary; squeegeeing standing water to provide a safe environment for our guests; picking up and throwing away trash left in the stadium and outside perimeter that cannot be swept.
  • Responsible for providing a clean and safe facility before, during, and after all events
  • Responsible for picking up trash and emptying trash and recycle receptacles
  • Maintain all aspects of restroom cleanliness and preparedness by stocking and wiping down dispensers; cleaning and disinfecting all fixtures (toilets, urinals, sinks, baby changing tables); keeping the floor clean, dry and free of debris; and emptying trash cans
  • Respond to and resolve guests’ questions, concerns, complaints or suggestions in a professional and polite manner. Recognize and respond effectively in emergency situations
  • Supervisory positions available

job.title: Performance Nutritionist
job.html_description:
Position Summary

Under the direction of the Director of High Performance, the Performance Nutritionist is primarily responsible for the development and execution of nutrition services for the first team, providing individualized and team-based nutrition support that optimizes player health, adaptation, recovery, and performance. This role requires a high level of organization and communication to facilitate collaboration with team operations, high performance staff, and the culinary team.

 

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and evaluate a comprehensive nutrition program designed for optimal performance: the evaluation, interpretation, and monitoring of the nutritional status and nutritional needs of the team, using established standards of care and practice guidelines.
  • Conduct nutrition assessments, care planning, education, and counseling of athletes and staff, including personalized nutrition services and medical nutrition therapy for athletes with clinical nutrition needs and food allergies, integrated with the individual athlete’s nutrition goals as indicated.
  • Design, implement, and oversee an evidence-based supplementation program, prioritizing NSF Certified for Sport (or equivalent third-party banned-substance-tested) products, with ongoing education and monitoring to ensure compliance with MLS rules, regulations, and nutrition-related bylaws and to minimize inadvertent doping risk.
  • Order, interpret, and act on blood biomarker panels (e.g., iron/ferritin, vitamin D, complete metabolic and lipid panels, CBC, inflammatory markers) in collaboration with team physicians, translating findings into individualized lifestyle, fueling, and supplement recommendations that optimize athlete performance and health.
  • Leads and conducts individual and team nutrition counseling and education sessions; development of effective individual nutrition prescriptions and educational materials for athletes.
  • This position will require strong communication skills, both verbal and written and the ability to collaborate with Coaches, Sports Medicine staff, Strength and Conditioning staff, physicians, and other support staff to ensure a collaborative and comprehensive approach to training, nutrition and recovery, as well as aiding in the treatment of diet and nutritional related medical issues.
  • Coordinate and implement nutritional recovery process through pre- and post-competition menus with training ground chefs; oversee and implement catering and meals during team travel with hotels. Coordinate/manage quantity food production, inventory and distribution, of other food products, supplements and beverages. oversee ordering, vendor relationships, procurement of goods and payment of purchases.
  • Body Composition testing (DEXA and other) including assessment, education, and programming regarding the nutritional needs. Conduct body composition assessments by utilizing and maintaining appropriate technology (i.e. DEXA, BodPod or InBody) and other manual anthropometric testing (i.e. ISAK).
  • Implementation of hydration testing and strategies.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

 

 

Requirements

  • Registered Dietitian, by the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, must be Registered and Licensed by the Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics (ACEND) of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics and licensed in the state of Tennessee of a minimum of 2 years. 
  • Master’s degree from an accredited college or university in Dietetics, Kinesiology, Exercise Science, Biology, or other Health Sciences related field.
  • Excellent multi-tasking and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including: evenings and weekends, with possible travel.  Must be available for in-person work/team interaction at an average of 15-25 hours per week.
  • Candidate should possess strong computer knowledge including proficiency utilizing Microsoft Office and other relevant software.
  • Professional, collegiate or club level sport nutrition experience.
  • Demonstrated proficiency interpreting blood biomarker panels and translating results into actionable lifestyle, fueling, and supplement recommendations, with working knowledge of third-party supplement testing/certification standards (e.g., NSF Certified for Sport) and anti-doping regulations relevant to professional sport.

 

Preferred but not required:

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Eligible to be Board Certified as a Specialist in Sports Dietetics (CSSD).
  • Soccer experience
  • Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist, through NSCA (National Strength & Conditioning Association)
  • ISAK certified 
  • Certified in Sports Nutrition (CISSN, ISSN) or comparable applied supplementation credential
  • Experience partnering with physicians on blood panel-driven nutrition and supplementation protocols
  • Experience in research, data collection, analysis of monitored stats, and evaluation of technology used by Sports Science/Performance department.

Duties & Responsibilities
- Develop, implement, and evaluate a comprehensive nutrition program designed for optimal performance: the evaluation, interpretation, and monitoring of the nutritional status and nutritional needs of the team, using established standards of care and practice guidelines. - Conduct nutrition assessments, care planning, education, and counseling of athletes and staff, including personalized nutrition services and medical nutrition therapy for athletes with clinical nutrition needs and food allergies, integrated with the individual athlete’s nutrition goals as indicated. - Design, implement, and oversee an evidence-based supplementation program, prioritizing NSF Certified for Sport (or equivalent third-party banned-substance-tested) products, with ongoing education and monitoring to ensure compliance with MLS rules, regulations, and nutrition-related bylaws and to minimize inadvertent doping risk. - Order, interpret, and act on blood biomarker panels (e.g., iron/ferritin, vitamin D, complete metabolic and lipid panels, CBC, inflammatory markers) in collaboration with team physicians, translating findings into individualized lifestyle, fueling, and supplement recommendations that optimize athlete performance and health. - Leads and conducts individual and team nutrition counseling and education sessions; development of effective individual nutrition prescriptions and educational materials for athletes. - This position will require strong communication skills, both verbal and written and the ability to collaborate with Coaches, Sports Medicine staff, Strength and Conditioning staff, physicians, and other support staff to ensure a collaborative and comprehensive approach to training, nutrition and recovery, as well as aiding in the treatment of diet and nutritional related medical issues. - Coordinate and implement nutritional recovery process through pre- and post-competition menus with training ground chefs; oversee and implement catering and meals during team travel with hotels. Coordinate/manage quantity food production, inventory and distribution, of other food products, supplements and beverages. oversee ordering, vendor relationships, procurement of goods and payment of purchases. - Body Composition testing (DEXA and other) including assessment, education, and programming regarding the nutritional needs. Conduct body composition assessments by utilizing and maintaining appropriate technology (i.e. DEXA, BodPod or InBody) and other manual anthropometric testing (i.e. ISAK). - Implementation of hydration testing and strategies. - Perform other related duties as assigned.
Requirements
- Registered Dietitian, by the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, must be Registered and Licensed by the Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics (ACEND) of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics and licensed in the state of Tennessee of a minimum of 2 years. - Master’s degree from an accredited college or university in Dietetics, Kinesiology, Exercise Science, Biology, or other Health Sciences related field. - Excellent multi-tasking and prioritization skills. - Ability to work flexible hours, including: evenings and weekends, with possible travel. Must be available for in-person work/team interaction at an average of 15-25 hours per week. - Candidate should possess strong computer knowledge including proficiency utilizing Microsoft Office and other relevant software. - Professional, collegiate or club level sport nutrition experience. - Demonstrated proficiency interpreting blood biomarker panels and translating results into actionable lifestyle, fueling, and supplement recommendations, with working knowledge of third-party supplement testing/certification standards (e.g., NSF Certified for Sport) and anti-doping regulations relevant to professional sport.
Preferred but not required:
- Bilingual in English and Spanish - Eligible to be Board Certified as a Specialist in Sports Dietetics (CSSD). - Soccer experience - Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist, through NSCA (National Strength & Conditioning Association) - ISAK certified - Certified in Sports Nutrition (CISSN, ISSN) or comparable applied supplementation credential - Experience partnering with physicians on blood panel-driven nutrition and supplementation protocols - Experience in research, data collection, analysis of monitored stats, and evaluation of technology used by Sports Science/Performance department.

job.title: I.T. Network Administrator
job.html_description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

The IT Network Administrator supports Nashville SC’s technology infrastructure across the Club’s facilities, with a primary focus on maintaining a reliable, secure, and well-documented network environment. This role requires a hands-on technical operator who can support network administration, infrastructure troubleshooting, end-user needs, and event technology in a small IT team. The ideal candidate brings strong network infrastructure experience, practical troubleshooting ability, clear communication skills, and sound judgment around security, confidentiality, and escalation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Install, configure, monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot network equipment and infrastructure across Club facilities
  • Maintain and document network assets, configurations, procedures, and escalation paths to support operational continuity
  • Support end-user helpdesk needs as part of a small IT team
  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to wired/wireless networks, VLANs, firewalls, and related network services
  • Contribute to technology planning and execution for matchdays, concerts, international matches, and other major events
  • Work closely with IT staff, end users, external stakeholders, and technology partners to identify issues, implement solutions, and support system improvements
  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating issues and next steps as needed
  • Work nights, weekends, and holidays as required, including matchdays and stadium events
  • Perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Administration, a related field, or equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, and relevant experience
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT administration, network administration, or related technical support
  • Strong hands-on experience administering, troubleshooting, and maintaining Cisco-based enterprise network environments
  • Working knowledge of IP networks, routing protocols, LAN/WAN configurations, firewalls, VPNs, Microsoft 365, Windows Server, and VMware
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and customer-service skills
  • Comfortable working in a small IT team where priorities can shift quickly between helpdesk requests, network issues, event support, and longer-term project needs
  • Sound judgment in handling network access, systems, credentials, confidential information, and appropriate escalation practices

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Professional certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft, or VMware certifications
  • Experience with Cisco Meraki, enterprise wireless environments, and advanced VLAN troubleshooting
  • Experience supporting technology operations across multiple facilities or event-based environments
  • Experience working with external vendors, managed service providers, or technology partners

job.title: Financial Analyst
job.html_description:
Nashville SC is seeking a full-time Financial Analyst to join the club. The Financial Analyst is responsible for supporting financial planning, analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting activities across the organization. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, capable of translating financial data into actionable business insights.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports and variance analyses.
  • Assist with development of budgets, forecasts, and long-range financial plans.
  • Analyze financial performance and key business metrics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Support management’s strategic initiatives with ad hoc financial modeling and business case analyses.
  • Maintain and improve financial reporting tools, dashboards, and KPI tracking.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance financial performance.
  • Assist with accounting and month end close as needed.

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of proven experience as a financial analyst or similar role.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, and modeling.
  • Understanding of GAAP and basic accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

 

Preferred Skills:

  • CPA, CMA, CFA, or progress toward a professional certification is a plus.
  • Experience with NetSuite, Vena, Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence and automation tools is a plus.

job.title: Manager, Special Event Sales
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
As the Manager, Special Events Sales at GEODIS Park, home of Nashville SC, you will play a critical role in driving revenue through the sales and coordination of special events. This position is focused on developing new business, maintaining strong client relationships, and creatively packaging GEODIS Park’s unique venue spaces. You will work collaboratively with internal stakeholders to maximize venue usage and ensure an exceptional client experience from initial outreach through event execution.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities through networking, cold outreach, client referrals, trade publications, and database research.
  • Build relationships with local event planners, corporate planners, and decision-makers to promote GEODIS Park’s event offerings.
  • Schedule and lead venue tours for prospective clients, showcasing features and amenities.
  • Prepare and deliver professional proposals and presentations using data, visuals, and client-focused storytelling to secure bookings.
  • Maintain and grow relationships with existing clients to drive repeat business and long-term partnerships.
  • Conduct market research to uncover new leads and cross-departmental tie-in opportunities.
  • Collaborate with internal scheduling and booking teams to secure venue availability.
  • Partner with operations, marketing, ticketing, sponsorship, and premium sales teams to support event execution and maximize revenue.
  • Work with sponsorship and premium sales teams to package special event opportunities with partner or hospitality activations.
  • Assist in the ideation and execution of internal special event series and venue-driven initiatives.
  • Develop innovative sales strategies and social event packages to increase visibility and overall revenue.
  • Attend industry events and networking functions as a representative of GEODIS Park to generate new leads and stay connected to local trends.
  • Provide regular reporting on sales activity, pipeline updates, and performance metrics to the Senior Director of Special Events.
  • Ensure a seamless handoff and continued communication with operations teams to execute event logistics successfully.
  • Support the Senior Director in strategic initiatives, special projects, and other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality, Marketing, or related field; or 3+ years of relevant sales experience in events, hospitality, or corporate settings.
  • Experience working in a stadium, sports, entertainment, hotel, or convention center setting in an event sales role preferred.
  • Proven success in prospecting, negotiating, and closing diverse event sales.
  • Strong knowledge of the event/hospitality industry; familiarity with the Nashville market is a plus.
  • Strong Food and Beverage Knowledge
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Detail-oriented multitasker with experience managing fast-paced projects.
  • Advanced experience in CRM and venue management tools (e.g., Tripleseat, Momentus, VenueOps) and proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Creative in developing tailored event packages.
  • Self-driven, collaborative, and results-driven.
  • Availability for evenings, weekends, and holidays, as required by event schedules.

job.title: Groundskeeping - Groundskeeper
job.html_description:
The Groundskeeper, in conjunction with the Groundskeeping staff, will be responsible for maintaining the natural grass and synthetic fields at a designated Nashville SC facility. This is a full-time position with majority of the hours worked at the academy facility (Currey Ingram Academy). During busy periods at either Geodis Park or the first-team training facility (Vanderbilt Health Training Center), this position, with ample notice, may be assigned to work for extended periods of time at either of those locations as needed.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist with maintenance of natural grass, as well as synthetic fields at Nashville SC facilities - including but not limited to Nashville SC’s trainings, home matches, concerts, football games, rugby matches, and field-related private events at Geodis Park.
  • Complete preventive maintenance on various pieces of equipment and ensure all equipment remains in working and operational condition.
  • Repair and maintain exterior grounds (in conjunction with landscaping services), including snow and ice removal.
  • Perform daily field maintenance.
  • Perform other duties to support the Nashville SC facilities.

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2 years relevant work experience in maintaining sports fields, golf courses or home lawn/landscape (preferred).
  • Must have high level of interpersonal skills to handle sensitive and confidential situations and information.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, detail oriented, and deadline driven.
  • Hours are variable and will include early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays in addition to the traditional Monday through Friday hours.
  • Ability to perform physical labor in various degrees of outdoor weather conditions, including but not limited to, extreme heat and cold or rain for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to lift 50 pounds of weight frequently throughout assigned workday.
  • Ability to work in various positions, including but not limited to, stooping, standing, bending over, sitting, kneeling, and squatting for extended periods of time.

job.title: Host Families
job.location: Newcastle upon Tyne Discipline: Football Operations Job type: Casual Job ref: 008802 Published: 5 months ago Expiry date: 30 Sep 2026 20:00
job.html_description:
Could you provide a welcoming home for the next generation of Newcastle United stars?

 

We’re looking for Host Families to support our young players as they move to Newcastle United from outside the North East.

 

Why Become a Host Family?

 

*        Provide a stable, safe, and welcoming home

*        Play a vital role in a player’s growth on and off the pitch

*        Support their academic and personal development

*        Receive competitive remuneration

 

Family is at the heart of Newcastle United. We know our players perform at their best when they feel happy and secure at home.

 

We offer both short-term (1–2 nights) and full-time (7 nights per week) placements for players aged 14–21.

 

If you can offer a nurturing environment and want to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you!

 

What we’re looking for:

 

We’re seeking Host Families in Newcastle upon Tyne (postcodes NE7, NE6, NE2, NE3, NE12), located close to our education partner or the Academy. You should be able to provide high-quality accommodation, ideally in a family environment.

 

Requirements:

 

*        Provide an evening meal, breakfast (for school-age players)

*        Access to laundry facilities and Wi-Fi

*        A safe and suitable environment for the player

*        Private bedroom with a double bed

*        Full or part-time placements available year-round to align with the football season

*        Willingness to accommodate trialists and provide holiday cover when needed

 

You’ll be able to:

 

*        Create a welcoming, homely environment for young players

*        Teach essential independent living skills like cooking, cleaning, and self-care

*        Provide meals following nutritional guidance from the Academy

*        Ensure accommodation is close to local amenities with good transport links to the Academy

*        Report any welfare concerns to the Academy’s Safeguarding and Wellbeing team

*        Integrate players into family life as much as they feel comfortable

*        Accommodate regular inspections and visits during the season

*        Build trusted relationships through open communication

*        Adapt to the flexible schedule of young players throughout the football season

*        Promote and demonstrate a strong anti-discriminatory practice

 

It would be great if you have:

 

*        Experience working with young people

*        Understanding of the emotional impact and well-being challenges young athletes face

*        A child-focused approach

*        The capacity to accommodate more than one player

 

We welcome applications from all sections of the community. In particular, we encourage candidates from Black, Asian and other minority ethnic backgrounds to apply, as these groups are currently under-represented in this role. If you're ready to offer a supportive home and make a lasting impact, we'd love to hear from you! 

 

To express an interest and find out more information please email Callum.Thompson@nufc.co.uk detailing the following:

 

1)      Your full name and current address

2)      Current occupation

3)      Whether you are interested in offering a full-time placement or intermittent support for trialists

4)      Your current property situation including availability of a private bedroom / number of rooms available

5)      Why you would like to become a host family in no more than 250 words

job.title: Lead Recruitment Data Analyst
job.html_description:
Lead Recruitment Data Analyst

Permanent

Newcastle Upon Tyne

Competitive Salary

Be part of something bigger.

We are the heartbeat of the city. A club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar and make an impact, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment.

About the role

To lead the application of data informed intelligence within the recruitment department, identifying, evaluating and ranking player targets to support first team and emerging global talent performance objectives.

What you’ll do

- Produce reporting and insights on transfer market trends and competitor benchmarking.

- Build and manage recruitment dashboards and automated workflows.

- Collaborate with data teams and external providers to drive innovation.

- Identify and rank player targets using data-led models.

- Deliver player analysis and evidence-based recommendations to stakeholders.

- Support recruitment strategy with data-driven insights and reporting.

The team

You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach.

United As One.

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with.

How to apply

To access the full job description for this role please click here.

For further information on this role and about the club please visit our careers page.

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.

This position is UK based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK. All job offers are conditional upon background checks, including reference history, DBS checks, and verification of your eligibility to work. Please note, we do not sponsor applicants without the right to work in the UK.

Recruitment Agencies – please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate details. Any candidates submitted without request will be considered direct applicants.

job.title: Academy Sessional Driver
job.location: Newcastle upon Tyne Discipline: Football Operations Job type: Casual Job ref: 010842 Published: 13 days ago Expiry date: 01 Sep 2026 08:00
job.html_description:
Sessional Academy Driver

Newcastle United Academy

Casual– Weekend and Evening working required

£13.45 per hour

Closing Date: 1st September 2026

We are the heartbeat of the city. Bringing people and communities together, join the Newcastle United Family, as we embark on the next steps of our exciting journey.

Your day to day

We’re looking for an individual to join our Academy Administration team where you will:

*       Transport passengers to and from academy games and tournaments and other assigned destinations using Club vehicles

*       Responsible for the health and safety, comfort, and welfare of all passengers while in the vehicle

*       Ensure vehicles are in a clean and roadworthy condition before and after us

*       Report any vehicle defects, faults, incidents, and accidents

About you

You will have the below skills and experience:

job.title: Lead Club Designer
job.html_description:
Lead Club Designer

Permanent / Fixed Term  Location  Competitive Salary

Be part of something bigger. Department tagline: Creative: shaping and unifying a world-class visual identity across every club touchpoint.

We are the heartbeat of the city. A club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar and make an impact, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment.

About the role

As Lead Club Designer, you will lead and unify the club’s design vision across all teams and touchpoints, ensuring a consistent, world-class visual identity. You will bridge creative leadership, strategy and execution, guiding the design team to deliver compelling, culturally relevant work that reflects the club’s identity on and off the pitch.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the club design hub, setting standards for quality, style and visual consistency.

  • Manage, mentor and develop a high-performing team of designers and creatives.

  • Oversee design across men’s, women’s and shared club initiatives.

  • Act as design lead on matchdays, ensuring a cohesive visual experience across all channels.

  • Drive the creation of campaigns, graphics, marketing, hospitality and merchandise materials.

  • Develop scalable design systems, templates and workflows that improve efficiency and quality.

The team

You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach.

Working closely with the Chief Creative Officer, Art Director and wider creative teams, you will play a key role in shaping how the club is presented to supporters, partners and audiences around the world.

United As One.

job.title: Academy Goalkeeper Scout Analyst
job.html_description:
Academy Goalkeeper Scout Analyst 

Permanent 

Competitive Salary 

Closing Date: 1st September 2026

Be part of something bigger. Identifying future goalkeeping talent through insight, evidence and expertise. 

We are the heartbeat of the city. A club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar and make an impact, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here. 

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment. 

About the role 

As Academy Goalkeeper Scout Analyst, you will identify, assess and monitor emerging goalkeeper talent across the UK and Europe through live and video-based scouting. The role will provide comprehensive technical, tactical, physical, psychological, video and data analysis to support recruitment decision-making and the Club’s long-term talent strategy. 

Working within Academy Recruitment, you will produce evidence-based player recommendations, maintain detailed player profiles and support scouting discussions through video, data and reporting insight. 

What you’ll do 

  • Identify and assess Academy goalkeeper talent across the UK and Europe through live match attendance and video-based scouting. 

  • Provide objective recommendations on player suitability against the Club’s recruitment strategy, playing philosophy and positional requirements. 

  • Monitor identified target goalkeepers through multiple viewings to assess consistency, progression and long-term potential. 

  • Build and maintain detailed player profiles incorporating scouting observations, video analysis and performance data. 

  • Create video packages and presentation materials to support recruitment discussions and player recommendations. 

  • Analyse goalkeeper performance data and combine this insight with live and video scouting assessments. 

  • Maintain accurate records within scouting databases, recruitment platforms and departmental reporting systems. 

  • Identify recruitment opportunities, succession planning options and emerging talent across designated territories and age groups. 

  • Work closely with Academy Recruitment colleagues to produce reports and evidence-based clips aligned with the recruitment strategy. 

  • Develop specialist knowledge of goalkeeper performance trends, player pathways and recruitment markets across the UK and Europe. 

  • Represent the Club professionally when attending fixtures, tournaments and industry events. 

  • Support wider recruitment projects and strategic talent identification work as required. 

The team 

You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach 

United As One.  

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

For further information on this role and about the club please visit our careers page. 

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates. 

This position is UK based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK. All job offers are conditional upon background checks, including reference history, DBS checks, and verification of your eligibility to work. Please note, we do not sponsor applicants without the right to work in the UK.  

Recruitment Agencies – please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate details. Any candidates submitted without request will be considered direct applicants.

job.title: Wellbeing Officers New
job.html_description:
Wellbeing Officers

St James Park

Casual

£13.78 per hour

Closing Date: 6th September 2026

Supporting fans every matchday. Ensuring everyone feels safe, welcome and looked after

We have a brilliant opportunity to kick start your career with us. We are the heartbeat of the city. Bringing people and communities together, join the Newcastle United Family, as we embark on the next steps of our exciting journey.

Your day to day

To help us deliver on our ambitious plans we have a fantastic opportunity for Wellbeing Officers to support our safeguarding, inclusion and security teams to ensure the safety and wellbeing of visitors and staff within designated sections of the stadium.

*       You will ensure your area remains a safe and inclusive environment and supports our Safeguarding and Equality, Diversity and Inclusion policies and supporting legislation.

*       This can include assisting and monitoring of individuals whose behaviour may pose a risk of harm to themselves or others.

*       Ensure accessible entrance and exit routes remain free from hazards throughout the game.

*       applying lost/found child/person protocols.

*       You will have exceptional written and verbal communication skills and be able to build strong relationships with colleagues.

*       You will have experience of working with vulnerable people and diverse groups to ensure we can meet their needs.

*       you will be able to manage conflict and difficult situations in a timely manner.

*       Confidentiality and discretion are key when dealing with sensitive information!

About you

It is essential you have prior knowledge and experience of applying Safeguarding, Wellbeing Accessibility, Equality, Diversity and Inclusion knowledge in practical scenarios that involve members of the public.

*       You will have exceptional written and verbal communication skills and be able to build strong relationships with colleagues.

*       You will have experience of working with vulnerable people and diverse groups to ensure we can meet their needs.

*       you will be able to manage conflict and difficult situations in a timely manner.

It is desirable but not essential to have a FA Safeguarding Children certificate, FA Safeguarding Adults certificate and FA Equality, Inclusion and Diversity certificate and are willing to complete further training as required.

United As One

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believes in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with.

How to apply

If you want to be part of our amazing journey click apply now and follow our step-by -step application. Get in quick and don’t delay your application, as we may close this role early.

job.title: Full Stack Engineer New
job.html_description:
Full Stack Engineer 

Permanent  Location  Competitive Salary 

Be part of something bigger. Data & Insights: Building cutting-edge technology that powers football decision-making across the club. 

We are the heartbeat of the city. A club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar and make an impact, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here. 

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment. 

About the role 

We are seeking a Full Stack Engineer to design, build and maintain the internal analytics tools used by scouts, analysts, coaches and football operations staff. Working across both backend and frontend technologies, you will transform complex football data into intuitive, reliable products that support recruitment and performance decision-making across Newcastle United. 

What you’ll do 

  • Design, build and maintain internal web applications across the full technology stack. 

  • Develop backend services and REST APIs using modern technologies and best practices. 

  • Build clear, data-rich interfaces, dashboards and visualisations that support decision-making. 

  • Take ownership of cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines and application performance. 

  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, designers and stakeholders to deliver production-ready solutions. 

  • Contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing and the continuous improvement of the platform. 

The team 

You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach. 

Working within a small, focused Data & Insights team, you will have significant autonomy and the opportunity to shape products and technology that are used daily across football operations.

Academy Data Analyst 

Permanent  Location  Competitive Salary 

Be part of something bigger. Academy / Data & Insights: Using data and insights to support player development and help shape the future of Newcastle United. 

We are the heartbeat of the city. A club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar and make an impact, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here. 

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment. 

About the role 

The Academy Data Analyst plays a critical role in transforming Academy data into clear, impactful insights that illuminate each player’s development journey. Working closely with coaches, sports science and medical teams, you will blend data engineering, analytics and storytelling to support informed decision-making across the player pathway. 

What you’ll do 

  • Integrate football, sports science and academy data into analysis-ready datasets. 

  • Build Tableau, Power BI and visual analytics products that support player development decisions. 

  • Develop reporting and dashboards that track player progression and performance. 

  • Present insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

  • Apply football context to technical, tactical, physical and behavioural analysis. 

  • Explore innovative tools and methods to enhance insight delivery and workflows. 

The team 

You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach.

We are looking for a Front-End Developer to help take Newcastle United’s internal analytics platform beyond its initial release. job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - Academy Strength & Conditioning
job.html_description:
Company Description

The New York Red Bulls are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS). RBNY, one of the ten charter clubs of MLS, have competed in the league since its founding in 1996. The Red Bulls play home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium (SIS) in Harrison, New Jersey. The three-time MLS Supporters' Shield Winners are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull for which the team is named. The New York Red Bulls offer one of the nation's premier youth soccer development programs, from local soccer partnerships across New York and New Jersey to Regional Development Schools and the Red Bulls Academy teams.

Purpose of this Internship

New York Red Bulls Academy are looking for an intern to join our excellent Medical and Performance department. This internship provides a professional learning environment for aspiring strength and conditioning coaches, performance scientists or other performance related careers.

Note: applicants must have consistent afternoon and/or evening availability on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday. Weekend availability is a plus.

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Contribute towards the development of best practices in the Academy
  • Design and administer strength training sessions and pre-training activation protocols that will align with the Red Bulls youth development model
  • Development and implementation of strength and conditioning programs to excel individual player performance and reduce risk of injuries
  • Evaluation of player performance through testing and workload monitoring in conjunction with selected key performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Live global positioning system (GPS) monitoring of players during training and games
  • Plan and develop late-stage return to play sessions – working in collaboration with medical staff
  • Provide daily and weekly reports to the coaching staff regarding individual player and team physical performance
  • Testing and analyzing player physical performance and creating reports for coaches and players

Qualifications

Basic knowledge and understanding of soccer


Current undergraduate or graduate student studying sports exercise and science, strength and conditioning, CSCS accreditation, or a related field


Demonstrates effective communication, time management, and organizational skills


Lives within 60-miles of Whippany, New Jersey


Possess a driver’s license and/or reliable transportation


Proficiency in Microsoft Office – Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - Academy Scout
job.html_description:
Company Description

The New York Red Bulls are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS). RBNY, one of the ten charter clubs of MLS, have competed in the league since its founding in 1996. The Red Bulls play home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium (SIS) in Harrison, New Jersey. The three-time MLS Supporters' Shield Winners are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull for which the team is named. The New York Red Bulls offer one of the nation's premier youth soccer development programs, from local soccer partnerships across New York and New Jersey to Regional Development Schools and the Red Bulls Academy teams.

Purpose of this Internship

The Academy Scouting & Video Analysis Intern will gain hands-on experience within a professional youth academy by supporting the player identification and recruitment process through video analysis. Working alongside the Academy Scouting department, the intern will learn how video evaluation, player profiling, and scouting operations contribute to identifying elite youth talent while developing practical skills used throughout professional soccer. 

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).

Job Description

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN

Learn the fundamentals of professional academy scouting, talent identification, and player evaluation.  


Develop technical skills in video analysis, including clipping, organizing, and presenting player footage using industry-standard software.  


Understand how scouting reports, video analysis, and recruitment workflows support player identification and decision-making.  


Gain experience organizing scouting databases, maintaining video libraries, and preparing materials for internal scouting discussions.


Improve analytical thinking, written communication, and attention to detail in a professional sporting environment.  


Work collaboratively with Academy staff while gaining insight into the day-to-day operations of a Major League Soccer academy. 

Qualifications

Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program and eligible to receive academic credit for the internship.  


Pursuing a degree in Sport Management, Sports Analytics, Performance Analysis, Coaching, Data Analytics, Kinesiology, or a related field.  


Passionate about soccer, player development, scouting, and performance analysis.  


Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational and time management skills.  


Comfortable reviewing large amounts of match footage and identifying key player actions.  


Strong written and verbal communication skills.  


 Proficient with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.  


Experience with video analysis software (Hudl Sportscode, Hudl, Spiideo, Wyscout, or similar platforms) is preferred but not required.  


Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a professional environment. 

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends).


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.

job.title: 2026 Internship, Fall - RBII Analysis
job.html_description:
Company Description

Red Bull New York (“RBNY”) are one of 30 teams in Major League Soccer (MLS) and one of the league’s ten original charter clubs. Founded in 1996, RBNY has competed in MLS since its inception. RBNY’s First Team plays its home matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, New Jersey and its Second Team plays its home matches at Montclair State University. RBNY are owned by the Austrian beverage company Red Bull GmbH, after which the team is named.


RBNY’s First Team is a three-time MLS Supporters’ Shield winner and a two-time Conference Champion, while the Second Team is the 2025 MLS NEXT Pro Champion. RBNY also operates one of the nation’s premier youth soccer development programs, spanning local partnerships across New York and New Jersey. RBNY’s Academy is ranked among the top development organizations in the country.

Purpose of this Internship

Red Bull New York II are looking for an intern to join our high-performance team for the season. A key responsibility of this internship includes providing analysis support to 2nd team staff in order to aid player development and maximize workflow efficiency. This internship will provide a valuable introduction into the world of analytics and the dynamics of a professional football club.

This is an unpaid, for credit internship (proof that you will receive credit is required).  

Job Description

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • A basic understanding of how analysis is performed at a professional level
  • Introductory tools and skills to be able to analyze matches and trainings
  • The ability to fly a drone
  • Firsthand use of industry specific software programs
  • A beginning understanding of providing analysis within a professional football context

Qualifications

Passion for the game of soccer


A willing learner and can take initiative


The ability to learn on the fly and be adaptable in different situations


The ability to work under pressure

Additional Information

Because of the cyclical nature of the entertainment industry, your assigned hours may vary to reflect our needs (includes nights and weekends). 


Red Bull New York is an equal opportunity employer and we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or any other classification protected by law.
