Nottingham Forest Football Club is a signatory of the FA’s Football Leadership Diversity Code. We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we Invite all applicants to provide diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer.  We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions.  If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below.  The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check or an enhanced DBS check. The results of a DBS check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act in a proportionate manner when deciding whether or not to proceed with the appointment.

An FA Enhanced DBS disclosure is required for all relevant new appointments to the Club. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions or reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that may have been incurred. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed on a DBS disclosure if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements. Failure to satisfy the Club and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment.

job.title: Education Assistant (Casual)
job.location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR, GB
job.html_description:
Engagement: Casual position offering variable hours on a flexible basis

Location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Department: Academy Education

Reporting to: Head of Education & Audit Co-ordinator

Closing Date For Applications: 25th August 2026

About the Role:

Nottingham Forest Academy has a clear aim of building on its excellent history and strong back story with the following vision ‘develop a world-class Academy which develops players of Premier League and International Standard. Recognised as a genuine EPPP Category One Academy differentiated by ‘emotion’ and ‘innovation’, this post will be held by an exceptional leader to continue our journey and further develop the excellent young players, people, strategy and methodology we have in place.

The post holder will support the delivery of the Academy Education programme (Scholarship, Full Time Training Model and Hybrid Training Model). The post holder is required to support the academic progression of Academy players aged between under 9 and under 18 to ensure that learners are achieving the highest possible education outcomes in line with the Academy Strategy and exceed the full requirements of the Category 1 Academy determined by the EPPP.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • To work under the direct instruction of the Head of Education and Audit Co-Ordintaor to support the teaching and learning activities of all Academy players.

  • Support with the delivery of the Academy Education Programme (Scholarship, Full Time Training Model and Hybrid Training Model) from an academic and administrative perspective.

  • Planning and delivery of the BTEC Level 3 provision for the Academy.

  • Assess and mark work in line with the BTEC Assessment plan set out by the Premier League.

  • Support the Intervention programme to support learners who are not making expected progress on the BTEC Level 3 programme

  • Be the key point of contact for all education matters on the Full Time Training Model including delivery and coordination of education intervention sessions.

  • Assist with the Co-ordination and delivery of the schoolboy hybrid education programme including liaison with schools of schoolboys in the 12-16 age groups.

  • Liaise with schools to collect academic data every 12 weeks for players on both Part Time Training and Hybrid Training Models to track and monitor academic progress.

  • Build new relationships / partnerships with schools, educational institutions and organisations that will enhance The Academy.

  • Ensure all administration work is completed accurately and within the time scale set by the Head of Academy and /or Head of Education/Assistant Head of Education.

  • Assist in creating a positive and purposeful learning environment for all learners.

  • Assist in creating an inclusive and safe environment for all learners ensuring all have equal access to opportunities to learn and develop.

  • Deal with any safeguarding issues that may arise by reporting them to via Myconcern and to the Academy Safeguarding Manager.

  • Participate in any CPD courses that are deemed relevant to your role

  • Lead on your CPD to ensure you are enhancing your development within the role.

  • Build and maintain effective relationships with governing bodies and external stakeholders to help shape the external environment, maximise student development opportunities, through appropriate challenge and varied experiences.

  • Ensure full adherence to safer recruitment practices and procedures across all Academy staff recruitment activities.

  • Be accountable for maintaining and embedding Nottingham Forest’s values, standards, and behaviours across all Academy staff and players at all times.

  • Ensure the effective use of the Football IP platform across the Education department, in line with established processes, expectations, and reporting requirements.

  • Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual reports, as required, demonstrating progress and outcomes against the Academy strategy.

What are we looking for:

  • Postgraduate Certificate in Education (PGCE) and Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) essential for this role.

  • Degree level education or equivalent essential

  • Knowledge and experience of delivery of a Core Subject (Desirable)

  • Experience of Safeguarding/Safeguarding role desirable

  • Demonstrable experience of secondary education teaching along with successful completion of probation period.

  • Experience of working in an elite sporting environment

  • Sound organisational skills, able to prioritise and manage own workload.

Forest For Everyone

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is a signatory of the FA’s Football Leadership Diversity Code. We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we Invite all applicants to provide diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer. We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

job.title: First Team Recruitment Analyst
job.location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR, GB
job.html_description:
Salary: Please state your expectations within your application

Contract: Full Time, 42 hours a week

Location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Reporting to: Recruitment Analyst

Closing Date For Applications: 28th August 2026

About the Role:

Nottingham Forest FC are seeking a Recruitment Analyst to join the scouting department, supporting the full player identification, analysis and reporting process. Reporting to the Lead Recruitment Analyst, the successful candidate will take ownership of a specific positional group across both Senior and Emerging Talent pathways, contributing directly to transfer window strategy and the department's day-to-day operations. The role also carries responsibility for the technical production of player presentations, including video content and dossier compilation.

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Access to high street and gym discounts.

  • Discount within our Club shop.

  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Lead scouting coverage for assigned positional groups, filtering and prioritising targets.

  • Research, track and evaluate prospective transfer targets throughout the window.

  • Compile detailed player dossiers, written reports and supporting video content to inform recruitment decisions.

  • Attend domestic and international fixtures as part of ongoing live scouting work.

  • Build and maintain a network of contacts within the football industry.

  • Maintain scenario-specific shortlists, kept regularly updated and ready to deliver at any point to support recruitment decisions.

  • Contribute to department operations, including platform management and internal reporting processes.

  • Work collaboratively and adaptably within the wider scouting team, while demonstrating the independence and confidence to take initiative and communicate findings clearly to key stakeholders.

What are we looking for:

Essential:

  • Minimum 3 years' experience working within a competitive first-team recruitment environment.

  • Demonstrable track record in player analysis, with strong position-specific tactical understanding.

  • Proven ability to produce clear, well-structured reports and dossiers.

  • Working knowledge of industry-leading platforms such as Wyscout, SkillCorner and StatsBomb.

  • Strong research capability across market trends and positional requirements.

  • Ability to manage a demanding workload and maintain performance under pressure.

  • Proficient in written and verbal English communication.

  • Proficient in Hudl Studio or comparable video editing software, including the creation of clip libraries and playlists for the players under assessment.

Desirable:

  • Postgraduate qualification in a relevant discipline (e.g. sports science, data analysis, performance analysis).

  • Existing network of contacts within the scouting or recruitment community

job.title: Deputy Safety Officer
job.location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ, GB
job.html_description:
Salary: Please state your expectations within your application

Contract: Full Time, 37.5 hours a week

Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ

Department: Safety and Security

Reporting to: Head of Safety and Security

Closing Date For Applications: 26th August 2026

About the Role:

The role will be responsible for ensuring, as reasonably practicable, the security of all Club premises, and the safety of all people attending events at The City Ground in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Safety Certificate and the Club’s Policy for Spectator Safety, through the establishment, operations and monitoring of suitable systems and controls, maintaining compliance with all relevant legislation and best practice.

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Access to high street and gym discounts.

  • Discount within our Club shop.

  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Assisting with co-ordinating and monitoring all matchday safety matters affecting the stadium.

  • Establishing, maintaining and reviewing Safety Policy in line with changes in legislation, best practice and identified problems through appropriate risk assessment.

  • Ensuring that the provisions of the Safety Certificate issues by Nottingham County Council are acted upon.

  • Maintaining compliance with all requirements of the ‘Safety at Sports Grounds’ legislation (The Green Guide) and other advisory documents issued by the Sports Ground Safety Authority.

  • Consulting regularly with senior representatives of Nottinghamshire Police, Fire and Rescue Service, East Midlands Ambulance Service and Nottinghamshire County Council regarding spectator safety and security.

  • Attending Nottinghamshire CC Safety Advisory Group meetings representing Club interests.

  • Liaising with the Emergency Services in the event of critical incidents and keep senior Club officials fully informed of developments.

  • Overseeing and reviewing Stewarding requirements for Matchdays to ensure numbers of staff and allocation complies with the Safety Certificate.

  • Assisting with reviewing and implementing appropriate elements of Health & Safety Legislation in relation to crowd safety and large events, liaising with the Health & Safety Executive and other relevant bodies.

  • Assist with investigating and responding to customer complaints arising from safety & security activities.

  • Liaising with Supporters Associations & assist in the planning of future events.

  • Continually reviewing the operation of the dept and implement actions to improve its effectiveness and keep up to date with changes/trends in football and adopt best practice where appropriate.

  • Liaising with and assist other departments with the preparation and launching of new initiatives.

  • You will be required to work on all home match days and to work across all Club sites including the Stadium, Club offices and Training Ground.

What are we looking for:

  • Experience in similar role involving spectator safety and large crowds at big sporting events.

  • NVQ Level 4 qualification in Spectator Safety or equivalent, or Safety Management qualification or working towards qualification.

  • Highly developed problem-solving skills, is resilient, works well in pressurised and stressful situations.

  • Flexibility to deal with issues out of hours and at short notice.

  • Develop a culture of continuous improvement and the ability to embed this ethos within your team.

  • Fosters a team approach both within and between departments assisting others where appropriate.

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate confidently with the public, contractors, employees at all levels in and outside the Club.

  • Strong leadership and management skills, commercial awareness and excellent decision-making skills.

  • Sound organisational skills, able to prioritise and manage own workload and that of allocated staff.

  • The ability to interpret and implement policies as required.

  • Be able to communicate key issues to a wide audience, listen to suggestions, ask probing questions to ensure full understanding of messages.

  • The ability to develop relationships with people quickly, work to build longer term individual, team and department relationships, creating trust and credibility.

  • Have a sound understanding of the financial and relationship management of your own area.

  • Ensure that internal and external satisfaction is a high priority.

  • The ability to complete all necessary tasks required by you and the team, ensuring high standards are always achieved.

  • Be able to persuade others through a well-structured and well-reasoned case.

Forest For Everyone

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer.  We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions.  If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below.  The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

job.title: Women's Lead Analyst
job.location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR, GB
job.html_description:
Salary: Please state your expectations within your application

Contract: Full Time, 42 hours a week

Location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Department: Forest Women

Reporting to: Head of Women and Girls Football

Closing Date For Applications:26th August 2026

About the Role:

The role will involve working as an integral part of the Girls Academy, facilitating the delivery of the performance analysis programme predominantly for the women first team.

The role will require a hard-working individual, who is able to work with a high level of detail and accuracy, whilst being comfortable with operating in a fast-paced, modern environment.

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Access to high street and gym discounts.

  • Discount within our Club shop.

  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the analysis programme for the Women's First Team.

  • Work closely with the women first team Head Coach and technical team on shaping, facilitating & delivering the analysis programme.

  • Ensure that games & training are covered effectively.

  • Work as part of a collaborative MDT team.

  • Build relationships with wider MDT staff throughout the academy.

  • Undertake self-development to ensure knowledge in all aspects of your role is up to date & industry leading.

  • Filming of women first team training.

  • Travel to home & away to women first team fixtures to film.

  • Help facilitate the filming of Goalkeeper training.

  • Create & help deliver analysis sessions.

  • Support the creation and implementation of Individual Development Plans.

  • Create a team-orientated stats report for women first team.

  • Help generate individualised metrics from match play for players within the women first team.

  • Build and maintain a library of best practice from games and training.

What are we looking for:

  • Previous experience at working at First Team level in an elite sporting environment.

  • Detailed technical and tactical knowledge of football.

  • Postgraduate degree in performance analysis or relevant field.

  • Highly proficient in using Hudl Sportscode & Hudl Studio.

  • Accustomed to leading and delivering analysis sessions to players & staff.

  • Experience filming training and matches with a variety of different equipment.

  • Football Coaching Qualifications (UEFA C License or higher).

  • Previous experience leading an analysis programme (desirable).

  • Experience using SBG Matchtracker (desirable).

  • Experience using Piero (desirable).

  • Accustomed using Tableau, and handling data, to produce team & individual orientated reports (desirable).

  • Experience undertaking longitudinal research projects (desirable).

  • Full UK Driving License (desirable).

The results of a DBS check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act in a proportionate manner when deciding whether or not to proceed with the appointment.
An FA Enhanced DBS disclosure is required for all relevant new appointments to the Club. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions or reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that may have been incurred. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed on a DBS disclosure if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements. Failure to satisfy the Club and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment.

job.title: Academy Goalkeeper Coach (Part-Time)
job.html_description:
JOB TITLE:  Academy Goalkeeper Coach (Part-Time)
DEPARTMENT:  Academy
REPORTING TO: Academy Technical Director
LOCATION:  St. John’s University (Queens, NY) & CFA New York (Orangeburg, NY)
COMPENSATION: $30-35/hour, 15 hours per week

POSITION OVERVIEW:
New York City FC is seeking a dedicated and experienced Goalkeeper Coach to join our Academy staff. Working with our U12-18 age groups, you will be responsible for supporting the development of all of our Academy goalkeepers. This role will demand a high level of off-field expertise as well as a very strong ability to design, plan, and execute on-field sessions and build individual development plans while ensuring alignment with the overarching philosophy and playing style of NYCFC and City Football Group. This role will play a pivotal part in the development of goalkeepers within our academy, fostering their technical, tactical, physical, psychological, and social growth. Finally – you will also be part of the City select and scouting & recruitment of the new Goalkeepers for our incoming U12 team and any other team within the academy. Expect ad hoc requests for travelling days domestic and internationally.

WHO YOU ARE: 
At New York FC, we are committed to upholding our core club values and our values guide how we show up and work together every day.  If you share our values listed below, please consider NYCFC as a great place for you to work (and play):
 Acts Honorably: listens and communicates respectfully, without judgement
Engages Collaboratively: provides and seeks constructive feedback to and from peers, proactively sharing appreciation for quality contributions of others
Champions Inclusion: celebrates the value of differences recognizing the value in the unique backgrounds and lived experiences of every team member
Drives Forward: embraces new opportunities with curiosity and a focus on improvement and innovation
Shows Heart: demonstrates passion for the Club and sport, operating as an NYCFC ambassador in encouraging and inspiring that passion in others

WHAT YOU’LL DO:
Training and Development 
  • Design, plan and deliver daily goalkeeper-specific training sessions according to the clubs Game Model and Methodology.
  • Support the creation of a curriculum for the U12-18 goalkeepers in accordance with the playing style and principles of NYCFC.
  • Supporting the assessment of all U12-U18 GK’s in the Academy and provide detailed feedback to both staff and the players/parents. 
  • Utilize video analysis and modern coaching tools to enhance goalkeeper development and performance
  • Ensure that every Academy goalkeeper has a clear Individual Development Plan (IDP). 
  • Aid in on goalkeeper scouting/ recruitment within the Academy. This will include supporting the planning and delivery of goalkeeper try-outs, clinics and camps as well as attending local and nationwide events.
Matchday Responsibilities
  • Delivering to the U12-U18 Goalkeepers during matches and tournaments, including warm-ups and pre-game strategies for them.
  • Support the head coaches and technical staff in match preparation when requested
  • Provide in-game observations and adjustments to ensure goalkeeper development and performance.
Collaboration and Integration
  • Work closely with the NYCFC Academy Goalkeeper Coach and attend/deliver as per his instruction.
  • If requested, assist the first and second team goalkeeper coaches to ensure continuity and alignment in goalkeeper development.
  • Collaborate with the strength and conditioning team to design fitness programs tailored to goalkeeper needs.
  • Coordinate with performance coaches and medical staff on load management and injury prevention.
Administration and reporting
  • Maintain detailed records of goalkeeper performance, training attendance, and progress.
  • Provide regular progress reports to the Acdaemy Technical Director as requested.
  • Attend staff meetings, logistics meetings and other events as required by the club.
  • Complete all administration associated with the NYCFC Academy platforms (Kitman, Hudl, TAKA etc).
 
WHAT YOU’LL BRING:
  • 3-5 years of youth goalkeeper coaching background/experience
  • Strong teaching background
  • Dual language English/Spanish is preferred
  • Knowledge and know-how of Microsoft office
  • Drivers license 
  • Strength in delivering tactically relevant on-field sessions
  • Hold a relevant coaching license (e.g., UEFA B License, USSF B License, or equivalent) or a goalkeeper-specific coaching license is highly preferred
  • Proven experience as a goalkeeper coach at the professional, collegiate, or elite youth level.
  • Experience in combining practical on-field know how with off-field planning and assessment
  • Ability to communicate effectively with players, staff, and other stakeholders.
  • Passionate about player development with a commitment to NYCFC's values and philosophy.
  • Collaboration with fellow coaches with a multidisciplinary approach
  • A motivated growth mindset and life-long learner
  • Strong work ethic
  • Competency in using analysis software particularly Hudl/Sportscode
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.

ADDITIONAL REQUIRMENTS:
Applicant must be able to comply with applicable child safety policies provided to applicants by NYCFC
Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as necessary
Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times   

WHAT WE OFFER:
  • Two complimentary tickets to select New York City FC home match
  • Team outings, happy hours, and annual staff gatherings to celebrate our co-workers
  • A dynamic, ambitious, and fun work environment
 
NEW YORK CITY FOOTBALL CLUB OVERVIEW:
At New York City FC, we are on a mission to build this city into one of the soccer capitals of the world. The Club was announced as Major League Soccer’s 20th franchise and is the first and only MLS team located within the five boroughs of New York City. The Club has qualified for the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs nine times over the past 10 seasons, winning MLS Cup in 2021. Games are available to stream via an Apple TV subscription, providing every match of the MLS regular season, the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs, annual Leagues Cup tournament, the MLS All-Star Game, the Campeones Cup, and more all in one place and with no blackouts. New York City FC is building New York City’s first-ever soccer-specific stadium, Etihad Park, which is set to open in 2027. For more information, please visit: www.newyorkcityfc.com.
 
New York City FC is also one of 12 clubs comprising City Football Group and counts Manchester City FC, Melbourne City FC, Yokohama F-Marinos, Girona FC, Montevideo City Torque, Shenzhen Peng City FC, Lommel SK, ESTAC Troyes, Palermo FC, Bahia, and Club Bolívar among its sister clubs.
 
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

POSITION OVERVIEW:
As an Academy Coach you will have the responsibility to contribute to the continued development of several Academy age groups. You will be responsible for the delivery of the NYCFC coaching philosophy and supporting Individual Development Plans for the players. You will contribute to the interdisciplinary team achieving individual and team goals. It is important that you are willing and able to work together across departments and other age groups. 
 
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
As an Academy coach, you are responsible for creating a learning environment, with the balance of challenges and support to each individual player. You are responsible to maximize the potential of every player through delivery of the NYCFC game model and methodology 
  • Responsible for the delivery and content of all daily training sessions and match preparation together with support staff.
  • Collaborate with the other Academy teams/staff and maintain relationships with appropriate stakeholders; both internal and external. 
  • Responsible for planning, delivering, and reviewing coaching practice according to the NYCFC methodology with an action orientated attitude, striving to continually improve. 
  • Work from a periodization model and conduct practice designs to enhance the learning and understanding of NYCF’s game model. 
  • Collaboratively work with the other Academy coaches to deliver 1-to-1 player development support through progressive Individual Development Plans with ongoing specific actionable feedback.
  • Understand and adhere to all Competition Guidelines in all entered competitions 
  • Representation of NYCFC in a positive manner within all required responsibilities, 
  • Responsible for the continued development and matriculation of Academy players to progress in our system.
  • Responsible for engaging, and ensuring timely input, into all the Academy platforms and software (SmartaBase, Taka, etc) 
 
WHAT YOU’LL BRING:
  • 5+ experience coaching youth academy level.
  • USSF ‘B or A’ license – minimum (required) 
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work multidisciplinary in the context of Soccer. 
  • Valid driver’s license 
  • Knowledge of Microsoft office; PowerPoint, Word, and Excel
  • Knowledge of tactical periodization and how to implement it.
  • A growth mindset and willingness to join the team with enthusiasm and curiosity.

  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as necessary
  • Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times

  • Team outings, happy hours, and annual staff gatherings to celebrate our co-workers
  • A dynamic, ambitious, and fun work environment

job.title: Senior Director, Maintenance & Safety
job.html_description:
JOB TITLE: Senior Director, Maintenance & Safety
REPORTING TO: Head of Stadium Facilities Management
DEPARTMENT: Facility Operations
LOCATION: Etihad Stadium, Queens – this role is fully onsite. CFA, Orangeburg when required

POSITION OVERVIEW:
New York City FC is seeking a highly experienced and strategic Senior Director, Maintenance & Safety to lead all aspects of stadium maintenance, asset management, engineering operations, life safety systems, and workplace safety programs.
This role will be responsible for ensuring Etihad Stadium and associated facilities are maintained to the highest standards of safety, reliability, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest experience. The Senior Director will oversee multidisciplinary maintenance and engineering teams, manage third-party service providers, and drive continuous improvement across all facility operations.
A critical component of this role will be supporting the transition from construction to operations by leading maintenance, asset management, and safety readiness activities through project closeout, commissioning, and stadium activation. The successful candidate will ensure building systems, processes, and personnel are fully prepared for long-term operational success.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:
Stadium Commissioning & Operational Readiness
  • Provide operational and maintenance expertise during the construction closeout and stadium activation phases.
  • Review design documentation and building systems to support maintainability, operational efficiency, and long-term asset performance.
  • Participate in coordination meetings with architects, engineers, contractors, and project teams throughout closeout and turnover activities.
  • Lead operational readiness planning, including participation in system commissioning, integrated testing, acceptance processes, and occupancy preparation.
  • Validate operation and maintenance manuals, warranties, as-built documentation, and turnover requirements.
  • Ensure all building systems meet applicable accessibility, life safety, code, and regulatory requirements prior to opening.
Maintenance & Asset Management
  • Direct all day-to-day maintenance operations across the stadium campus and associated facilities.
  • Develop and oversee preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs that maximize asset reliability while minimizing operational disruption.
  • Establish and maintain enterprise asset management strategies, including lifecycle planning and capital renewal programs.
  • Ensure the effective operation, maintenance, and reliability of all facility systems, including: 
    • HVAC systems
    • Electrical distribution systems
    • Plumbing systems
    • Fire protection and life safety systems
    • Elevators and escalators
    • Building automation systems (BAS/BMS)
    • Roofing and building envelope systems
    • Structural components and mechanical equipment
  • Lead implementation, optimization, and ongoing performance management of the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
  • Coordinate rapid response and recovery efforts for equipment failures, facility issues, and operational interruptions.
Safety, Risk Management & Compliance
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve workplace health, safety, and environmental programs in accordance with OSHA, New York State, New York City, fire code, and industry standards.
  • Maintain and oversee the stadium's Safety Management System (SMS).
  • Foster a culture of safety, accountability, operational discipline, and continuous improvement across all teams and contractors.
  • Lead incident investigations, corrective action programs, safety inspections, audits, and risk assessments.
  • Manage permit-to-work processes and ensure safe execution of all maintenance and contractor activities.
  • Maintain compliance with all regulatory, safety, environmental, inspection, certification, and documentation requirements.
Contractor & Vendor Management
  • Procure, negotiate, and manage maintenance service agreements and vendor contracts.
  • Establish performance standards and accountability measures for contractors and service providers.
  • Monitor contractor performance, quality of service, safety compliance, onboarding requirements, and adherence to applicable warranties and service agreements.
  • Ensure contractor activities are conducted in accordance with all stadium safety, operational, and regulatory requirements.
Event Operations & Facility Support
  • Provide engineering and maintenance leadership during sporting events, concerts, and other venue activities.
  • Ensure facilities and critical systems are operationally ready before, during, and after events.
  • Serve as a key operational leader during emergencies, business continuity incidents, and crowd-safety situations.
Capital Projects & Continuous Improvement
  • Support planning, execution, and delivery of capital improvement projects, renovations, and new installations.
  • Provide technical oversight to ensure new assets are effectively commissioned, documented, and integrated into operational maintenance programs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, asset performance, reliability, and service delivery.
Financial Management & Strategic Planning
  • Develop, manage, and administer departmental operating and capital budgets.
  • Monitor expenditures and identify opportunities for cost optimization and operational efficiencies.
  • Prepare business cases and recommendations for asset replacement, capital investment, and long-term facility improvements.
  • Provide executive-level reporting on asset performance, maintenance KPIs, safety performance, operational trends, and capital planning initiatives.
Leadership & Team Development
  • Lead and develop a high-performing Maintenance & Safety organization, including engineers, skilled trades personnel, and third-party contractors.
  • Establish department objectives, KPIs, staffing plans, operational procedures, and workforce development strategies.
  • Develop training programs that support operational performance, safety compliance, and business needs.
  • Promote collaboration, accountability, customer service, and continuous improvement throughout the department and across the organization.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING: 
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in facility maintenance, engineering, or building operations, including significant leadership responsibility within large, complex facilities. 
  • Experience in stadiums, arenas, airports, convention centers, healthcare facilities, large entertainment venues, or similarly complex environments preferred. 
  • Demonstrated success leading maintenance operations, engineering teams, contractors, and capital projects. 
  • Experience implementing and utilizing CMMS and asset management systems. 
  • Experience with Willow technology platforms strongly preferred. 
  • Strong working knowledge of Building Automation Systems (BAS/BMS). 
  • Knowledge of unionized work environments and labor relations preferred. 
  • Proven ability to lead effectively during emergencies, operational disruptions, and time-sensitive situations. 
  • Strong people leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills. 
  • Experience managing operating and capital budgets. 
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Construction Management, Occupational Safety, or a related discipline preferred. 
  • Professional certifications such as CFM, FMP, CMRP, CSP, CHFM, NEBOSH, or equivalent are preferred. 
  • Collaborative mindset with the flexibility to support broader organizational and operational objectives as needed.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
  • Applicant must be able to comply with MLS Next Safety and Well-Being policy and any other applicable child safety policies provided to applicants by NYCFC
  • Must be able to work at all or most of the major scheduled events which may be at night and on weekends and holidays
  • Must be able to regularly traverse a multi-level industrial stadium campus, including access tunnels, seating bowls, mechanical rooms, and confined utility areas during high-density event windows.
  • Must be able to observe, inspect, and interpret technical building schematics, digital building automation system alarms, machinery gauges, and potential physical hazards.
  • Must be able to withstand regular exposure to outdoor weather elements during stadium walk-throughs and events, heavy mechanical machinery noise, localized dust, electrical currents, and industrial environments.
  • Calm under pressure and able to work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders. 

COMPENSATION:
This exempt position has an estimated annual base salary range of $155,000 - $175,000 and is not overtime eligible. Final compensation offer amounts are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to demonstrated skill set, years and depth of relevant experience, and some role-dependent factors such as certifications and software expertise. We welcome direct conversations with each candidate about compensation in all of our initial calls.

WHAT WE OFFER:
  • Excellent health, dental & vision insurance, with options to fit you and your family’s needs
  • Comprehensive and competitive benefit programs, including maternal & paternal leave
  • Ancillary benefits: Commuter, and Citi Bike discounts
  • Your health is important! Our wellness strategy focuses on mental and physical wellbeing through in-office and virtual programs
  • Four complementary tickets to every NYCFC home match
  • Team outings, happy hours, and annual staff gatherings to celebrate our co-workers
  • A dynamic, ambitious, and fun work environment

job.plain_text_description:
JOB TITLE: Senior Director, Maintenance & Safety REPORTING TO:Head of Stadium Facilities Management DEPARTMENT: Facility Operations LOCATION:Etihad Stadium, Queens – this role is fully onsite. CFA, Orangeburg when required
POSITION OVERVIEW: New York City FC is seeking a highly experienced and strategic Senior Director, Maintenance & Safety to lead all aspects of stadium maintenance, asset management, engineering operations, life safety systems, and workplace safety programs. This role will be responsible for ensuring Etihad Stadium and associated facilities are maintained to the highest standards of safety, reliability, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest experience. The Senior Director will oversee multidisciplinary maintenance and engineering teams, manage third-party service providers, and drive continuous improvement across all facility operations. A critical component of this role will be supporting the transition from construction to operations by leading maintenance, asset management, and safety readiness activities through project closeout, commissioning, and stadium activation. The successful candidate will ensure building systems, processes, and personnel are fully prepared for long-term operational success.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:Stadium Commissioning & Operational Readiness
- Provide operational and maintenance expertise during the construction closeout and stadium activation phases. - Review design documentation and building systems to support maintainability, operational efficiency, and long-term asset performance. - Participate in coordination meetings with architects, engineers, contractors, and project teams throughout closeout and turnover activities. - Lead operational readiness planning, including participation in system commissioning, integrated testing, acceptance processes, and occupancy preparation. - Validate operation and maintenance manuals, warranties, as-built documentation, and turnover requirements. - Ensure all building systems meet applicable accessibility, life safety, code, and regulatory requirements prior to opening.
Maintenance & Asset Management
- Direct all day-to-day maintenance operations across the stadium campus and associated facilities. - Develop and oversee preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs that maximize asset reliability while minimizing operational disruption. - Establish and maintain enterprise asset management strategies, including lifecycle planning and capital renewal programs. - Ensure the effective operation, maintenance, and reliability of all facility systems, including: HVAC systemsElectrical distribution systemsPlumbing systemsFire protection and life safety systemsElevators and escalatorsBuilding automation systems (BAS/BMS)Roofing and building envelope systemsStructural components and mechanical equipment - Lead implementation, optimization, and ongoing performance management of the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). - Coordinate rapid response and recovery efforts for equipment failures, facility issues, and operational interruptions.
Safety, Risk Management & Compliance
- Develop, implement, and continuously improve workplace health, safety, and environmental programs in accordance with OSHA, New York State, New York City, fire code, and industry standards. - Maintain and oversee the stadium's Safety Management System (SMS). - Foster a culture of safety, accountability, operational discipline, and continuous improvement across all teams and contractors. - Lead incident investigations, corrective action programs, safety inspections, audits, and risk assessments. - Manage permit-to-work processes and ensure safe execution of all maintenance and contractor activities. - Maintain compliance with all regulatory, safety, environmental, inspection, certification, and documentation requirements.
Contractor & Vendor Management
- Procure, negotiate, and manage maintenance service agreements and vendor contracts. - Establish performance standards and accountability measures for contractors and service providers. - Monitor contractor performance, quality of service, safety compliance, onboarding requirements, and adherence to applicable warranties and service agreements. - Ensure contractor activities are conducted in accordance with all stadium safety, operational, and regulatory requirements.
Event Operations & Facility Support
- Provide engineering and maintenance leadership during sporting events, concerts, and other venue activities. - Ensure facilities and critical systems are operationally ready before, during, and after events. - Serve as a key operational leader during emergencies, business continuity incidents, and crowd-safety situations.
Capital Projects & Continuous Improvement
- Support planning, execution, and delivery of capital improvement projects, renovations, and new installations. - Provide technical oversight to ensure new assets are effectively commissioned, documented, and integrated into operational maintenance programs. - Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, asset performance, reliability, and service delivery.
Financial Management & Strategic Planning
- Develop, manage, and administer departmental operating and capital budgets. - Monitor expenditures and identify opportunities for cost optimization and operational efficiencies. - Prepare business cases and recommendations for asset replacement, capital investment, and long-term facility improvements. - Provide executive-level reporting on asset performance, maintenance KPIs, safety performance, operational trends, and capital planning initiatives.
Leadership & Team Development
- Lead and develop a high-performing Maintenance & Safety organization, including engineers, skilled trades personnel, and third-party contractors. - Establish department objectives, KPIs, staffing plans, operational procedures, and workforce development strategies. - Develop training programs that support operational performance, safety compliance, and business needs. - Promote collaboration, accountability, customer service, and continuous improvement throughout the department and across the organization.
WHAT YOU’LL BRING:
- 10+ years of progressive experience in facility maintenance, engineering, or building operations, including significant leadership responsibility within large, complex facilities. - Experience in stadiums, arenas, airports, convention centers, healthcare facilities, large entertainment venues, or similarly complex environments preferred. - Demonstrated success leading maintenance operations, engineering teams, contractors, and capital projects. - Experience implementing and utilizing CMMS and asset management systems. - Experience with Willow technology platforms strongly preferred. - Strong working knowledge of Building Automation Systems (BAS/BMS). - Knowledge of unionized work environments and labor relations preferred. - Proven ability to lead effectively during emergencies, operational disruptions, and time-sensitive situations. - Strong people leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills. - Experience managing operating and capital budgets. - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Construction Management, Occupational Safety, or a related discipline preferred. - Professional certifications such as CFM, FMP, CMRP, CSP, CHFM, NEBOSH, or equivalent are preferred. - Collaborative mindset with the flexibility to support broader organizational and operational objectives as needed.
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Applicant must be able to comply with MLS Next Safety and Well-Being policy and any other applicable child safety policies provided to applicants by NYCFC - Must be able to work at all or most of the major scheduled events which may be at night and on weekends and holidays - Must be able to regularly traverse a multi-level industrial stadium campus, including access tunnels, seating bowls, mechanical rooms, and confined utility areas during high-density event windows. - Must be able to observe, inspect, and interpret technical building schematics, digital building automation system alarms, machinery gauges, and potential physical hazards. - Must be able to withstand regular exposure to outdoor weather elements during stadium walk-throughs and events, heavy mechanical machinery noise, localized dust, electrical currents, and industrial environments. - Calm under pressure and able to work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders.
COMPENSATION:This exempt position has an estimated annual base salary range of $155,000 - $175,000 and is not overtime eligible. Final compensation offer amounts are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to demonstrated skill set, years and depth of relevant experience, and some role-dependent factors such as certifications and software expertise. We welcome direct conversations with each candidate about compensation in all of our initial calls.
WHAT WE OFFER:
- Excellent health, dental & vision insurance, with options to fit you and your family’s needs - Comprehensive and competitive benefit programs, including maternal & paternal leave - Ancillary benefits: Commuter, and Citi Bike discounts - Your health is important! Our wellness strategy focuses on mental and physical wellbeing through in-office and virtual programs - Four complementary tickets to every NYCFC home match - Team outings, happy hours, and annual staff gatherings to celebrate our co-workers - A dynamic, ambitious, and fun work environment

job.title: Media Relations Gameday Associate
job.html_description:
TITLE: Media Relations Gameday Associate 
DEPARTMENT: Communications        
LOCATION: New York City, NY 
COMPENSATION: $18.50/ hour (part-time) 
 
POSITION OVERVIEW: 
New York City FC is seeking part-time seasonal Media Relations Gameday Associates who are looking to start their career in Sports Communications. These individuals will assist the Communications Department to execute the media operations at New York City FC (First Team) and New York City FC II (Second Team) home games. The Media Relations Gameday Associate will report to the Director, Media Relations and Manager, Media Relations and assist with gameday responsibilities which include media information distribution, press box operations, media credentialing assistance, stat keeping, photo marshaling, facilitating post-match press conference and player availability, quote transcriptions and compiling post-match notes.  
 
Individuals chosen for this role must be available to work a majority of home games, including nights, weekends and odd hours as assigned, based on the First Team and Second Team regular season and postseason schedule across all of the Club’s home venues. This is an opportunity to gain valuable sports communications experience while working in a dynamic matchday environment. 
 
WHAT YOU’LL DO: 
  • Assist the Communications staff on gamedays in various roles while helping promote the Club’s brand through the media 
  • Assist in press box preparation and management before and after games to ensure a fantastic matchday experience for all attending media and broadcasters 
  • Operate and staff the media check-in, managing credential distribution to media, photographers and guests   
  • Compile key storylines and player milestones throughout the match for the post-match notes, in addition to working with the League to track and keep stats to input into the database 
  • Act as an on-field photo marshal for broadcasters and photographers  
  • Facilitate post-match press conference and player availability, gather audio and transcribe for the inclusion of the post-match notes that are distributed to media  
  • Other duties as assigned by the Director and Manager, Media Relations in preparation for a home match such as publicity recaps, gameday notes, stats, and support at New York City FC Communications activations  
 
WHAT YOU’LL BRING: 
  • College graduate or currently enrolled in an accredited College or University, working towards a bachelor’s degree in public relations, Communications, Sports Management, or related field  
  • An understanding of media and soccer, with the desire to learn about Communications and sports media operations 
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills 
  • Self-motivated with a high degree of integrity; takes personal responsibility for accomplishing tasks in a way that positively and professionally represents the Club 
  • Excellent attention to detail, organizational & time management skill 
  • Excellent work ethic and ability to learn quickly, with ability to multi-task and prioritize workload 
  • Flexible schedule, with availability to work nights, weekends and odd hours as assigned, based on the NYCFC and NYCFC II regular season and postseason schedules 
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite  
  • Knowledge of Spanish and Portuguese is a plus, but not required  
 
ADDITIONAL REQUIRMENTS:  
  • Applicant must be able to comply with MLS Next Safety and Well-Being policy and any other applicable child safety policies provided to applicants by NYCFC  
  
WHAT WE OFFER:  
  • Two complimentary tickets to each home match  
  • Medical benefits through a third-party provider  
  • Team outings, happy hours, and annual staff gatherings to celebrate our co-workers   
  • A dynamic, ambitious, and fun work environment

job.title: Performance Coach - NYCFC II
job.html_description:
JOB TITLE: Performance Coach - NYCFC II
DEPARTMENT: Sporting
REPORTING TO: VP, Performance                                                  
LOCATION: City Football Academy (Orangeburg, NY)

POSITION OVERVIEW 
Athletic development is central to the long-term progress and performance of our players. At New York City Football Club, we believe a consistent, evidence-informed approach to physical development is essential to building robustness, supporting injury resilience, and creating the physical foundation for sustained sporting success. 
The Performance Coach will support the planning, delivery, and evaluation of the NYCFC II physical development program. Working within an interdisciplinary, first-team-aligned performance model, this role will provide high-quality support across strength and conditioning, recovery, nutrition, athlete monitoring, fitness testing, training-load management, and return-to-play processes. 
The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with excellent communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills. They will be committed to helping young players develop the habits, knowledge, and resilience required to thrive both as athletes and as people.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 
  • Plan, deliver, and evaluate individual and team-based physical development programs aligned with NYCFC’s first-team performance philosophy. 
  • Deliver strength and conditioning sessions, warm-ups, recovery strategies, athlete monitoring, fitness testing, and training-load management for NYCFC II players. 
  • Develop and implement appropriate return-to-play protocols in collaboration with athletic training, medical, coaching, and performance staff. 
  • Manage the collection, analysis, reporting, and practical application of performance data, including GPS and other athlete-monitoring technologies. 
  • Use data and professional judgment to provide clear, timely, and actionable feedback to players and coaches. 
  • Support NYCFC II coaches with the planning, delivery, and review of training sessions. 
  • Contribute to the continued development and implementation of NYCFC’s Human Performance philosophy across the Club. 
  • Support the physical development assessment and monitoring of players within the Elite Development pathway. 
  • Assist with the practical delivery of appropriate nutrition and hydration strategies for training, matches, travel, and recovery. 
  • Build effective working relationships with NYCFC II coaches, athletic trainers, analysts, Academy staff, first-team performance staff, and other key stakeholders. 
  • Educate players on training, recovery, nutrition, lifestyle habits, and personal responsibility in a way that supports long-term development. 
  • Maintain accurate records, communicate effectively, and uphold the professional standards expected within NYCFC. 

WHAT YOU’LL BRING
Required Competencies and Experience 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Sport and Exercise Science, Kinesiology, or related discipline (Master’s degree preferred) 
  • A recognized strength and conditioning qualification, such as the CSCS 
  • At least two years of paid experience working as a strength and conditioning or performance coach in a team-sport environment 
  • Demonstrated experience supporting the development of young or emerging athletes 
  • Practical experience designing and delivering strength, conditioning, recovery, monitoring, and return-to-play programs 
  • The ability to interpret performance data and translate findings into clear recommendations for players and staff 
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and communicate effectively across an interdisciplinary team 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and PowerPoint 
  • A professional, organized, and detail-oriented approach to data management and daily operations 
Preferred Experience 
  • Experience using STATSports GPS or comparable athlete-monitoring systems. 
  • Experience using VALD technologies, including NordBord, ForceFrame, and ForceDecks. 
  • Experience working within a professional soccer or high-performance sporting environment. 
  • Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese. 

HOW YOU’LL WORK 
The ideal candidate will: 
  • Put the player and the player’s long-term development at the center of their work. 
  • Communicate clearly, respectfully, and proactively with players and colleagues. 
  • Collaborate openly and contribute positively to an interdisciplinary team. 
  • Apply evidence-informed practice while remaining adaptable to the individual needs of each player. 
  • Demonstrate sound judgment, accountability, and professionalism in a high-performance environment. 
  • Be curious, reflective, and committed to continuous learning. 
  • Create a demanding yet supportive environment in which players feel challenged, respected, and empowered to improve. 
  • Consistently model the standards, habits, and behaviors expected of NYCFC players.

WHO YOU ARE:  
At New York FC, we are committed to upholding our core club values and our values guide how we show up and work together every day.  If you share our values listed below, please consider NYCFC as a great place for you to work (and play): 
  • Acts Honorably: listens and communicates respectfully, without judgement 
  • Engages Collaboratively: provides and seeks constructive feedback to and from peers, proactively sharing appreciation for quality contributions of others 
  • Champions Inclusion: celebrates the value of differences recognizing the value in the unique backgrounds and lived experiences of every team member 
  • Drives Forward: embraces new opportunities with curiosity and a focus on improvement and innovation 
  • Shows Heart: demonstrates passion for the Club and sport, operating as an NYCFC ambassador in encouraging and inspiring that passion in others 
 
KEY RELATIONSHIPS 
  • Vice President, Performance 
  • Athletic Trainer – NYCFCII 
  • Fitness Coach – 1st Team 
  • Performance Coach – 1st Team 
  • Director of Performance Services – Academy 
  • NYCFC II and Academy Coaches & Administrators 

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: 
  • Applicant must be able to comply with MLS Next Safety and Well-Being policy and any other applicable child safety policies provided to applicants by NYCFC. 
  • Must be able to work games scheduled which may be at night and on weekends and holidays. 

COMPENSATION:
This exempt position has an estimated annual base salary of $70,000. Final compensation offer amounts are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to demonstrated skill set, years and depth of relevant experience, and some role-dependent factors such as certifications and software expertise. We welcome direct conversations with each candidate about compensation in all of our initial calls.

WHAT WE OFFER: 
  • Excellent health, dental & vision insurance, with options to fit you and your family’s needs. 
  • Comprehensive and competitive benefit programs, including maternal & paternal leave. 
  • Ancillary benefits: Commuter, gym membership, and Citi Bike discounts. 
  • Your health is important! Our wellness strategy focuses on mental and physical wellbeing through in-office and virtual programs. 
  • Four complementary tickets to every NYCFC home match. 
  • Team outings, happy hours, and annual staff gatherings to celebrate our co-workers. 
  • A dynamic, ambitious, and fun work environment.

job.plain_text_description:
JOB TITLE:Performance Coach - NYCFC II
DEPARTMENT:Sporting
REPORTING TO:VP, Performance
LOCATION:City Football Academy (Orangeburg, NY)
POSITION OVERVIEW
Athletic development is central to the long-term progress and performance of our players. At New York City Football Club, we believe a consistent, evidence-informed approach to physical development is essential to building robustness, supporting injury resilience, and creating the physical foundation for sustained sporting success.
The Performance Coach will support the planning, delivery, and evaluation of the NYCFC II physical development program. Working within an interdisciplinary, first-team-aligned performance model, this role will provide high-quality support across strength and conditioning, recovery, nutrition, athlete monitoring, fitness testing, training-load management, and return-to-play processes.
The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with excellent communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills. They will be committed to helping young players develop the habits, knowledge, and resilience required to thrive both as athletes and as people.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
- Plan, deliver, and evaluate individual and team-based physical development programs aligned with NYCFC’s first-team performance philosophy. - Deliver strength and conditioning sessions, warm-ups, recovery strategies, athlete monitoring, fitness testing, and training-load management for NYCFC II players. - Develop and implement appropriate return-to-play protocols in collaboration with athletic training, medical, coaching, and performance staff. - Manage the collection, analysis, reporting, and practical application of performance data, including GPS and other athlete-monitoring technologies. - Use data and professional judgment to provide clear, timely, and actionable feedback to players and coaches. - Support NYCFC II coaches with the planning, delivery, and review of training sessions. - Contribute to the continued development and implementation of NYCFC’s Human Performance philosophy across the Club. - Support the physical development assessment and monitoring of players within the Elite Development pathway. - Assist with the practical delivery of appropriate nutrition and hydration strategies for training, matches, travel, and recovery. - Build effective working relationships with NYCFC II coaches, athletic trainers, analysts, Academy staff, first-team performance staff, and other key stakeholders. - Educate players on training, recovery, nutrition, lifestyle habits, and personal responsibility in a way that supports long-term development. - Maintain accurate records, communicate effectively, and uphold the professional standards expected within NYCFC.
WHAT YOU’LL BRING Required Competencies and Experience
- Bachelor’s degree in Sport and Exercise Science, Kinesiology, or related discipline (Master’s degree preferred) - A recognized strength and conditioning qualification, such as the CSCS - At least two years of paid experience working as a strength and conditioning or performance coach in a team-sport environment - Demonstrated experience supporting the development of young or emerging athletes - Practical experience designing and delivering strength, conditioning, recovery, monitoring, and return-to-play programs - The ability to interpret performance data and translate findings into clear recommendations for players and staff - Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and communicate effectively across an interdisciplinary team - Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and PowerPoint - A professional, organized, and detail-oriented approach to data management and daily operations
Preferred Experience
- Experience using STATSports GPS or comparable athlete-monitoring systems. - Experience using VALD technologies, including NordBord, ForceFrame, and ForceDecks. - Experience working within a professional soccer or high-performance sporting environment. - Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese.
HOW YOU’LL WORK
The ideal candidate will:
- Put the player and the player’s long-term development at the center of their work. - Communicate clearly, respectfully, and proactively with players and colleagues. - Collaborate openly and contribute positively to an interdisciplinary team. - Apply evidence-informed practice while remaining adaptable to the individual needs of each player. - Demonstrate sound judgment, accountability, and professionalism in a high-performance environment. - Be curious, reflective, and committed to continuous learning. - Create a demanding yet supportive environment in which players feel challenged, respected, and empowered to improve. - Consistently model the standards, habits, and behaviors expected of NYCFC players.
WHO YOU ARE:
At New York FC, we are committed to upholding our core club values and our values guide how we show up and work together every day. If you share our values listed below, please consider NYCFC as a great place for you to work (and play):
- Acts Honorably: listens and communicates respectfully, without judgement - Engages Collaboratively: provides and seeks constructive feedback to and from peers, proactively sharing appreciation for quality contributions of others - Champions Inclusion: celebrates the value of differences recognizing the value in the unique backgrounds and lived experiences of every team member - Drives Forward: embraces new opportunities with curiosity and a focus on improvement and innovation - Shows Heart: demonstrates passion for the Club and sport, operating as an NYCFC ambassador in encouraging and inspiring that passion in others
KEY RELATIONSHIPS
- Vice President, Performance - Athletic Trainer – NYCFCII - Fitness Coach – 1st Team - Performance Coach – 1st Team - Director of Performance Services – Academy - NYCFC II and Academy Coaches & Administrators
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Applicant must be able to comply with MLS Next Safety and Well-Being policy and any other applicable child safety policies provided to applicants by NYCFC. - Must be able to work games scheduled which may be at night and on weekends and holidays.
COMPENSATION: This exempt position has an estimated annual base salary of $70,000. Final compensation offer amounts are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to demonstrated skill set, years and depth of relevant experience, and some role-dependent factors such as certifications and software expertise. We welcome direct conversations with each candidate about compensation in all of our initial calls.
WHAT WE OFFER:
- Excellent health, dental & vision insurance, with options to fit you and your family’s needs. - Comprehensive and competitive benefit programs, including maternal & paternal leave. - Ancillary benefits: Commuter, gym membership, and Citi Bike discounts. - Your health is important! Our wellness strategy focuses on mental and physical wellbeing through in-office and virtual programs. - Four complementary tickets to every NYCFC home match. - Team outings, happy hours, and annual staff gatherings to celebrate our co-workers. - A dynamic, ambitious, and fun work environment.
NEW YORK CITY FOOTBALL CLUB OVERVIEW: At New York City FC, we are on a mission to build this city into one of the soccer capitals of the world. The Club was announced as Major League Soccer’s 20th franchise and is the first and only MLS team located within the five boroughs of New York City. The Club has qualified for the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs nine times over the past 10 seasons, winning MLS Cup in 2021. job.title: Team Operations - Academy Team Administrator
job.html_description:
TITLE: Team Administrator – Academy
DEPARTMENT: Team Operations
REPORTS TO: Head of Academy Operations
FLSA: Full-time; Exempt

 

WHAT SETS YOU APART

The Team Administrator will provide comprehensive administrative and operational support across the Academy’s Pre-Formation and Formation age groups. This role will work closely with the Head of Academy Operations, Director of Soccer Operations, and Academy Director.  This role will be an integral piece ensuring smooth day-to-day delivery of Academy programming in alignment with MLS standards, Orlando City SC operational expectations, and safeguarding requirements.

 

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented, with experience supporting elite youth soccer environments. This individual will serve as a central point of coordination for players, parents, coaches, and external stakeholders while ensuring all operational, registration, scheduling, travel, and compliance processes are delivered to a high professional standard.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

 

  • Provide full administrative and operational support for all Pre-Formation and Formation age groups across training, fixtures, tournaments, showcases, and special events.
  • Coordinate and maintain all phase-specific schedules, calendars, and communications through Teamworks and other club communication platforms.
  • Serve as a primary administrative contact for players, parents, coaches, and support staff within assigned age groups.
  • Assist with the day-to-day operational delivery of academy programming in accordance with MLS standards and club policies.
  • Maintain accurate academy records, player files, attendance tracking, registration documentation, and operational reports.
  • Support the Head of Academy Operations with academy-wide operational projects and initiatives.
  • Support the organization and execution of MLS events, tournaments, festivals, friendlies, and showcase competitions.
  • Coordinate communication with internal departments, including facilities, groundskeeping, security, and medical staff, to ensure operational readiness.
  • Assist with all player registration processes through MLS, U.S. Soccer, and applicable federation systems.
  • Support compliance with MLS roster regulations, player movement policies, safeguarding standards, and competition requirements.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of MLS rules, academy standards, and youth player compliance procedures.
  • Assist with international clearance and player documentation processes where applicable.
  • Coordinate team travel arrangements for assigned academy teams in collaboration with the Head of Academy Ops and Finance. 
  • Maintain consistent and professional communication with players and families regarding schedules, travel, programming updates, and operational information.
  • Promote a positive and professional experience that reflects the values and standards of Orlando City SC.
  • Coordinate Academy player housing logistics, including host family placements, housing documentation, onboarding, monitoring, and conclusion of host family agreements in accordance with club policies.
  • All other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

 

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC. It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sports Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum 2–4 years of experience in team operations, Academy administration, or elite youth sports environments preferred.
  • Previous experience working within MLS academies, professional academies, collegiate athletics, or elite youth soccer environments preferred.
  • Knowledge and understanding of MLS rules, youth player registration processes, and Academy operational standards preferred.
  • Experience coordinating logistics, including fixtures, tournaments, travel, and events.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and athlete management platforms such as Teamworks.
  • Strong organizational, administrative, and multitasking skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with players, parents, coaches, and staff.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing positively within a collaborative team environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexible schedule with availability to work evenings, weekends, and travel domestically as required.
  • Bilingual in Spanish or Portuguese preferred but not required.
  • Ability to pass a background screening.
  • Ability to attain and maintain SafeSport certification.

 



About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride: 

 

In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.  

The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons. 

In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.  

The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.

 

In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.

 

In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.  

For more information on Orlando City SC and Orlando, visit OrlandoCitySC.com or Orlando-Pride.com.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

 

Orlando City and Orlando Pride will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the job application or interview process and perform critical job functions. Please contact the People and Culture department at Peopleandculture@orlandocitysc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.
