job.title: Stadium Operations - Sports Turf Specialist
job.html_description:
TITLE:  Sports Turf Specialist, Stadium

DEPARTMENT:  Stadium Operations 
REPORTS TO:  Grounds Supervisor

FLSA:  Full-time Hourly; Non-Exempt 

  

WHAT SETS YOU APART  

Are you a self-motivated individual with physical stamina? Do you love the outdoors and maintaining aesthetically pleasing outdoor space? If so, our Sports Turf Specialist role could be for you. You will be responsible for mowing, fertilization, edging, irrigation troubleshooting and repair, top dressing, aerating, painting, sodding, and record keeping for the Inter.co Stadium. You will get a chance to use a variety of practical skills which are valuable and essential to the overall Club.   

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:  

  • Assist with all operations of field maintenance at Inter.co Stadium to include painting, mowing, irrigation, aerification, chemical application and any special projects as needed 
  • Proactively identify turf grass diseases, weeds, pests, and work with Director of Turf & Grounds and Grounds Supervisor to take corrective action as needed 
  • Assist in equipment and irrigation repair and maintenance 
  • Work MLS games, NWSL games and third party events based on business needs 
  • Create and maintain good working relationships with all MLS and NWSL coaches and soccer operations staff 
  • Participate in procuring equipment and supplies as needed for the facility 
  • Provide coverage at the training facilities as needed 
  • Other duties as assigned 

   

QUALIFICATIONS  

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC and Orlando Pride.  It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Turf Grass Science, Horticulture, or related field preferred. 
  • 1-3 years of grounds maintenance related work experience in soccer 
  • Candidate should possess or have the ability to obtain the Florida Commercial Pesticide Applicator License. 
  • Ability to operate turf related equipment (i.e., tractors, mowers, aerifiers, field paint machine). 
  • Possess excellent written/verbal communication skills, be detail-oriented and highly organized with the ability to simultaneously handle multiple tasks and adapt to change. 
  • Ability to resolve concerns expeditiously and independently. 
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.). 
  • Fluency in Spanish is preferred but not required. 
  • Experience with hosting field events including sporting and concerts, using various field protection systems is a plus. 
  • Ability to perform physical labor for extended periods of time and in various weather conditions. 
  • Able to work flexible hours including nights, weekends, and holidays. 
  • Ability to walk and stand for short periods of time. 
  • The ability to attain and maintain Safesport certification. 
  • The ability to pass a background screening. 


About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride: 

 

In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.

In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons. 

In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.  

The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.

job.title: Training Facilities - Sports Turf Specialist, OHP
job.html_description:
TITLE:  Sports Turf Specialist, OHP 

DEPARTMENT:  Training Facilities 
REPORTS TO:  Head Groundskeeper, OHP 

FLSA: Full-Time, hourly; Non-exempt 

  

WHAT SETS YOU APART 

We are looking for a skilled and proactive Sports Turf Specialist to join our team at the Orlando Health Training Ground at Osceola Heritage Park.  You will be responsible for mowing, fertilization, edging, irrigation, troubleshooting and repair, top dressing, aerating, painting, sodding, and record keeping for the Inter.co Stadium. You will get a chance to use a variety of practical skills which are valuable and essential to the overall Club.   

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Assist with field maintenance of (3) natural grass fields and (1) turf field at the Orlando Health Training Ground at Osceola Heritage Park to include mowing, fertilization, edging, irrigation, troubleshooting and repair, top dressing, aerating, painting, sodding, and any special projects as needed 
  • Proactively identify turf grass diseases, weeds, and pests, and work with the Head Groundskeeper to take corrective action as needed 
  • Collaborate with Director of Turf & Grounds to ensure field conditions are to the team and MLS/MLS Next Pro standards 
  • Work MLS games, NWSL games and third-party events at Inter.co Stadium based on business needs 
  • Assist with Orlando City B game coverage at Osceola County Stadium based on business needs 
  • Create and maintain good working relationships with all MLS coaches and soccer operations staff 
  • Other duties as assigned 

 

QUALIFICATIONS 

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC.  It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications: 

  • Must possess a High School diploma or G.E.D. or equivalent 
  • Must possess a valid Florida Driver’s License 
  • 1-3 years of grounds maintenance-related work experience, with soccer-specific experience preferred 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Turf Grass Science, Horticulture, or related field preferred. 
  • Candidate should possess or have the ability to obtain the Florida Commercial Pesticide Applicator License 
  • Ability to operate turf-related equipment (i.e., tractors, mowers, aerifiers, field paint machines). 
  • Possess excellent written/verbal communication skills, be detail-oriented and highly organized with the ability to simultaneously handle multiple tasks and adapt to change. 
  • Ability to resolve concerns expeditiously and independently. 
  • Ability to perform physical labor for extended periods of time and in various weather conditions. 
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.). 
  • The ability to attain and maintain Safesport certification. 
  • The ability to pass a background screening.  
  • Fluency in Spanish is preferred but not required. 
  • Ability to walk and stand for short periods of time. 
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

 



About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride: 

 

In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.  

The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons. 

In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.  

The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.

 

In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.

 

In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.  

For more information on Orlando City SC and Orlando, visit OrlandoCitySC.com or Orlando-Pride.com.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

 

Orlando City and Orlando Pride will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the job application or interview process and perform critical job functions. Please contact the People and Culture department at Peopleandculture@orlandocitysc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Team Operations - Academy Formation Phase Assistant Coach
job.html_description:
TITLE: Formation Phase Assistant Coach

DEPARTMENT:  Soccer Operations
REPORTS TO:  Academy Director

FLSA: Full-Time; Exempt

 

WHAT SETS YOU APART

The Formation Phase Assistant Coach is responsible for supporting the academy team in both player and team development and the day-to-day operations of the formation phase. The Assistant Coach will assist with the team, including supporting training practices and games. The successful candidate will report to the Academy Director.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & REPONSIBILITIES

  • Support and assist Head Coaches and all academy staff.
  • Implement the club methodology, effective practice, and game plans through the Academy Curriculum, style of play, and periodization.
  • Support all team practices and training sessions.
  • Use session planning tools and video platforms to ensure that all relevant player data is recorded.
  • Lead and support preparation for all games, including developing game strategies, team meetings, and scouting opposing teams.
  • Support and deliver Individual Development Plans (IDP) and training for Formation Phase Teams.
  • Assists in the scouting and evaluation of potential players for the team.
  • Communicate with Academy Scouts frequently to identify and report talent.
  • Enforces team rules and league rules applicable to players and coaching staff.
  • Assist and support coaches in the general control, management, and conduct of Academy players, ensuring adherence to the Academy Code of Conduct.
  • Assist with other age groups with training and game day when needed.
  • Other duties assigned by Academy Director.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • USSF ‘B’ or ‘C’ License or Equivalent
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience working in elite soccer.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organizational and leadership skills.
  • Collaborative management style – an advocate of team concepts. 
  • Positive influencer, comfortable with leading dynamic change.
  • Must be able to work long hours, weekends, and some holidays.
  • Ability to attain and maintain SafeSport certification.
  • Ability to pass a background check.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • USSF A License
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English) or multi-lingual fluency
  • Experience, familiarity, and network within OCSC Territory is strongly preferred.

job.title: Team Operations - Academy Lead Scout
job.html_description:
TITLE: Academy Lead Scout 

DEPARTMENT: Team Operations

REPORTS TO: Technical Director and Academy Director

FLSA: Full-Time; Exempt

 

WHAT SETS YOU APART

The Academy Lead Scout is responsible for leading both day to day operations and scouting strategies for Orlando City Academy. The Academy Lead Scout will observe, identify and recruit players both in territory and open market territories. The successful candidate will report to the Academy Director and Technical Director.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

 

  • Scout players for the academy teams in Orlando City SC Homegrown Territories.
  • Explore and scout players in MLS Open Territories.
  • Manage Regional and Network Scouts in local and open territories.
  • Observe and write player reports for technical staff.
  • Manage and report scouting database.
  • Scout and recommend players to attend Academy tryouts or Talent ID sessions.
  • Work with Player Development Lead to identify and recruit players.
  • Attend OC Academy training and games where needed.
  • Other duties assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC.  It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:

  • USSF ‘B’ License or Equivalent
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience working in elite soccer
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience working in scouting
  • Proven history of identifying and recruiting players
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent organizational and leadership skills
  • Collaborative management style – an advocate of team concepts
  • Positive influencer, comfortable with leading dynamic change
  • Able to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, within a team atmosphere

 


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • USSF ‘A’ License
  • US Soccer Talent Scout Course
  • Professional Scouting Experience (MLS Academy, MLS Pro/First Team, USYNT)
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English) or multi-lingual fluency
  • Experience, familiarity, and network within OCSC Territory is strongly preferred

job.title: Brand Alliance - Brand Alliance Assistant
job.html_description:
TITLE: Brand Alliances Assistant

DEPARTMENT: Brand Alliances

REPORTS TO: Senior Manager, Brand Alliance Marketing

FLSA: Part Time, Hourly, Seasonal

 

WHAT SETS YOU APART

Brand Alliances at Orlando City SC/Orlando Pride is seeking a hardworking, positive and passionate individual who wants to enhance their knowledge in corporate partnership marketing and corporate partnership development through practical experience in facilitating corporate events, gameday operations, lead generation and prospecting, asset tracking and inventory, contract fulfillment and overall account management. We are seeking someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment with great organizational skills, an unequaled willingness to learn by doing, and the ability to be an innovative problem solver.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Review and comprehend Brand Alliance contracts, analyzing fulfillment needs and strategy.
  • Support the Brand Alliance Marketing team with account management, partner communication, and fulfillment of contractual obligations.
  • Track partner assets and performance.
  • Support Brand Alliances with graphic design needs for existing and prospective partners.
  • Collaborate with internal departments and external vendors to plan and implement in-office/stadium events, gameday promotions, digital/social campaigns, and partner recaps.
  • Assist with prospecting new corporate sponsorship and media partnerships, developing customized proposals and sales presentations, and researching new partnership opportunities.
  • Gain exposure to Brand Alliances business development strategies, including deal structures, premium suite sales, fulfillment, and rate cards.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

Gameday and On-Site Event Responsibilities:

  • Support the sales staff on gameday with prospect and partner communication as needed.
  • Participate in Fan Zone operations, including pregame meetings and gameday responsibilities.
  • Professionally act as liaison between players and partners during off-site appearances and corporate events.
  • Support youth clinics, camps, and partner events by assisting with registration, guest flow, equipment setup, fulfillment of partner assets, and event breakdown.
  • Prepare and support gameday assets, including run of show, Fan Zone activations, gate giveaways, LED fulfillment, and other partner activations.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC and Orlando Pride. It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications: 

  • Applicants preferably should be working toward or recently graduated with an undergraduate or graduate degree with an emphasis in Sports Marketing/Management or a related field.
  • Exceptional reliability, interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Innovative, team-oriented individual who can identify opportunities and develop creative solutions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Able to work all Orlando City SC and Orlando Pride home games, as well as other corporate events throughout the year.
  • Preferred 6 months to 1 year of experience with a sports team/organization, athletic department, or similar field.
  • Experience and/or proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Strong knowledge of social media platforms.
  • A sense of humor is a must—be prepared to share your favorite joke during the interview!
  • Position will work up to 30 hours per week, including gamedays, evenings, weekends, holidays, and select events.
  • Must be comfortable working outdoors and be able to lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to pass a background screening.
  • Ability to attain and maintain SafeSport certification.
  • Strong interest in soccer and sports is a plus.

 

Other Details:

Candidate can be working toward an academic credit for this opportunity.



About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride: 

 

In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.  

The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons. 

In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.  

The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.

 

In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.

 

In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.  

For more information on Orlando City SC and Orlando, visit OrlandoCitySC.com or Orlando-Pride.com.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

 

Orlando City and Orlando Pride will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the job application or interview process and perform critical job functions. Please contact the People and Culture department at Peopleandculture@orlandocitysc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.html_description:
TITLE: Facilities Operations Assistant

DEPARTMENT: Stadium Operations

REPORTS TO: Sr Manager, Stadium Operations

FLSA: Hourly, Part-Time, Non-Exempt

 

WHAT SETS YOU APART

Orlando City SC is seeking hardworking, positive, and passionate individuals looking to gain practical experience supporting key operational functions at a professional soccer stadium and special event venue. The Assistant will have a direct role in supporting the delivery of services, protection and monitoring of facilities, and oversight of vendors providing services. The Assistant will work under the close supervision of the Stadium Operations Manager and facility operations team.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with the facility operations team while observing the planning and execution of sporting and non-sporting stadium events.
  • Learn about and assist with organizing and inspecting stadium storage areas.
  • Learn about and participate in the Inter&Co Stadium Zero Waste sustainability program.
  • Learn about and collaborate with departments across the organization.
  • Assist with general administrative duties specific to Stadium Operations.
  • Learn and demonstrate excellent customer service when interacting with clients and vendors.
  • Learn how to conduct stadium inspections.
  • Participate in assignments related to inventory tracking, departmental activities, and other Stadium Operations initiatives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC. It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:

  • An innovative individual who can contribute ideas, work effectively within a team, develop creative solutions, and identify new opportunities in a high-pressure, fast-changing environment.
  • Availability to work approximately 20–30 hours per week.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Exceptional reliability, interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours and in a variety of settings within a team environment.
  • Flexibility to work nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Ability to attain and maintain SafeSport certification.
  • Ability to pass a background check.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong interest in soccer and sports is a plus.
  • Applicants are not required to be pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree; however, students pursuing a degree in Sport Management, Facility Management, or a related field may be eligible to receive course credit.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Must be able to move and/or lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to walk, run, kneel, climb stairs, and react quickly to unpredictable situations.
  • Must be able to work both indoors and outdoors, with some exposure to adverse weather conditions.

job.title: Stadium Operations - Part Time, Stadium Security Guard
job.html_description:
TITLE: Part-Time Stadium Security Guard

DEPARTMENT: Stadium Operations 
REPORTS TO: Security Manager 

FLSA: Part Time; Non-Exempt 
 

 

WHAT SETS YOU APART

We are looking for an honest, attentive, and perceptive individual to join our Security team. In this role, you will help secure Inter.Co Stadium and protect the Club’s property, guests, teammates, and players. You will help maintain a safe and secure environment while serving as a visible security presence and deterrent to unauthorized or irregular activity.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Patrol Inter.Co Stadium property to monitor and prevent intrusion, damage, hazards, and security breaches.
  • Lock and unlock doors and conduct facility walkthroughs as needed.
  • Provide a visible presence that promotes and enforces safety and security.
  • Monitor activity throughout the facility via closed-circuit television (CCTV).
  • Respond appropriately to emergencies, including but not limited to fire and burglar alarms.
  • Monitor access to the venue on event and non-event days.
  • Assist with event-day security coverage.
  • Identify and address unauthorized persons and violations of security procedures.
  • Contact appropriate authorities regarding unlawful or irregular activity when necessary.
  • Use radios and other communication devices in a clear, concise, and professional manner.
  • Document and report malfunctions, misconduct, incidents, and operational or safety concerns.
  • Interview victims and witnesses and prepare incident reports as necessary.
  • Maintain a professional appearance and demeanor.
  • Implement prescribed emergency procedures when necessary.
  • Assist with the development and implementation of public safety plans for day-to-day operations and special events.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride. It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:

 

  • High school diploma, G.E.D., or equivalent required.
  • College coursework in Criminal Justice, Private Investigations, Homeland Security, Emergency Management, Emergency Medical Services, or another security-related field is preferred. Relevant military experience is also preferred.
  • Six (6) months to one (1) year of security experience, preferably in a similar environment.
  • Bilingual in Spanish or Portuguese is preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to establish rapport and build positive working relationships.
  • Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to successfully complete required background screening and employment verification.
  • Valid Florida driver’s license required.
  • Valid Florida Class “D” Security Officer License required.
  • Appropriate credentials as mandated by state, county, or local law.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Must be able to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to walk, run, kneel, climb stairs, and react quickly to unpredictable situations.
  • Must be able to work both indoors and outdoors, including exposure to varying weather conditions.
  • Must be able to sit or stand for prolonged periods, including while monitoring surveillance equipment.

 

The physical demands described herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the core functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing duties, the employee may be regularly required to stand or sit for extended periods, walk long distances, use hands to handle, hold or feel objects, tools, or controls, reach with arms, and talk or hear. Vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. The employee is required to hear conversations in noisy environments. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. The information contained in this position description is for compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (A.D.A) and is not an exhaustive list of the duties performed by persons holding this position. Additional duties are performed by the individuals currently in these positions and may change from time to time considering immediate operational requirements.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing duties, the employee may be regularly required to stand or sit for extended periods, walk long distances, use hands to handle, hold or feel objects, tools, or controls, reach with arms, and talk or hear. Vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. The employee is required to hear conversations in noisy environments. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. The information contained in this position description is for compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (A.D.A) and is not an exhaustive list of the duties performed by persons holding this position. Additional duties are performed by the individuals currently in these positions and may change from time to time considering immediate operational requirements.
About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride:
In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.
The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons.
In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.
The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.
In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.
In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.

job.title: Brand Alliance - Sr Manager, Partnership Development
job.html_description:
TITLE: Sr. Manager, Partnership Development

DEPARTMENT: Brand Alliances  

REPORTS TO: Director, Partnership Development

FLSA: Full-Time; Exempt

 

WHAT SETS YOU APART

You are an experienced partnership sales professional who builds relationships and is a strategic storyteller who can build fully integrated partnership programs that include assets across the portfolio such as IP rights, in-game signage and entitlements, social & digital content, hospitality, and other unique platforms.

 

You are driven by results and generating new business revenue with local, regional, and national companies through the sale of comprehensive sponsorship packages of the Orlando City SC (MLS), Orlando Pride (NWSL), and Inter&Co Stadium assets.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Prospect and close new corporate sponsorships/partnerships for Orlando City SC, Orlando Pride and Inter&Co Stadium.
  • Establish strong working relationships with local, regional, and national companies to understand individual marketing and business goals and initiatives.
  • Accountable for achieving KPI’s and revenue goals on a yearly basis.
  • Identify key open categories and new industries as prospective new business leads.
  • Generate qualified leads by self-prospecting via research, outbound calls, face-to-face meetings, in-game entertaining, business and community networking events, and social selling.
  • Develop unique and customized proposals and sales presentations for new business prospects.
  • Negotiate and work with the Director of Business Development, VP of Brand Alliances, and Legal Department through execution of partnership contract.
  • Continually manage and update individual sales pipeline through CRM platform to provide accurate, reliable information for sales and renewal forecasting for executive leadership.
  • Work alongside Brand Alliance Marketing team to ensure proper fulfillment of partnership contract.
  • Collaborate with internal departments such as Marketing, Digital, Creative, Merchandise, Public Relations, and Ticket Sales to effectively and efficiently create new partnership assets that drive revenue and are mutually beneficial to the partner and our club.
  • Work game days, weekends, and special events to assist with any activations (as assigned) and entertain existing partners and new business prospects.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC and Orlando Pride.  It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:

 

  • 3+ years of demonstrated success in sports sponsorship, partnership, or new business development required.
  • Proven track record of high-level B2B selling and deal construction with local, regional, and national brands.
  • Strategic storyteller that can craft sophisticated deals beyond basic turnkey assets.
  • Excellent relationship-building and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively influence and communicate with all internal and external clients, especially C-Level executives.
  • Demonstrated professional sales presentation creation and delivery skills.
  • Data-driven sales mindset to efficiently leverage insights from the Business Intelligence team when prospecting and selling new partners 
  • Must be passionate about sales, exhibit high energy, and be self-motivated.
  • Knowledge or ability to learn various sales tools such as Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, SponsorUnited, and Digideck to follow all department and company standard operating procedures.
  • Ability to work well on a team and independently.
  • Professional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, weekends, holidays, and game days.
  • Reliable transportation and ability to travel to offsite client meetings/presentations and networking events.
  • Experience in the Florida marketplace preferred but not required.
  • The ability to pass a background screening.
  • The ability to attain and maintain Safesport certification.
  • Spanish or Portuguese is a plus but not required.


About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride: 

 

In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.  

The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons. 

In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.  

The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.

 

In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.

 

In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.  

For more information on Orlando City SC and Orlando, visit OrlandoCitySC.com or Orlando-Pride.com.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

 

Orlando City and Orlando Pride will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the job application or interview process and perform critical job functions. Please contact the People and Culture department at Peopleandculture@orlandocitysc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Brand Alliance - Manager Brand Alliances Solutions and Insights
job.html_description:
TITLE: Manager, Brand Alliances Solutions & Insights

DEPARTMENT: Brand Alliances
REPORTS TO: Vice President, Business Development & Solutions

FLSA: Full-Time; Salaried

WHAT SETS YOU APART

The Manager of Solutions & Insights serves as the commercial strategy, sales enablement, and partnership development function for the Brand Alliances department. This role will translate insights, inventory, partner objectives, and market trends into customized partnership solutions, revenue platforms, go-to-market materials, and partner-facing strategies.  This role will have a focus on 1) supporting the Business Development team by utilizing data and insights to create compelling sales solutions and go-to-market presentations to drive new revenue and expand commercial inventory and 2) supporting the Brand Alliance Marketing team by leading impactful recaps and identifying upsell opportunities to continuously elevate the level of service offered by our team. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

 

  • Develop strategic partnership narratives that connect prospective partners' business objectives with Orlando City SC and Orlando Pride's audience, brand, and fan experiences, translating complex sponsorship opportunities into clear, compelling stories that demonstrate mutual value and illustrate how each recommendation supports the partner's business objectives.
  • Conduct brand research on prospective and existing partners by analyzing current campaigns, product lines, messaging priorities, business objectives, and market trends to develop customized sponsorship concepts and visuals that authentically align with both the partner's identity and the Orlando City SC and Orlando Pride brands.
  • Exhibit strong project management skills to manage the asset development process from ideation to execution to ensure consistency and delivery on partner KPI’s.
  • Attend client meetings as necessary to present relevant data insights and accompanying solutions in support of the sales & renewal process.
  • Leverage partnership performance data, audience insights, market intelligence, and industry trends to develop strategic recommendations that strengthen sponsorship proposals, partnership recaps, and future sales opportunities.
  • Identify and organize market research, category research, competitive analysis, and ongoing sponsorship trends to develop focused brand target lists for the business development team.
  • Analyze partnership performance, campaign results, and fan engagement metrics to create impactful recap presentations and generate insights that inform future partnership strategies and creative recommendations.
  • Lead the creation of infographics that transform sponsorship metrics, campaign performance, audience insights, and business insights into visually compelling graphics and partner-facing materials.
  • Maintain and refresh club overview story presentations, including creating ongoing sales stories and narratives for the Business Development team to utilize in the sales process.
  • Collaborate cross-departmentally with teammates in creative, marketing, social/digital, strategy & analytics, community, and operations to identify new revenue-generating inventory, ensure partnership concepts align with strategic objectives and are successfully brought to life.
  • Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride.  It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in sport management, business, marketing, or related fields required.
  • Highly motivated individual contributor with cross-functional experience, including technical and strategic knowledge of corporate partnerships. Previous team experience is preferred but not required. 
  • Minimum 2-3 years in Partnerships and/or Creative Marketing with demonstrated success in media, sport sponsorship, or entertainment fields. 
  • Organized project manager with ability to effectively manage multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Ability to work independently, be self-directed, and demonstrate initiative.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Word, Excel) and Adobe Creative Suite (or Photoshop) for mockups and presentations.
  • Experience working in data analysis platforms (Blinkfire, Salesforce, YouGov).
  • A team-first collaborator that builds trust in relationships across all business functions.
  • Must be strategic in thinking and an effective communicator with polished presentation skills, both verbal and written, with experience creating and delivering recap/sales presentations. 
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and be able to work non-traditional hours within a team atmosphere.
  • The ability to pass a background screening.
  • The ability to attain and maintain Safesport certification.

 



About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride: 

 

In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.  

The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons. 

In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.  

The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.

 

In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.

 

In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.  

For more information on Orlando City SC and Orlando, visit OrlandoCitySC.com or Orlando-Pride.com.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

Please contact the People and Culture department at Peopleandculture@orlandocitysc.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Communications - Communications Manager, Orlando Pride
job.html_description:
TITLE: Communications Manager – Orlando Pride

DEPARTMENT: Communications

REPORTS TO: Sr. Director of Communications

FLSA: Full-time; Salaried, Exempt

 

WHAT SETS YOU APART

 

You are a strategic, collaborative, and self-driven communications professional with a passion for soccer and storytelling. You bring expertise in media relations and content strategy, while thriving in fast-paced, high-performance environments. In this role, you will help elevate the Orlando Pride’s brand, drive meaningful engagement with key audiences and contribute to the continued growth of the club and the women’s game on both the local and global stage.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

 

  • Serve as the primary communications lead for the Orlando Pride, overseeing all day-to-day media relations, including matchday media operations, media availability at training sessions, interview coordination and internal documentation.
  • Develop and execute strategic communications plans that align with Club objectives, driving media coverage and brand visibility across local, national and international outlets.
  • Lead the development of storylines in collaboration with internal content teams, marketing and external media partners, translating Club knowledge into compelling narratives that amplify team identity, milestones, and key moments.
  • Partner with the Sr. Director of Communications to shape and execute proactive media outreach, brand alignment and integrated communications campaigns.
  • Oversee day-to-day media operations, including media at trainings, matchday credentialing, press box logistics and post-match media availability, while supervising and mentoring department associates and interns.
  • Produce key written materials, including press releases, advisories, game notes and Club bios, with particular emphasis on clarity, brand voice and timeliness.
  • Spearhead the monitoring and reporting of Pride-specific media coverage, collaborating with senior leadership to evaluate messaging impact and refine outreach and crisis response tactics.
  • Lead planning and execution of Pride-specific media events such as press conferences, media days and Club announcements.
  • Represent the Communications department at Club and venue events, providing strategic guidance and on-site support as needed.
  • Foster and strengthen relationships with media personnel, league communications teams, and broadcast partners across the domestic and international soccer landscape.
  • Travel as needed to support media relations for away matches and events.
  • Support Club-wide marketing efforts, as well as brand alliances and sales initiatives, by aligning communications strategies with overarching goals
  • Other duties as assigned

 

 

QUALIFICATIONS

 

It’s never just a job at Orlando Pride.  It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:

 

  • 4+ years of experience in sports communications, media relations, or related fields
  • Deep understanding of the women’s soccer landscape, especially NWSL
  • Self-starter who takes pride in their duties and is consistently looking to raise the standard of excellence
  • Strong interpersonal skills, including a network of media contacts and/or the ability to foster relationships with Club media targets
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple projects under tight deadlines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in AP style
  • Bilingual in Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus, but not required
  • Proficiency in digital tools and platforms; knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite is a plus
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, in non-traditional settings within a fast-paced team environment
  • The ability to pass a background screening
  • The ability to attain and maintain Safesport certification

 



About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride: 

 

In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.  

The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons. 

In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.  

The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.

 

In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.

 

In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.  

For more information on Orlando City SC and Orlando, visit OrlandoCitySC.com or Orlando-Pride.com.

job.title: Brand Alliance - Manager, Brand Alliance Marketing
job.html_description:
TITLE: Manager, Brand Alliances Marketing

DEPARTMENT: Brand Alliances
REPORTS TO: Senior Director, Brand Alliance Marketing

FLSA: Full-Time; Salaried

WHAT SETS YOU APART

As Brand Alliance Marketing Manager, you will oversee partner accounts across all clubs, manage asset activation, develop strategic programs aligned with partner business objectives, identify upsell opportunities, and lead renewals. You will build strong relationships while continually enhancing the service and support provided by the Brand Alliances department.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Deliver exceptional service and build strong relationships with partner contacts at all organizational levels.
  • Manage the delivery of all assets for assigned partner accounts, ensuring alignment with business objectives. Develop a deep understanding of each partner’s business and identify mutually beneficial opportunities to collaborate.
  • Advance organizational marketing objectives through partner activations, including ticket offers, partner inventory, retail programs, in-stadium promotions, special events, and community outreach.
  • Identify upsell opportunities and present strategic ideas that align with partner business objectives.
  • Lead the renewal process to strengthen and grow partner relationships, collaborating with the Senior Director and SVP of Brand Alliances on strategies that engage stakeholders across the organization.
  • Partner with Legal and Brand Alliances senior leadership to execute new agreements during the renewal process.
  • Manage budgets for assigned partner accounts to achieve financial and partner objectives, including timely invoice submission, quarterly expense updates, and preliminary budgets for future years.
  • Lead annual planning sessions for assigned Brand Alliance partner accounts, engaging the broader Orlando City and Orlando Pride team to develop strategies aligned with partner business objectives. Produce annual recaps and collaborate with Business Intelligence to generate insights and recommendations.
  • Collaborate across Creative, Ticketing, Marketing, Social/Digital, IT, Community, and HR to coordinate and support partner programs.
  • Maintain accurate benchmarks, records, and inventory in Brand Alliances OneDrive, KORE CRM and ACTIVATE.
  • Document and track partnership performance promptly and accurately for recaps, including photos, screenshots, Trajektory and Blinkfire data, KORE reports, and other relevant third-party data.
  • Provide ongoing recommendations on asset and inventory management and availability.
  • Support the Brand Alliance Business Development team in creating innovative, sellable assets for prospects and existing partners. 
  • Submit partnership creative briefs and proofread collateral featuring corporate partner and Club logos to ensure accurate brand usage across print, digital, social, sponsor artwork, and other materials.
  • Coordinate media and creative traffic logistics with partners and media partners, including reviewing rundowns and inventory.
  • Lead cross-functional meetings and provide regular updates to leadership.
  • Coordinate approved ticket requests and distribution for corporate partners.
  • Negotiate competitive pricing and coordinate orders for giveaways, merchandise, and client gifts.
  • Support the planning and execution of departmental special events.
  • Work home games and support on-site partner activations.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

At Orlando City SC, soccer and entertainment are more than a job—they are a way of life. Every role is as unique as the person who fills it. Successful candidates will also have the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in sport management, business, marketing, or a related field.
  • At least three years of partnership marketing and activation experience, with demonstrated success in media, sports sponsorship, or entertainment. Sales experience is a plus.
  • Strategic thinker and effective communicator who thrives on meeting and exceeding partner objectives.
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple accounts and balancing competing priorities.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with experience creating and delivering recap and sales presentations. 
  • Experience in the Florida market preferred but not required.
  • Supervisory experience preferred but not required.
  • Strong interpersonal, organizational, analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced event environment.
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours and in varied settings as part of a collaborative team.
  • Ability to successfully pass a background check.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a SafeSport certification.

job.title: Guest Services Event Staff, Subaru Park
job.html_description:
ABOUT OUR COMPANY
Awarded Major League Soccer’s 16th franchise in 2008, the Philadelphia Union officially took the pitch in 2010 and have been raising expectations ever since. Owned and operated by Union Sports & Entertainment, the Philadelphia Union call Subaru Park home—an 18,500-seat, world-class, soccer-specific stadium set along the Delaware River beneath the Commodore Barry Bridge, just 15 miles from downtown Philadelphia.

On the field, the Union have established themselves as one of Major League Soccer’s most consistent and competitive clubs. The team reached the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup Final three times (2014, 2015, and 2018), made multiple MLS Cup Playoff appearances, and captured the Supporters’ Shield in 2020 and again in 2025, recognizing the club’s excellence and consistency across the regular season. The Union also hosted the Eastern Conference Final in 2021, were crowned Eastern Conference Champions in 2022, and advanced to the MLS Cup Final that same year in one of the most thrilling matches in league history. The club has continued to represent Philadelphia on the international stage through participation in the Scotiabank CONCACAF Champions League.

Off the field, the Philadelphia Union are defined by a culture that is Young, Fearless, and Challenger-driven. We are unafraid to think differently, push boundaries, and pursue excellence in everything we do. We believe success is built through accountability, collaboration, innovation, and a relentless drive to raise the bar.

Our deep connection to Philadelphia is woven into who we are. From the Club’s crest and colors to the thirteen stars and rallying cry, the Union proudly reflect the city’s revolutionary spirit and its legacy as the birthplace of American independence.  If you’re ready to challenge the ordinary and help shape the future of soccer in Philadelphia, we invite you to join us.

ABOUT THE ROLE
As part of the Guest Services team at Subaru Park, you’ll help shape the game‑day experience for our fans. Our staff is dedicated to creating a safe, welcoming, and energetic environment throughout the stadium. You’ll greet guests, assist with directions and seating, monitor crowd behavior, and help ensure every visitor enjoys a top‑tier sports and entertainment experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Warmly greet guests and welcome them to Subaru Park.
  • Assist with ticketing questions, seating locations, and general stadium procedures and policies.
  • Comfortably manage and interact with large groups of guests.
  • Maintain awareness and control of your assigned section or area.
  • Anticipate, identify, and resolve issues to promote a safe and enjoyable environment.
  • Share general building information, including locations of amenities and services.
  • Ensure all areas remain safe for guests and staff.
  • Monitor alcohol consumption and help address related concerns appropriately.
  • Deliver exceptional, friendly, and proactive customer service.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support stadium operations.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • Available to work a part‑time schedule that includes frequent evening and weekend shifts (majority of events occur during these hours).
  • Previous customer service experience preferred.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional in high‑stress or fast‑paced situations.
  • Comfortable standing for long periods.
  • Ability to work outdoors in varying and extreme weather conditions.
  • Friendly, outgoing, and positive personality.
  • Consistently courteous, polite, and committed to delivering a great guest experience.

Part-time employees are eligible for our 401(k) savings plan, including employer 401(k) matching (subject to plan eligibility and terms).

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class. Not sure you meet every requirement? Championship teams are built on diverse strengths. If you’re passionate about sports and excited about this role, we want to hear from you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
**This is not a role with the Philadelphia Union first team, second team, or Academy**  

The Philadelphia Union Youth is a premier training program that provides year around clinics, camps and affiliate training.  This part-time staff coach position will report directly to the Union Youth Director and provide supplemental training programs including goalkeeper coaching for programs such as camps, clinics and club training.  A pivotal part of this role will be to deliver the Union Youth methodology through organized training sessions. 

The Union Youth Training Programs are currently looking to add new and experienced coaches to our staff. In conjunction with the Union Youth Director, this individual will assist and provide input into the Union Youth Developmental Curriculum. Core to the role is the ongoing positive promotion of the Philadelphia Union through soccer organizations and communities.

Details
• Summer availability from June to August
• Available to work at least 8 of the 12 weeks
• Available Monday-Thursday 8:00am-4:00pm
• Pay based on coaching license
• Have had at least 1 year of coaching experience
• Playing experience preferred

WHAT CAMPS & PROGRAMS DO WE OFFER?
Union Youth Soccer Camps & Programs are designed to meet players where they are in terms of development. The camps & programs offered throughout the year include UTrain, Union Camps, Union Tournaments, and the Player Pathway Program.

UTRAIN
Philadelphia Union provide youth programs and clinics which are designed to provide a series of training sessions that allow the Union to connect with local clubs and the soccer community. The UTrain Program offers programs for all level of players looking to train outside of their club environment. The programs range from beginner to elite level and delivered under the instruction of the Philadelphia Union Youth coaching staff.

UNION CAMPS
Union Youth Soccer Camps are designed for ages 6 to 14 years old.  All camps are designed to create a professional & engaging environment for players to learn and improve their game.

PLAYER PATHWAY PROGRAM
The Philadelphia Union Youth Player Pathway Program (PPP) provides supplemental development training (club neutral) by creating a player-centered learning environment for advanced level boys and girls ages U10—U14. The Union Youth is also part of the identification program for the Union Academy.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Conduct oneself in a professional manner as a representative of the Philadelphia Union.
  • Lead and/or assist trainings within the greater Philadelphia area 1 to 5 times a week, depending on availability and willingness to work. With the exceptions of summer camps and holiday clinics, goalkeeper trainings typically occur within the timeframe of 5-9 pm on weeknights. 
  • Advise, educate and provide development opportunities to the affiliate clubs.
  • Provide the Youth Director with weekly reports on programs directly involved in.
  • Oversee onsite programs and manage youth programs.

**This is not a role with the Philadelphia Union first team, second team, or Academy**  

QUALIFICATIONS
  • On-field and Goalkeeper experience - playing and/or coaching. 
  • Coaching license and/or goalkeeper license - preferred, but not required if candidate shows proficiency in the additional areas below.
  • A passion for coaching and developing grassroots level players.
  • Strong communications skills and ability to educate.
  • Have own transportation.
  • Willingness to attend coaching education, learn directly from the Youth Director, and have a growth mindset. 
  • An ability to think and plan strategically, as well as the ability to adjust on the fly and be autonomous in training sessions.
  • A team player, with an ability to operate as part of an integrated multi-functional management team.
  • Applicants for employment in the U.S. must possess work authorization, which does not require sponsorship by the employer.

This position requires the following clearances: 
  • PA Child Abuse History clearance
  • PA State Police Criminal Records Check
  • An FBI Criminal Background Check
  • Safesport Certification

Part-time employees are eligible for our 401(k) savings plan, including employer 401(k) matching (subject to plan eligibility and terms).

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class. Not sure you meet every requirement? Championship teams are built on diverse strengths. If you’re passionate about sports and excited about this role, we want to hear from you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We’re looking for enthusiastic, hard-working people to join the housekeeping team at Subaru Park during the season. Housekeeping staff play a critical role in maintaining a clean, safe, and welcoming environment for our guests, players, and staff. This is a fast-paced, hands-on role that requires attention to detail, reliability, and the ability to work a flexible schedule.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Clean and sanitize restrooms, locker rooms, and office areas.
  • Sweep, mop, scrub, and vacuum floors.
  • Empty trash receptacles and replace liners.
  • Detail-clean suites and premium spaces (dusting, mopping, wiping surfaces, restocking supplies).
  • Pick up and sort waste and recycling following post-event procedures.
  • Pressure-wash seating bowl and other exterior surfaces as needed.
  • Maintain cleaning equipment and report supply or maintenance needs.
  • Follow all cleaning, safety, and PPE protocols.
  • Perform other housekeeping duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
  • Ability to follow both oral and written instructions.
  • Strong verbal communication skills and ability to work with others.
  • Comfortable working in both indoor and outdoor environments.
  • Flexible availability — daytime, afternoons, evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays as required by stadium schedule.
  • Able to work independently, exercise good judgment, and take initiative.
  • Reliable, punctual, and able to work a fast-paced, event-driven schedule.

Physical Requirements
  • Must be able to stand, bend, stoop, reach, and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift, carry, and move objects (frequently up to ~50 lbs) and perform repetitive tasks.
  • Must be able to work outdoors in varying weather conditions and in noisy, crowded environments.

Part-time employees are eligible for our 401(k) savings plan, including employer 401(k) matching (subject to plan eligibility and terms).

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class. Not sure you meet every requirement? Championship teams are built on diverse strengths. If you’re passionate about sports and excited about this role, we want to hear from you!

job.title: Philadelphia Union Academy – Part-Time Driver
job.html_description:
ABOUT US
Awarded Major League Soccer’s 16th franchise in 2008, the Philadelphia Union officially took the pitch in 2010 and have been raising expectations ever since. Owned and operated by Union Sports & Entertainment, the Philadelphia Union call Subaru Park home—an 18,500-seat, world-class, soccer-specific stadium set along the Delaware River beneath the Commodore Barry Bridge, just 15 miles from downtown Philadelphia.

On the field, the Union have established themselves as one of Major League Soccer’s most consistent and competitive clubs. The team reached the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup Final three times (2014, 2015, and 2018), made multiple MLS Cup Playoff appearances, and captured the Supporters’ Shield in 2020 and again in 2025, recognizing the club’s excellence and consistency across the regular season. The Union also hosted the Eastern Conference Final in 2021, were crowned Eastern Conference Champions in 2022, and advanced to the MLS Cup Final that same year in one of the most thrilling matches in league history. The club has continued to represent Philadelphia on the international stage through participation in the Scotiabank CONCACAF Champions League.

Youth development is the core of our mission and the heart of our passion. The Philadelphia Union Academy is committed to providing a world-class player development environment that prepares talented young athletes to reach their highest potential. Our Academy is free of charge, ensuring that the region's top players have the opportunity to pursue excellence regardless of financial circumstances. 

Built upon best practices from leading clubs around the world, the Philadelphia Union Academy integrates elite coaching, sport science, athletic development, education, and performance support into a holistic development model. Every member of our staff plays an important role in creating a safe, professional, and supportive environment that reflects the values and culture of the Philadelphia Union. 

ABOUT THE ROLE 
Reporting to Academy Operations, the Part-Time Academy Driver is responsible for safely transporting Academy players to and from training sessions, matches, educational programming, and other Academy-related activities. This individual plays an essential role in supporting the daily operation of the Academy by ensuring players arrive safely, on time, and prepared to perform. 

The ideal candidate is a dependable, safety-conscious professional who demonstrates excellent judgment, strong communication skills, and a commitment to providing a positive experience for our Academy players and families. 

RESPONSIBILITIES 
  • Safely transport Academy players (minors) to and from Academy training sessions, matches, educational programming, and other Club-related activities. 
  • Follow established transportation schedules while maintaining punctuality for all pick-up and drop-off times. 
  • Prioritize the safety, well-being, and professionalism expected when transporting youth athletes. 
  • Operate Club vehicles in accordance with all federal, state, and local traffic laws and safety regulations. 
  • Complete pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections to ensure vehicles remain safe, clean, and properly maintained. 
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of assigned vehicles. 
  • Communicate effectively with Academy Operations staff regarding transportation schedules, delays, route changes, or player concerns. 
  • Maintain accurate trip logs, including mileage, fuel usage, and transportation records as required. 
  • Immediately report accidents, incidents, maintenance concerns, or safety issues to Academy leadership. 
  • Demonstrate professionalism and represent the Philadelphia Union positively when interacting with players, families, schools, and community partners. 
  • Assist with other Academy operational needs as assigned. 

QUALIFICATIONS 
  • Valid driver's license with an excellent driving record. 
  • Previous experience transporting youth, student-athletes, or similar groups preferred. 
  • Ability to safely operate passenger vans or similar vehicles. 
  • Strong understanding of safe driving practices and applicable traffic laws. 
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
  • Reliable, punctual, organized, and trustworthy. 
  • Ability to remain calm and exercise sound judgment in changing or stressful situations. 
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with Academy staff. 
  • Flexible availability, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and occasional holidays based on Academy schedules. 
  • Familiarity with SafeSport principles and youth protection best practices is preferred. 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS 
  • Ability to sit and drive for extended periods. 
  • Ability to assist with loading and unloading equipment when needed. 
  • Ability to safely enter and exit passenger vehicles multiple times throughout the day. 

This position requires valid criminal background clearances in the state of PA:
  • PA Child Abuse History Clearance 
  • PA State Police Criminal Record Check
  • DHS Criminal Background Check (via fingerprinting)
  • Annual Safe Sport Certification
  • MVR Background Check 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description.  Championship teams are built on diverse strengths. If you’re passionate about sports and excited about this role, we want to hear from you! We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.
